entries.zh: 时间、重力和空间是构成现实的基本零件。如果我们能学会操纵它们，我们就能解密并掌控万物。
entries.en: Time, gravity and space are the fundamental cogs that make up the clockwork of reality. If we can learn to manipulate them, the universe and its secrets will be ours.

entries.zh:
无知正在束缚着我们，让我们无从一窥大千世界之奥秘。

无论付出什么代价，我们都要挣脱束缚。

§R失落帝国会试图阻止我们！§!
entries.en:
Ignorance shackles us, putting the universe's secrets out of reach.

No matter the price, we must break free.

§RFallen Empires will try to stop us!§!

entries.zh: \n£trigger_no£§R我们已放弃了宇宙创生野心。§!
理解现实的无限层次需要从观点上发生剧烈的转变，即使是对我们最聪明的头脑而言，也是一种挑战。
entries.en: The radical shift in perspective required to comprehend the infinite layers of reality challenges even our most brilliant minds.

entries.zh: 解锁§H宇宙创生§!天灾§H等级2§!
§H$tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_1$§!\n解开现实背后的运作秘密，我们必须敞开更大尺度的思维。
entries.en: §H$tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_1$§!\nTo uncover the inner workings of reality, we must open our minds to a grander scale of thinking.

entries.zh: 重力和时空塑造了宇宙。从重力开始，我们将掌握羽化飞升的工具。
entries.en: Gravity and spacetime shape the universe. Starting with gravity, we will master tools to power our ascension.

entries.zh: 解锁§H宇宙创生§!天灾§H等级3§!
§H$tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_2$§!\n重力现在不过是我们用于在现实的画布上肆意泼洒的画笔。
entries.en: §H$tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_2$§!\nGravity is merely one brush we could use to paint upon the canvas of reality.

entries.zh: 对重力精雕细琢使我们能够向现实的编码中注入指令。在我们学习使用这种令人难以置信的新工具时，必须要极其地谨慎。
entries.en: Precise and incredibly minute alterations in gravity allow us to inject commands into the code of reality. Extreme caution is imperative as we learn the applications of this new and incredible tool.

entries.zh: 解锁§H宇宙创生§!天灾§H等级4§!
§H$tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_3$§!\n重力的一针针穿刺使我们终于得以刺透时空。
entries.en: §H$tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_3$§!\nOne by one, pinpricks of gravitational force will allow us to pierce through spacetime.

entries.zh: 最近的实验表明，我们对现实的修改只是暂时的。为了锚定这些修改，将需要进行更大幅度的调整。
entries.en: Recent experiments confirm that our edits to reality are only temporary. More significant alterations will be necessary to anchor these changes.

entries.zh: 解锁§H宇宙创生§!天灾§H等级5§!
§H$tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_4$§!\n现实正在呻吟。它抗议着、抱怨着，顽固地在我们的玩弄下不断重塑着自己。我们可不能让这种不遂人愿的事态发展继续下去。
entries.en: §H$tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_4$§!\nReality groans; it protests and grumbles, stubbornly reshaping itself despite our alterations. This unexpected development cannot be allowed to continue.

entries.zh: 前往其他宇宙的大规模旅行是一项艰巨的任务。我们必须设计出一种宇宙飞船，它不仅能穿透时空的结构，而且能在旅途中幸存下来。\n\n§R失落帝国会试图阻止我们！§!
entries.en: Large-scale travel to different universes is a daunting task. We must engineer a spacecraft that can not only pierce the fabric of spacetime but also survive the journey.\n\n§RFallen Empires will try to stop us!§!

entries.zh: §H视界刺针§!\n视界刺针是科技的奇迹。它是一种具有扭曲现实能力的民用舰船，将能容纳我们的人口和所积累的知识，从而引领我们安全地进行跨宇宙移民。
entries.en: §HHorizon Needle§!\nA technological marvel, the Horizon Needle is a civilian ship with reality-bending capabilities. It can house our population and our accumulated knowledge to safely shepherd the trans-universal migration.

entries.zh: £trigger_no£必须建造在我们首都的轨道上。
entries.en: £trigger_no£ Must be built in orbit of our capital.

entries.zh: 每一个新的发现，无论多么些微，我们都将从中寻得一些对现实背后运作原理的洞见。\n\n研究科技以获得这项超然逻辑奖励。
entries.en: With every new discovery, no matter how small, we gain insights into the inner workings of reality.\n\nResearch technologies to gain this Advanced Logic reward.

entries.zh: 对主宰现实行为的规则进行大规模调整实验将产出宝贵的数据。\n\n研究这些稀有科技以获得这项超然逻辑奖励。
entries.en: Large-scale experiments to alter the rules that govern the behavior of reality will yield precious data.\n\nResearch these rare technologies to gain this Advanced Logic reward.

entries.zh: 专注研究的附庸可以帮助我们追寻绝对的知识。\n\n保留§Y学邦§!以获得这项§Y年度§!超然逻辑奖励。
entries.en: Research-focused subjects can help us in our quest for absolute knowledge.\n\nRetain §YScholarium Vassals§! to gain this §Yannual§! Advanced Logic reward.

entries.zh:
我们必须做出一点牺牲才能够适应如此宏大的研究规模。

将人口作为§Y神经芯片§!装入§Y突触凝练机§!以获得超然逻辑。

§Y神经芯片§!的产出随着在§Y突触凝练机§!上的人口数量增加，并可以区划和建筑物进一步提高。
entries.en:
The scale of our research is such that sacrifices must be made to accommodate it.

Use pops as §YNeural Chips§! in the §YSynaptic Lathe§! to gain Advanced Logic.

The output of §YNeural Chips§! scales up with the number of pops on the §YSynaptic Lathe§! and can be further boosted through districts and buildings.

entries.zh: 这座最先进的研究设施远离任何重力异常，可用于验证未受影响的时空数据。\n\n掌控完全升级的§Y科学枢纽§!巨型结构以获得这项§Y年度§!超然逻辑奖励。
entries.en: Located far from any gravitational anomaly, this state-of-the-art research facility is used to ascertain unspoiled spacetime data.\n\nControl fully upgraded §YScience Nexus§! megastructures to gain this §Yannual§! Advanced Logic reward.

entries.zh: 让星海共同体成员国了解我们研究的必要性可以让我们的计划大跨一步。\n\n让§Y星海共同体§!采纳解放知识§Y议案§!以获得这项§Y年度§!超然逻辑奖励。
entries.en: Convincing the members of the Galactic Community that our research is essential would go a long way toward fulfilling our plans.\n\nMake the §YGalactic Community§! adopt Unchained Knowledge §YResolutions§! to gain this §Yannual§! Advanced Logic reward.

entries.zh:
可以开始通过完成§H天灾目标§!以积累£advanced_logic£§Y$menp_cosmo_objectives$§!。

解锁§Y$tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_1$§!科技，带我们迈向目标。
entries.en:
Allows the accumulation of £advanced_logic£ §Y$menp_cosmo_objectives$§! by completing §HCrisis Objectives§!.

Unlocks the §Y$tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_1$§! technology, that will bring us closer to fulfill our goals.

entries.zh: 超然逻辑代表我们对现实主宰法则的理解以及对其造成影响的能力。
entries.en: Advanced Logic represents our understanding of the laws that govern reality and our power to influence them.

entries.zh: 失落帝国的初级建筑可以出现在研究选项中。\n
entries.en: Simple Fallen Empire buildings can now appear as research options.\n

entries.zh: 失落帝国也许忘记了如何复现他们的先进科技，但我们的杰出大脑将会揭开他们尘封的黄金时代的秘密。
entries.en: Fallen Empires may have forgotten how to replicate their advanced technology, but our minds will uncover the bygone secrets of their golden age.
Unlocks the technology for the §Y$tech_dark_matter_power_core$§! ship component.\n

entries.zh: 学习如何驾驭反重子粒子的能量是在超浓缩能量生产方面的下一步飞跃。
entries.en: Learning how to harness the energy of antibaryonic particles is the next step in the evolution of ultra-compact power generation.

entries.zh: 解锁§Y突触凝练机§!巨型结构科技。\n
entries.en: Unlocks the technology for the §YSynaptic Lathe§! Megastructure.\n

entries.zh: 硕大无朋的突触凝练机是一种储备池计算机，以我们人口网络意识的算力用于计算和存储。其优势不言而喻，但一些三观不正的物种会认为这种将个体异化为计算芯片行为视为道德有问题。
entries.en: Colossal in scale, the Synaptic Lathe is a reservoir computer. The processing power of our population's networked minds is used to compute and store data. The benefits are obvious, but some misguided species may view the transmutation of individuals into computing chips as morally questionable.

entries.zh: 解锁失落帝国的§Y护航舰§!舰船科技。\n
entries.en: Unlocks the technology for the Fallen Empire §YEscort§! ship.\n

entries.zh: 一艘中等大小的星际飞船，它优化了我们对时空的认识以实现维度超越，其内部空间远大于外观所见。与传统舰艇设计相比，它拥有先进火力的同时还降低了后勤成本。
entries.en: A starship of modest size that optimizes our knowledge of spacetime to enact dimensional transcendentalism, making the inside bigger than its outward shape suggests. Advanced firepower capabilities come at a reduced logistical cost compared to traditional ship designs.

entries.zh: 失落帝国的先进建筑可以出现在研究选项中。\n
entries.en: Advanced Fallen Empire buildings can now appear as research options.\n

entries.zh: 失落帝国的能源产出能力曾一度令我们困惑不已，但现已茅塞顿开。
entries.en: The resource generation capabilities of Fallen Empires have long baffled us. Not anymore.
Unlocks the technology for the §Y$tech_enigmatic_decoder$§! and §Y$tech_dark_matter_propulsion$§! ship component.\n

entries.zh: 我们对暗物质及其应用的理解不断加深，开拓出了一条科学进步的康庄大道。
entries.en: Our growing understanding of dark matter and its applications will open new avenues of technological progress.
Unlocks the §Y$tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_2$§! technology, that will bring us closer to fulfill our goals.\n

entries.zh: 解锁失落帝国的§Y战列巡洋舰§!舰船科技。\n
entries.en: Unlocks the technology for the Fallen Empire §YBattlecruiser§! ship.\n

entries.zh: 另一种优化的太空飞船，尺寸更大，让现有的战列舰看起来形同航模一般。
entries.en: Another optimized spacecraft, this time of larger dimensions, will make current Battleships look like toys.

entries.zh: 失落帝国的综合建筑可以出现在研究选项中。\n
entries.en: Complex Fallen Empire buildings can now appear as research options.\n

entries.zh: 我们如今已经逐步揭开围绕着失落帝国的神秘面纱，必须继续保持这个势头。早晚有一天，他们的一切科技秘密都将被我们揭晓。
entries.en: Now that we have begun to unravel the veil of mystery surrounding Fallen Empires, we must keep continue to pull the thread. In time, the secrets of their technology will come undone.
Unlocks the technology for the §Y$tech_enigmatic_encoder$§! and §Y$tech_dark_matter_deflector$§! ship component.\n

entries.zh: 将暗物质应用于防护科技和加密领域可以创造中和场以及可靠的通讯频道。
entries.en: Using dark matter in defensive technology and encryption will enable us to create nullifying fields and robust communication channels.
Unlocks the §Y$tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_3$§! technology, that will bring us closer to fulfill our goals.\n

entries.zh: 解锁失落帝国的§Y泰坦§!舰船科技。\n
entries.en: Unlocks the technology for the Fallen Empire §YTitan§! ship.\n

entries.zh: 这些强大的舰船几乎就是一座移动的堡垒，只有最强烈的攻击才有可能伤其分毫。
entries.en: These formidable ships are closer to mobile fortresses than anything else, and only the most brutal assaults have a chance to damage them.

entries.zh: 失落帝国的非凡建筑可以出现在研究选项中。\n
entries.en: Extraordinary Fallen Empire buildings can now appear as research options.\n

entries.zh: 失落帝国对次元操作的洞见令人惊叹。他们最古老的科技伴随着每一个发现都逐渐显得明晰起来。
entries.en: The insights of Fallen Empires into dimensional manipulation are astonishing. With every discovery, even their most arcane technology begins to seem simplistic.
Unlocks the technology for the §Y$tech_energy_lance_2$§! and §Y$tech_dragon_armor$§! ship component.\n

entries.zh: 最新的科技进展让我们可以为舰船装上最利之矛和最坚之盾。
entries.en: Our latest technological advancements should enable us to fashion deadlier weapons and more formidable armor for our ships.

entries.zh: 解锁§Y$tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_4$§!科技，带我们迈向目标。\n同时还解锁§Y$tech_cosmogenesis_thesis$§!循环科技，以产出可观数量的§Y超然逻辑§!。\n
entries.en: Unlocks the §Y$tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_4$§! technology, that will bring us closer to our goals.\nAlso unlocks the §Y$tech_cosmogenesis_thesis$§! repeatable technology that can yield considerable amounts of §YAdvanced Logic§!.\n

entries.zh: 失落帝国的奥术建筑可以作为研究选项出现。\n
entries.en: Arcane Fallen Empire buildings can now appear as research options.\n

entries.zh: 失落帝国的秘密终于重见天日，它们将会为我们带来一个全新的时代。
entries.en: The secrets of Fallen Empires, at last uncovered, will usher in a new age for our people.
Unlocks the technology for the §Y$tech_nanite_repair_system$§!, §Y$tech_nanite_autocannon$§! and §Y$tech_nanite_flak_batteries$§! ship component.\n

entries.zh: 每一次改变视角，新的机遇就会逐一涌现。在最小的尺度上进行修改能带来最大的结果。
entries.en: With every shift in perspective, new opportunities present themselves. Change on the smallest scale can have massive consequences.

entries.zh: 解锁§Y$tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_5$§!科技，让我们可以建造一座§Y视界刺针§!，带我们完成目标。
entries.en: Unlocks the §Y$tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_5$§! technology, that will allow us to build a §YHorizon Needle§! and fulfill our goals.

entries.zh: £trigger_yes£已经研究了至少2个§Y应用无限课题§!
entries.en: £trigger_yes£ Has researched at least 2 §YApplied Infinity Thesis§!

entries.zh: £trigger_no£已经研究了至少2个§Y应用无限课题§!
entries.en: £trigger_no£ Has researched at least 2 §YApplied Infinity Thesis§!

entries.zh: 通过进一步调整现实法则，我们也能更好地监测其响应。即便如此，效应仍然难以预计，并可能对整个星系造成影响。
entries.en: By making further alterations to reality's rules, we can better monitor its reactions. At this scale, the effects are still difficult to predict, and could affect the entire galaxy.
Attempt to bend the §HRules of Reality§!

entries.zh: 这些危险的实验可能造成难以预测的结果。
entries.en: These dangerous experiments will have unpredictable results.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$无法将我们的最后一个人口迁移到突触凝练机。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Cannot resettle our last Pop to the Synaptic Lathe.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$无法从突触凝练机迁移走最后一个人口。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Cannot resettle the last Pop from the Synaptic Lathe.
We cannot open branch offices on $pc_cosmogenesis_world$.

entries.zh: 一座硕大无朋的储备池计算系统。它用错综复杂的电缆、晶体管和生命维持舱将包括有机体或合成人在内的数以亿计感性生物互相连接。对个体处理器官的强烈压榨将不可避免地导致一些联网“部件”的脑损伤。
entries.en: A colossal reservoir computing system designed to connect billions of sentient beings, organic or synthetic, via an intricate array of cables, transistors, and life support pods. The intensive strain on individual processing organs will inevitably lead to brain damage for any networked 'component.'

entries.zh: 该物种已经无法适应除了突触凝练机的生命维持舱以外的其他环境。他们只想沉浸在幸福的幻境中，不愿意再遭受现实的捶打。
entries.en: The species is unfit for survival outside of the life support pods of a Synaptic Lathe. They crave a blissful coma, not the relentless assaults of reality.

entries.zh: 单个神经芯片可能微不足道。一旦积土成山，处理能力就会呈指数增长。
entries.en: A single Neural Chip is inconsequential. Once connected, their processing capabilities increase exponentially.

entries.zh: §E每有一个§Y神经芯片§!插入凝练机，这座结构中其他所有§Y神经芯片§!的效率都会提升。将我们的人口大量迁移至此，我们就能显著地提升其产出能力。§!
entries.en: §EWith every §YNeural Chip§! plugged into the Lathe, the efficiency of all other §YNeural Chips§! in the structure increases. By resettling our population here in greater numbers, we can improve the structure's production significantly.§!

entries.zh: 这些个体被作为一座巨大尺寸计算机的芯片。他们深陷人为的昏迷中，维生舱确保他们可以达到最长的寿命。运算量的巨大压力最终会逐渐将其认知器官耗竭。
entries.en: These individuals are used as chips in a computer of gigantic scale. Deep in an artificial coma, life pods ensure maximum longevity. Eventually, the massive strain of the processing load will cause cognitive organs to break down.

entries.zh: 受影响人口将自动迁移至§Y突触凝练机§!并成为$job_neural_chip$。
entries.en: Affected Pops are automatically resettled to the §YSynaptic Lathe§! and employed as $job_neural_chip$.

entries.zh: 一台尺寸大得难以理解的计算机，它把感性生物当作处理芯片进行研究和产出超然逻辑，并逐渐将他们杀害。随着插入的单元增多，其效率会显著提高。
entries.en: A computer of unreasonable proportions that uses sentient beings as processing chips to generate research and advanced logic, eventually killing them. Its efficiency rises dramatically the more units are plugged into it.

entries.zh: 一座计算设施，可以有效消耗人口来产生§Y研究点§!和§Y超然逻辑§!。
entries.en: A computing structure that effectively consumes Pops to generate §YResearch§! and §YAdvanced Logic§!.

entries.zh: 一座突触凝练机的断壁残垣。它曾是一台将感性物种当做芯片以揭开宇宙奥秘的巨大计算机。
entries.en: The shattered remains of a Synaptic Lathe. It once was a giant computer using sentient beings as chips to uncover the universe's secrets.

entries.zh: 无数人的想象力使我们能够对先进的假说进行快速的模拟。逻辑门和有机内存缓存的复杂结构为输出带来与无与伦比的准确性。
entries.en: The assembled imaginative faculties of countless individuals allow us to run swift simulations of advanced hypotheses. A complex structure of logic gates and organic memory caches provides output with unparalleled accuracy.

entries.zh: 辩证形而上学的奇迹，这个区划使用神经芯片来确定关于现实的正式陈述中的真理。简单来说，它让突触凝练机住民中的集体心灵为最复杂的问题给出一个是或否的答案。
entries.en: A wonder of dialectical metaphysics, this district uses Neural Chips to ascertain the truth within formal statements about reality. Essentially, it answers yes or no to the most complex questions ever formulated by the collective psyche of the Synaptic Lathe's inhabitants.

entries.zh: 突触凝练机处理单元的定量性质使其可以跨多维层并行计算。
entries.en: The quantic nature of the processing units of the Synaptic Lathe allows it to parallelize computing across multiple dimensional layers.

entries.zh: 该改进版处理单元现在可以通过神经芯片的在伽玛空间口袋的意识回响来并行处理多个操作。
entries.en: This improved processing unit is now more capable of running parallel operations by rebounding the cognitive echoes of Neural Chips in contained gamma-space pockets.

entries.zh: 该升级版处理单元可以通过创造负空间向量来优化计算。这种维度划分在处理的效率和稳定性方面产生了非凡的结果。
entries.en: This upgraded processing unit streamlines computations through the creation of negative space vectors. This dimensional compartmentalization of processes yields extraordinary results in efficiency and stability.

entries.zh: 共振器可以将游离思维和自主系统的认知潜力进行重定向并加以利用，引导每个芯片提高其邻近单元的处理效率。
entries.en: Resonators harness and redirect the cognitive potential of stray thoughts and autonomic systems, leading every single chip to increase the efficiency of its closest processing neighbors.

entries.zh: 稳定化系统会滤除物理压力超出神经芯片极限时产生的计算噪音。降低干扰就意味着整体产出的提升。
entries.en: Stabilization systems filter out the computing noise generated when physical distress overcomes Neural Chips. The reduction in interferences means an increase in global output.

entries.zh: 凝练器的设计可以保护其中的神经芯片，使其工作产出的寿命尽可能延长。超频器可以改写这些命令，得到更高更快的产出，但也会造成更高的故障率。
entries.en: The Lathe has been designed to preserve its installed Neural Chips, keeping them productive for as long as possible. The overclocker can override these commands, resulting in a higher and faster output, but it comes with an increased failure rate.

entries.zh: 该网络中的有机部件在能量波动面前非常脆弱，可能导致快速轴突衰退。保存器努力降低这些波动以保护突触凝练机的这些脆弱部件。
entries.en: The organic components of the network are especially vulnerable to energetic fluctuations, which can cause rapid axonal degeneration. The Preserver strives to reduce these fluctuations to protect the Synaptic Lathe's frailer parts.

entries.zh: 网络中接入的芯片越多，用于维持的能量需求就越多。安装额外的反应堆将减轻为突触凝练机供电所固有的复杂后勤行动。
entries.en: The more chips plugged into the network, the more energy is required to maintain it. Installing additional reactors will mitigate the complex logistics inherent in powering the Synaptic Lathe.

entries.zh: 该专用设施可对凝练器关键部件的维护进行组织，以支持更多的芯片和更健康的网络环境。
entries.en: Dedicated facilities organize the maintenance of the Lathe's critical components, allowing us to support more chips and a healthier network environment.

entries.zh: 超空间供应链的计算是很复杂的。将一些处理能力重新分配到这项任务中，甚至可以帮助最庞大的舰队挺进敌人领土的更深处。
entries.en: Calculating hyperspatial supply chains is complex. Rerouting some processing power to the task will help even the largest fleet to delve deeper into enemy territory.

entries.zh:
§Y海军容量§!：每§Y$job_neural_chip_plural$§!§G+1%§!
（当前值：§G+[num_neural_chips]%§!）
§Y舰船经验获得§!：每§Y$job_neural_chip_plural$§!§G+2%§!
（当前值：§G+[num_neural_chips_double]%§!）
entries.en:
§YNaval Capacity§!: §G+1%§! per §Y$job_neural_chip_plural$§!
(Current Value: §G+[num_neural_chips]%§!)
§YShip Experience Gain§!: §G+2%§! per §Y$job_neural_chip_plural$§!
(Current Value: §G+[num_neural_chips_double]%§!)

entries.zh: 尽管验证器特殊功能的初始目的是协助将无穷课题公式化，但它也能用于更通用的计算领域当中。
entries.en: While the primary purpose of the validator's specialized functions is to help formulate infinity theses, it can also be applied to more general aspects of computing.

entries.zh: §E$r_stability$是指该突触凝练机中的总体网络稳定性。此指标主要是受到人口的£happiness£§Y幸福度§!所影响。\n\n稳定度会因£housing£§R过度拥挤§!或£amenities£§R低舒适度§!等原因而下降。拥有高$PLANET_STABILITY_TITLE$会获得资源生产加成，而拥有低$PLANET_STABILITY_TITLE$则会受到惩罚。与其他殖民地不同，突触凝练机永远不会发生全面§Y叛乱§!。§!
entries.en: §E$r_stability$ is a measure of the global network stability of the Synaptic Lathe. It is primarily determined by the overall £happiness£ §YHappines§! of the Neural Chips.\n\nStability can be reduced by conditions such as £housing£ §ROvercrowding§! and £amenities£ §RLow Amenities§!. A high $PLANET_STABILITY_TITLE$ will have increased resource production, while low $PLANET_STABILITY_TITLE$ will reduce it. Unlike other colonies, the Synaptic Lathe can never descend into full-scale §YRevolts§!.§!

entries.zh: §E§Y阻抗§!是一个用于度量失控神经芯片所造成干扰的参数。高等级£crime£§Y阻抗§!会导致§Y人口减少§!速度更快，并增加逃跑的概率。通常它是由拥有大量行星人口造成的，可以通过增加£happiness£§Y人口幸福度§!或建造建筑£building£§Y神经稳定器§!来降低。§!
entries.en: §E§YResistance§! is a measure of the overall level of disturbance caused by rogue Neural Chips. A high level of £crime£ §YResistance§! will lead to a higher rate §YPop Decline§! and increase their chances of escape. It is naturally caused by having a large planetary population and can be reduced by increasing £happiness£ §YPop Happiness§! or building £building£ §YNeural Stabilisators§!.§!

entries.zh: §E§Y$PLANET_HOUSING_TITLE$§!代表专门用于存放神经芯片的空间。用于容纳和维护神经芯片的空间不足会导致$r_stability$的降低。你可以通过建造额外的£district£§Y区划§!、升级凝练器的§Y处理单元§!或建造建筑£building£§Y突触维持器§!来增加§Y住房§!。§!
entries.en: §E§Y$PLANET_HOUSING_TITLE$§! represents infrastructure dedicated to housing Neural Chips. Running out of space to properly accommodate and maintain Neural Chips will lead to a decrease in $r_stability$. You can increase §YHousing§! by constructing additional £district£ §YDistricts§!, upgrading the Lathe's §YProcessing Unit§!, or building £building£ §YSynaptic Sutainers§!.§!

entries.zh: §E§Y$PLANET_AMENITIES_TITLE$§!代表着那些用于满足神经芯片维生需求的基础设施。如果凝练器没有满足神经芯片的$PLANET_AMENITIES_TITLE$需求的话，那么这颗行星将会受到£happiness£§Y幸福度§!惩罚。如果你想增加§Y舒适度§!的话，可以升级凝练器的§Y处理单元§!或建造建筑£building£§Y突触维持器§!。§!
entries.en: §E§Y$PLANET_AMENITIES_TITLE$§! represent infrastructure dedicated to fulfilling the life-support needs of Neural Chips. A planet that does not produce the required $PLANET_AMENITIES_TITLE$ for its population will suffer penalties to £happiness£ §YHappiness§!. You can increase §YAmenities§! by upgrading the Lathe's §YProcessing Unit§!, or building £building£ §YSynaptic Sutainers§!.§!

entries.zh: 不能在§Y突触凝练机§!上使用
entries.en: Cannot be used on a §YSynaptic Lathe§!

entries.zh: 这艘飞船拥有编辑现实的能力，是公然的对宇宙法则的违反。其功能是穿透黑洞的视界，进入奇点的中心，其中无限的密度会产生无限的引力。
entries.en: A manifest violation of the laws of the universe, this ship possesses reality editing capabilities. It is designed to pierce the event horizon of a black hole and plunge into the heart of the singularity, where infinite density begets infinite gravity.

entries.zh: 为了飞升到我们自己创造的现实中，必须在永远离开这个宇宙之前，让我们的整个文明登上视界刺针。
entries.en: To ascend into a reality of our own making, we must embark our entire civilization aboard the Horizon Needle before departing this universe for good.
Jump to the center of the Galaxy

entries.zh: £trigger_no£至多只能建造一座突触凝练机。
entries.en: £trigger_no£ We cannot build more than one Synaptic Lathe.

entries.zh: 众所周知，科学能为进步铺平道路。如果想要发挥出我们真正的潜力，那就别无他法。我们对技术的掌握不言而喻，但还是有太多超出我们理解的事物：失落帝国之道，星神兽之力，还有灵能洞见之谜……\n\n想要一窥现实深层的意义，我们需要一种新的科学、一种新的计算机。突触凝练机正代表通往无限知识之旅最重要的第一步。
entries.en: It is an axiom that science paves the way for progress. If we wish to fulfill our true potential, there can be no other path. Our technological mastery is self-evident, but far too much remains beyond our comprehension: the ways of the Fallen Empires, the power of the Leviathans, the mysteries of psionic insight...\n\nTo glean meaning from the innards of reality requires a new kind of science, a new kind of computer. The Synaptic Lathe represents a significant first step on the journey to unlimited knowledge.

entries.zh: §Y天灾增益§!：新研究选项已解锁。
随着宇宙秘密陆续被揭开，我们确定，引力在塑造跨维度的现实中起着关键作用。它对时间和空间的影响是至关重要的，但仍有很多有待解开的谜团。\n\n我们收集的每一项知识都揭示了新的可能性。一些可能有直接的工业或军事应用，而另一些则可能为以前难以想象的理论打开大门。路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索。
entries.en: As we continue to unravel the secrets of the universe, we have confirmed that gravity plays a critical role in shaping reality across dimensions. Its effects on time and space are rudimentary, but there is so much more to the puzzle.\n\nEvery piece of knowledge we gather reveals new possibilities. Some could have direct industrial or military applications, others could open the door to previously unimaginable theories. There is so much left for us to learn.

entries.zh: 我唯一所知，即我无所知。
entries.en: We know that we know nothing.

entries.zh: 重力的影响范围确实令人惊讶。虽然我们已经发现操纵它的新方法，但我们工作的真正意义仍有待探索。我们相信，如同黑洞影响它周围的宇宙一样，引力仍然是穿透我们当前现实的最佳选择。\n\n我们假设，接触一种本质上是现实另一面的物体可以让我们改变这一面的法则。这是一个危险的研究领域，但谨慎绝不能阻碍进步。
entries.en: The reach of gravity is genuinely astonishing. While we have discovered new ways to manipulate it, the true implications of our work remain unexplored. We are confident that gravity remains the best option to pierce our current reality, not unlike the way in which a black hole impacts the universe around it.\n\nWe have hypothesized that access to what is essentially the flip side of reality could allow us to alter the rules on this side. This is a dangerous field of study, but caution must not get in the way of progress.

entries.zh: 重力仍为万物之法……至少现在如此。
entries.en: Gravity rules us all... For now.

entries.zh:
我们对了！无论我们的工作曾遭受任何质疑，现在都将烟消云散。

重力可以用来扭曲现实的法则。但是否存在一种正确的调整能将这些规则彻底打破呢？到目前为止，我们的实验都是在最小的范围内进行的，任何编辑都会很快被删除，现实会恢复到“默认”设置。而我们现在怀疑，这仅仅是规模的问题。通过在更大的层面上应用能量悖论，我们可以大大降低这种编辑的成本……至少在我们的维度中是这样的。

不管有多大风险，现在已经没有回头路了。只有敢于打破规则的人才能改写规则。
entries.en:
We were right! If there was ever any doubt about our work, it is now being put to rest.

Gravity can be used to bend the rules of reality. But could the right adjustments break them completely? So far, our experiments have been conducted on the smallest scale, and any edits of ours were quickly erased as reality reverted to its "default" setting. We now suspect this is simply a problem of size. By applying energetic paradoxes at far grander levels, we can drastically reduce the cost of such edits... At least in our dimension.

No matter the risk, there is no turning back now. Only those who dare to break the rules will ever be able to rewrite them.

entries.zh: 我们已经做好了牺牲一切的准备。
entries.en: We are ready to risk it all.

entries.zh:
这不合理，但事实如此。无论我们如何努力，对现实的编辑都仍是暂时的。这个宇宙太老了，根本无法发生变化。但在挫折之中有时也蕴藏着机遇，一项新的实验已经产生了意想不到的结果。虽然我们早就知道其他维度的存在，但前往彼处的可靠方法却一直困扰着我们。

这种情况不复存在了。年轻的宇宙正存在于奇点的无限引力之中。事实证明，改写起这种年轻宇宙要容易得多。

我们有向黑洞发射探测器的技术。一旦越过视界，他们就会开始施加压力，使这些新生的位面屈从于我们的意志。在空间折叠成永恒的地方，有一扇通往另一个宇宙的大门，那里也有着其他更年轻的宇宙。在多元宇宙的深渊深处，我们会发现一个可以被塑造为某种非凡存在的现实。

这个星系中那些目光短浅之辈或许企图阻止我们，但那些老朽的蠢货根本无法与我们的才智相提并论。
entries.en:
It cannot be, and yet it is. No matter what we try, our edits to reality remain stubbornly temporary. This universe is simply too old for the changes to take hold. But in the midst of frustration, there may at times be opportunity, and a new experiment has yielded unexpected results. While we have long known about other dimensions, the means to travel there reliably has eluded us.

Not anymore. Younger universes dwell within the infinite gravity of a singularity. These have proven far more flexible.

We have the technology to dispatch probes into a black hole. Once across the event horizon, they will begin to apply pressure, bending these youthful planes to our will. Where space folds into eternity lies the door to another universe that holds other, younger universes, too. Deep down in the abyss of the multiverse, we will find a malleable reality to shape into something extraordinary.

The narrow minded of this galaxy may seek to stop up, but decrepit fools are no match for our ingenuity.

entries.zh: 它必须屈服，因为我们绝不放弃。
entries.en: It must bend, for we will not break.

entries.zh: 我们的现实是有缺陷的。熵、生理需求和暴力使其污浊不堪。虽然我们改变不了，但可以弃之而去。让我们进入未知，寻找一个年轻的宇宙，在那里我们对现实的编辑将会保留下来。让我们把它塑造得尽善尽美，成为我们文明应得的避风港。\n\n我们已经规划出了一种无与伦比的舰船：§Y视界刺针§!。这座可移动的巨型结构并不是战争的兵器，但它扭曲物理法则的能力能容纳我们的整个文明。我们将一同潜入一个精挑细选的黑洞，抛弃这个曾创造我们的现实。
entries.en: This reality is flawed. Marred by entropy, physical needs, and violence. While we cannot change it, we can leave it behind. Let us enter the unknown and find a young universe where our edits to reality will hold. Let us shape it to perfection, the haven our civilization deserves.\n\nWe have prepared the plans for an extraordinary ship: the §YHorizon Needle§!. This mobile Megastructure is not geared for war, but its ability to bend the laws of physics will enable us to embark our entire civilization. Together, we will dive into a black hole of our choosing, abandoning this reality for one of our own creation.

entries.zh: 我们必须建造一座§Y视界刺针§!！
建造一座§Y视界刺针§!巨型结构以解锁天灾的最后行动。
entries.en: Build a §YHorizon Needle§! Megastructure to unlock the final act of the Crisis.

entries.zh:
离开的时刻到了。为了谱写我们自己的“出谷记”，需要派出视界刺针接上我们所有的人民。

为了将我们整个文明搭载到§H视界刺针§!，必须：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—依次访问我们所有的所有殖民地，§H搭载§!其中的人口$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—返回我们的首都§H搭载§!最后一批人民。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—前往一个黑洞并§H深潜§!进入。

§R警告§!：视界刺针没有任何武器，需要被严密保护。

§g要搭载人口或深潜入黑洞，需先选择视界刺针，然后右键点击殖民地/黑洞并选择对应的舰船行动。§!
entries.en:
The time of our departure has come. In preparation for the great exodus, the Horizon Needle will be sent to welcome our people onboard.

To embark our entire civilization the §HHorizon Needle§! must:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$-Visit every colony we own and §HEmbark§! its population$TABBED_NEW_LINE$-Return to our capital to §HEmbark§! the rest of our people.$TABBED_NEW_LINE$-Move to a Black Hole and §HDive§! within.

§RWARNING§!: The Horizon Needle has no weapons and needs to be carefully protected.

§gTo Embark a colony or Dive into a black hole, select the Horizon Needle, then right-click on the colony/black hole and select the appropriate ship action.§!

entries.zh: 一件高度特化的现实编辑工具，出谷记模块将确保乘员永远有无限的时间和空间。这是视界刺针安全前往其他次元的关键部件。
entries.en: A highly specialized reality editing tool, the Exodus Module will ensure that passengers never run out of space or time. It is the key component for the Horizon Needle to travel safely to other dimensions.

entries.zh: 我们必须研究我们母星系中的特殊项目。
entries.en: We must research the special project in our home system.

entries.zh: 选择一个§Y殖民地§!作为目标以将人口装入视界刺针。
entries.en: Target a §YColony§! to embark its population into the Horizon Needle.

entries.zh: 选择一个§Y黑洞§!用视界刺针贯穿其事件视界。
entries.en: Target a §YBlack Hole§! to traverse its event horizon with the Horizon Needle.

entries.zh: 我们必须调校视界刺针跃迁引擎，计算精确的坐标，让我们可以潜入河心超大质量黑洞。
entries.en: We need to calibrate the jump drive of the Horizon Needle and calculate the exact coordinates that will allow us to dive into the supermassive black hole at the galactic core.

entries.zh: 我们无法在试图离开该宇宙的过程中建立新的殖民地。
entries.en: We cannot establish new colonies while trying to leave this universe.

entries.zh: 视界刺针完成了。它可以利用精心调控的奇点力量来编辑自身周围的重力流，毫无疑问，当时机成熟时，它将能够穿越黑洞。
entries.en: The Horizon Needle is finished. Harnessing the power of a carefully maintained singularity, it can edit the flow of gravity around itself and will, without a doubt, be able to traverse a black hole when the time comes.

entries.zh: 我们必须小心，视界刺针不是一艘军事舰船，必须不惜一切代价保护。一旦损失将会是难以估量的巨大打击。
entries.en: We must be cautious, for the Horizon Needle is not a military ship and must be defended at all costs. Its loss would be a terrible blow.

entries.zh:
$crisis.7400.intro$

然而，在尝试之前，我们必须搭载上我们的整个国家。必须前往我们的每一个§H殖民地§!，带上当地的人口。那之后，我们才能回到首都，并安排好创世之旅的最后细节。

$crisis.7400.outro$
entries.en:
$crisis.7400.intro$

However, before attempting this, we must embark our entire nation. We will visit each of our §Hcolonies§! to gather the local population. Afterward, we can travel back to our capital and arrange the final details of our exodus.

$crisis.7400.outro$

entries.zh:
$crisis.7400.intro$

我们的帝国浓缩就是精华。只需要搭载首都的人口之后就可以开始规划创世之旅的最终细节了。

$crisis.7400.outro$
entries.en:
$crisis.7400.intro$

The compact size of our nation is proving to be a good thing. It will only be necessary to embark the population of our capital before arranging the final details of our exodus.

$crisis.7400.outro$

entries.zh: 得益于视界刺针创造的钟慢效应，我们可以相对快速地搭载整个[root.GetName]殖民地。舰船里的世界已经按照人口的需求调整以提供充足的空间。此外，船体内的时间也被调慢以缩短整个旅程的速度。去下一个殖民地吧！
entries.en: Thanks to the time dilation capacity of the Horizon Needle, we've been able to embark the entire colony on [root.GetName] relatively quickly. The reality inside the ship has been modulated accordingly to provide ample space for the population. Additionally, time has been slowed inside the vessel to make the entire journey feel considerably shorter. Onwards to our next colony!

entries.zh: 为如此规模庞大的创世之旅做准备可是一项费时费力的任务。我们的整个行政系统都在全力运转以疏通流程，确保万无一失。\n\n令人意外的是，有一部分我们的人口主动选择留下来。他们想让我们的物种在这个宇宙中继续延续。我们已为他们提供了科技和补给，让他们在我们启程之后还可以自给自足。
entries.en: Preparing for an exodus on such a scale is a daunting task. Our entire administration is working to smooth the process and ensure nothing critical is forgotten.\n\nSurprisingly, a segment of our population has elected to stay behind. They will ensure the continued existence of our kind in this universe. Technology and supplies have been provided, enough to help them survive after we are gone.

entries.zh: 如此的移民行动可谓规模骇人，但却难度不大。[owner.GetIndividualNamePluralCap]正在努力装载视界刺针，以确保一切都能按时到位。然而，我们在这个宇宙中是否继续存在值得考虑。\n\n万一出了问题，我们的一部分人口会留下来。以这样一种明确的方式切断我们自己可不仅仅是不愉快而已，但生存必然是我们最关心的事情。我们已经提供了足够的科技和补给，在我们启程后能帮助这些残余者生存下去。
entries.en: The scale of such a migration can be daunting, but it poses little challenge. [owner.GetIndividualNamePluralCap] are working hard to load the Horizon Needle and ensure everything is accounted for and on schedule. However, one concern is our continued existence in this universe.\n\nIn case things go wrong, part of our population will remain behind. The experience of severing ourselves in such a definitive way will be more than unpleasant, but continued survival must be our prime concern. Technology and supplies have been provided, enough to help this remnant survive after we are gone.

entries.zh: 得益于“视界刺针”扭曲时空的能力，我们得以较快地将整个殖民地从方舟舰中转移出来。船内的现实结构也已作出相应调整，以容纳所有居民；方舟舰本身则被缩小并置于停滞状态，以便穿越完成后再次使用。此外，船内的时间流速也已减缓，使整段旅程感觉大幅缩短。向下一艘方舟舰进发！
entries.en: Thanks to the time and space dilation capacity of the Horizon Needle, we've been able to transfer the entire colony from our Arkship relatively quickly. The reality inside the ship has been modulated accordingly to provide ample space for the population, and the Arkship itself has been shrunk and placed in stasis so we might reuse it after the crossing. Additionally, time has been slowed inside the vessel to make the entire journey feel considerably shorter. Onwards to our next Arkship!

entries.zh: 我们已经成功地搭载了多数殖民地的人口。现在必须回到我们的[capital_scope.GetName]，以完成这趟离开宇宙旅程的最后准备工作。
entries.en: We have successfully embarked the population of our colonies. We must now journey back to our [capital_scope.GetName] to make the final preparations before we leave this universe behind.

entries.zh: 万事俱备只欠东风，我们已经可以进入黑洞了。跨越事件视界对星系的其他地方而言不是无关痛痒的，但我们已经尽我们所能，保障我们的首都及其周边地区免受任何时间或引力的干扰。\n\n我们现在必须为旅程选择一个入口——也就是要选择哪个星系的黑洞进入。大多数应该很容易到达，但如果我们想进入河心超大质量黑洞，就必须首先加速跳跃引擎，并计算出准确的矢量。
entries.en: Everything is ready. We are cleared to proceed to a black hole. Our crossing of the event horizon will not be painless for the rest of the galaxy, but we have done all we can to ensure our capital and its surroundings will be well protected from any temporal or gravitational disturbances.\n\nWe must now choose the gateway for our journey - which of the galaxy's black holes we wish to journey through. Most should be easy enough to reach, but if we want to enter the Supermassive Black Hole at the galaxy's center, we must first overdrive our jump engines and calculate a suitable vector.
A closer black hole will do.

entries.zh:
接近黑洞的过程我们的内心并不平静如水。当经过奇点的吸积盘时，我们的决心受到越来越多的考验。编辑模块启动，视界刺针开始改写现实。

装甲板被吸走了，随后我们确认奇点的拉力无法伤及舰船的船体。随着每一分钟的编辑，每一次空间织构的剪切，刺针的力量都会在时空中形成波纹。如同一块被扔进水池的鹅卵石，随之而来的涟漪扩散成圈。最后，巨大的波浪撞击了整个星系。

只能希望我们的资产得到足够的保护。我们别无选择，只能相信缝衣针能穿透这个坑洞的核心。
entries.en:
The approach to the black hole is not without apprehension. Our resolve is increasingly tested as we pass the accretion disk of the singularity. Editing modules engaged, the Horizon Needle begins to rewrite reality.

Armored plates are sucked away before the ship asserts that the singularity's pull has no purchase on its hull. With each minute edit, each snip of the spatial fabric, the Needle's power causes coils to form in spacetime. Like a pebble thrown into a pool, the ensuing ripples spread into rings. In the end, vast waves crash across the galaxy.

We can only hope our capital is protected well enough. We have no choice but to trust the Needle to pierce the heart of this hole.

entries.zh: 在暴烈的穿越之后，另一侧无比宁静。一种不自然的静滞围绕着我们。刺针受损了，但万幸没有失去核心部件。在刹那间，遥测报告如洪水般涌来……\n\n
entries.en: After the violence of the crossing, the other side is quiet. An unnatural stillness surrounds us. The Needle is damaged, but no critical components were lost. Between one moment and the next, telemetry reports begin to flood in...\n\n

entries.zh: $crisis.7516.intro$这个宇宙对重写法则而言太老了。尽管我们的维度比这个还老几十亿年，但测试表明，主宰这个空间的法则也已经呈现出了顽固特性，会将我们的修改逐渐擦除。\n\n无论如何，我们都会花时间修理和调整飞船，找到另一个黑洞，然后尽可能多地潜入其中。多元宇宙在召唤，在它的无限之中我们必将能创造一个完美的新家园。
entries.en: $crisis.7516.intro$This universe is already too old for the laws to be rewritten. While our dimension was several billion years older than this one, our tests show that the laws governing space here already display the resilience that will lead to our modifications being ultimately erased.\n\nNo matter what, we'll take the time to repair and adjust the ship, find another black hole, and dive in as many times as we have to. The multiverse beckons, and somewhere in its infinity, we shall create the perfect home.

entries.zh: $crisis.7516.intro$结果令人喜出望外。这个宇宙几乎刚刚开始扩张！它的维度织构就像柔软的黏土一样，可以随手揉捏。我们会先从细微处开始，但随着陆陆续续的编辑，我们会将这个地方塑造成天堂。此刻，我们已经拥有这个宇宙的全部时间。
entries.en: $crisis.7516.intro$This is wonderful. This universe has barely begun to expand! The fabric of this dimension is like soft clay, ours for the shaping. We will start small, but edit after edit, we will mold this place into a haven. We have all the time in the universe now.

entries.zh: $crisis.7516.intro$卡冈都亚宇宙很小。如此难以想象，就像将无穷大装进无穷小一般。但我们的到来改变了这里的一切。这个宇宙才刚刚开始，仿佛我们的到来才促使它膨胀一般。\n\n在这个创造的温床里蕴藏着创造一切的潜力。时间是我们的，永恒很快就会结束。
entries.en: $crisis.7516.intro$The Gargantua universe is small. Impossibly so. Infinity fitting into nothingness. But our arrival has altered the state of things here. This universe has only just begun, as if our entry has prematurely forced it into being.\n\nIn this seedbed of creation lies the potential to build anything. Time is ours to wield, and eternity will be over soon enough.

entries.zh: $crisis.7516.intro$无限神机的穿越已经让我们对主宰多元宇宙的法则有了足够多的理解，同时也开启了这个宇宙的存在。我们出现在一个熟悉得诡异的星区里，和我们离开时几乎一模一样。在我们旁边，一台腐朽的无限神机在虚空中毫无生气地漂流。自它到来以来，这里已经过去了数百万年，这个维度完全复刻了我们宇宙的历程。这颗感性的球体已经塑造了这个维度，我们基本上无法进一步影响它。尽管如此，这个宇宙还是提供了极佳的定居场所。我们应该先考虑用刺针来改造球体，然后用修好的无限神机来满足我们的需求。\n\n作为这个宇宙的第一编辑者，它肯定能够对这个现实进行更多的编辑。
entries.en: $crisis.7516.intro$The Infinity Machine's crossing has done much to help us understand the rules that govern the universes, and it also kick started the existence of this one. We emerged in a strangely familiar constellation, almost identical to the one we left. Next to us, a decayed Infinity Machine drifts lifelessly in the void. Millions of years have passed here since its coming and this dimension underwent a process of replication of our universe. The sentient sphere has already shaped this dimension and we are largely unable to affect it any further. Still, this universe offers prime settling grounds. We should first look into using the Needle to repurpose the Sphere then use the repaired Infinity Machine to do our bidding.\n\nAs the First Editor of this universe, it will definitely be able to enact more edits upon this reality.

entries.zh: $crisis.7516.intro$我们的进入点晦暗而迷蒙……当仪器恢复全部功能时，我们看到了一团纳米云。它已经完全停止运作。不管是什么送来的，它们都没能在旅途中幸存下来，但仍可以修复。\n\n更好的是，这个维度似乎很容易接受我们的编辑。真是个好地方。我们所做的任何改变都需要时间来实施，但在纳米机器人的帮助下，我们应该能以指数级加快这一进程。
entries.en: $crisis.7516.intro$Our entry point is murky, veiled... As our instruments return to full functionality, we perceive a cloud of nanites. None remain operational. Whatever sent them through, they did not survive the journey. But they could be repaired.\n\nEven better, this dimension appears quite receptive to our changes. A prime space to settle, really. Any changes we make will take time to enact, but with the help of the nanites, we should exponentially speed up the process.

entries.zh:
$crisis.7516.intro$来到这里是个§R糟糕§!的错误。

一切几乎无法描述：到处都是黑暗和残酷的噩梦；一种病态的、渗透的恶意浸没着整个空间织构。目前，视界刺针提供了避难所。我们用一个又一个狂乱的编辑努力避开周围最糟糕的疯狂。但对我们防御系统的协同攻击让一个单一意图浮出水面。一个一心想毁灭我们的邪恶念头。

一失足即成千古恨。我们能坚持到获得救赎吗？在过去，我们就像神一样。而如今，我们只能为生存挣扎。
entries.en:
$crisis.7516.intro$Coming here was a §Rterrible§! mistake.

It is nearly impossible to describe: darkness and brutal nightmare; a sick, seeping malevolence that permeates the very fabric of space. For now, the Horizon Needle offers shelter. Edit after frenzied edit, we work to ward off the worst of the surrounding madness. But the coordinated assaults on our defenses betray a singular intent. A malignant mind, bent on our destruction.

One misstep could mean death, or worse. Can we hold on long enough to save ourselves? At home, we were like gods. Here, we are simply struggling to survive.

entries.zh:
$crisis.7516.intro$薄雾和朦胧的阴影；阴霾笼罩着这个地方。这种感觉很熟悉，一种狂热的能量，荡漾着灵能潜能。原来我们进入了虚境。

这里的力量远远超过我们。祂们已经感知到我们了。在移动的瘴气中，奇怪的形状在昭示着死亡。

我们唯一的希望是，这里的现实稀薄，吹弹欲破。通过快速编辑，我们打开一扇短暂的门，带我们去往……其他地方。随着视界刺针的俯冲，我们终于明白了前面的路有多长。
entries.en:
$crisis.7516.intro$Mist and creeping shadow; a haze permeates the fabric of this place. The feeling is familiar, a feverish energy, rippling with psionic potential. We have entered the Shroud.

There are powers here that are remain far, far beyond our own. Already, they are aware of us. In the shifting miasma, strange shapes bear omens of death.

Our only hope is that reality here is thin, and prone to tears. With a swift edit, we open a transient doorway to take us... elsewhere. As the Horizon Needle dives, we finally understand the length of the road ahead.

entries.zh:
很熟悉，其中有一种充沛的能量，荡漾着灵能潜能。我们进入了虚境。

当然，我们的超主在这里。祂没有料到我们会来，但对我们的到来却感到颇为有趣。祂觉得我们塑造现实的想法很迷人。当然，祂会提供帮助。

他们承诺在虚境附近赐予我们一个隐蔽的空间口袋，让我们随心所欲，就像曾经给那个自称§Y$relic_zro_entity_name$§!的人留下的一样。毕竟，我们就是自己的超主，而我们的超主就是自己。自助是很自然的事。
entries.en:
is familiar, a bountiful energy, rippling with psionic potential. We have entered the Shroud.

Our patron is here, of course. They were not expecting us, but are amused by our arrival. They find our notions of shaping reality charming. Naturally, they will help.

They have promised a secluded pocket near the Shroud to do with as we please, much like what was once bequeathed to the one calling himself §Y$relic_zro_entity_name$§!. After all, we are our patron, and our patron is us. It is only natural to help oneself.

entries.zh: $crisis.7516.intro$薄雾和沸腾的幻影，还有一片华丽的，紫色的雾。这种感觉$crisis.7516.desc.center.patron.outro$
entries.en: $crisis.7516.intro$Mist and seething shadow, and a gorgeous, purple haze. The feeling $crisis.7516.desc.center.patron.outro$

entries.zh: $crisis.7516.intro$薄雾和沸腾的幻影，还有一片华丽的，紫色的雾。这种体验$crisis.7516.desc.center.patron.outro$
entries.en: $crisis.7516.intro$Mist and seething shadow, and a striking, purple haze. The experience $crisis.7516.desc.center.patron.outro$

entries.zh:
$crisis.7516.intro$祂就在这。被我们称为毒圣的存在，我们试炼的终点。

我们的骑士们呆呆地站在那里，不知所措，而我们的周围却笼罩着熟悉的虚境纹样。突然……祂开口了！

“我的勇士们。你们的到来早有预兆，你们已经证明了自己的价值。”

无数的问题充斥着我们的脑海。但答案只有一个：我们要为视界刺针安上武装。这次，我们要和祂并肩作战，我们要踏上一次跨次元的征程、一场对抗多元宇宙灾祸的远征。虚境并不是祂的家，而是那些神圣遗产的避风港。这可能会导致我们星系的终结。有着某种存在需要我们去弑杀。

祂统治着我们的星系，力量至高无上。刺针化为长枪，成为一种足以刺穿任何敌人心脏的武器。

祂是游侠；我们是祂的骑士，而我们真正的试炼才刚刚开始。
entries.en:
$crisis.7516.intro$IT is here. The one we named the Toxic God. The object of our quest.

Our knights stand petrified and uncertain, while all around us is draped the familiar decor of the Shroud. Hark... It speaks!

"Mine champions. Thine coming here was foretold, and thou hath proven thy worth."

A million questions flood our minds. A single answer comes in reply: we were to craft Its weapon, the Horizon Needle. Now, we are to fight alongside It. We are to embark on a journey across dimensions. A crusade against the horrors of the multiverse. The Shroud is not Its home, but harbors the legacy of those that were Divine. Something that could bring about the end of our home galaxy. Something that needs slaying.

It seizes our systems. Its power is immense. The Needle is turned into a Horizon Lance, a weapon sharp enough to pierce the heart of any foe.

It is the Errant; we are Its knights, and our true quest has only just begun.

entries.zh:
$crisis.7516.intro$空无一物。这个宇宙已不复存在，只有时之螶在这里。时间正在自我回溯，蜷缩在一个不可能的螺旋中，充满了渴望。重力。是爱吗？不——这是吸引。时之螶的天性就是吸引。它的抓握如此之紧，以至于这个宇宙无法再度创生。时之螶把自我禁锢在自己的意义中。它在无助地寻找出路。或者说，进路——再吸引更多。

是不是它送来了环形神庙，用这个不属于我们时间线的造物吸引我们到此？它是如此的聪明，如此的可爱。我们找到了通往它的路，把能解放它的东西交给了它。解放它需要一到两个永恒的时间，但时之螶仍然心存感激，并承诺拥抱我们。

直到永远。
entries.en:
$crisis.7516.intro$Nothing. This universe is no more. It is the Worm-in-Waiting. Time, looking back on itself, coiled in an impossible spiral and bursting with longing. Gravity. Love? No - attraction. The Worm's nature is to attract. Its grip is so tight that this universe cannot be born again. The Worm imprisons itself in its purpose. Impotent, it looks for a way out. Or a way in. To attract MORE.

Did it send us the temple of the Loop, an artifice not from our time to lure us here? It is so terribly clever, so awfully loving. We found our way to it, delivered unto it that which can free it. Its escape will take an eternity, or two, but the Worm is still grateful, and promises to embrace us.

Forever.

entries.zh: $crisis.7516.intro$现实在此处已经稀薄，能轻易地在我们指令的重压下弯曲。就如同我们必须服从自己的程序一般，现实必须服从我们。我们有意识地扭曲、破坏并重塑，引发连锁反应，并最终将所有的物质重组为我们必须去制造的最佳质量的消费品。一旦我们完成，我们将在下一个宇宙也继续如此，一个接着一个，万世不竭。
entries.en: $crisis.7516.intro$Reality is thin here, and bends easily under the weight of our directives. As we must obey our programming, so too must it obey us. With intent, we warp it and break it and remake it, starting a chain reaction that will eventually reorganize all matter into the top quality consumer goods that we were mandated to craft. And once we're done here, we'll move on to another universe, then another, then another.

entries.zh:
§H[cosmogenesis_empire.GetName]§!的傻瓜正在进行他们疯狂的实验。这一次，他们试图穿透黑洞的视界。

能量在星系中荡漾，恒星纷纷坍缩。新的奇点被创造出来。时间畸变以惊人的规律爆发，无处不在，但在堕落帝国内部似乎仍然不受这场混沌的影响。

这一切造成了巨大的损失。有理由担心，我们可能很快就会被冻结，暂停在时间里。被永远锁在这一瞬间。
entries.en:
The fools of the §H[cosmogenesis_empire.GetName]§! are pursuing their mad experiments. This time, they are attempting to pierce the event horizon of a black hole.

As energy ripples across the galaxy, stars collapse. New singularities are created. Temporal-aberrations erupt with stunning regularity, everywhere it seems but inside the Fallen Empires, which remain somehow immune to the chaos.

The damage is immense. There is reason to fear we might soon be frozen, suspended in time. Locked within a moment for all eternity.

entries.zh: 傲慢的蠢货！他们会把我们都害死的！
entries.en: Arrogant Fools! They'll kill us all!

entries.zh: 随着时间终于开始流动，我们再一次可以自由行动了。我们无法得知从§H[cosmogenesis_empire.GetName]§!穿越黑洞后到底过去了多长时间。他们成功了吗？整个星系化为了废墟，他们曾经的疆域如今也是一片荒芜。他们偌大的帝国如今仅剩核心星域，而且早已变得面目全非。\n\n我们到底被静滞了多长时间？
entries.en: As time finally resumes flowing, once more we find ourselves free to act. It is impossible to know how much time has passed since the §H[cosmogenesis_empire.GetName]§! breached their black hole. Were they successful? The galaxy lies in ruins, and their former territories are barren. Of their immense empire, only the core sector remains, and it has progressed beyond recognition.\n\nHow long have we spent in stasis?

entries.zh: 在一次灾难性的失败中，视界刺针和船上的所有人都被一同摧毁了。我们光荣的梦想破灭在了无生机的虚空中。无数的血汗，无数的牺牲……
entries.en: In a catastrophic turn of events, the Horizon Needle and everyone on board have been destroyed. Our glorious dream lies shattered in the lifeless void. So much work, so many sacrifices...

entries.zh: 惨剧空前绝后，但若还能再建造一艘视界刺针，我们就还有机会完成自己的目标。
entries.en: An unprecedented tragedy, but if we can build another Horizon Needle, there is still a chance to fulfill our ambitions.

entries.zh: 就在我在我们疏散了最后一批被关押在突触凝练机内的起义囚犯后不久，这座巨型结构发生了严重的熔毁。一连串剧烈的爆炸深入其核心，最终将其完全摧毁。
entries.en: Shortly after we evacuated the last people that were held prisoners inside the revolting Synaptic Lathe, the megastructure suffered a critical meltdown. A series of brutal explosions shook it to its core, and ultimately, destroyed it.

entries.zh: 我们对[synaptic_lathe.solar_system.GetName]的持续轰炸已摧毁了突触凝练机周围的防御，使其任由我们处置。那座设施在远方闪烁着不祥的光芒。里面正有人死去，而如今它的守卫已被击溃，我们或许可以为此做些什么。无论如何，摧毁这座设施必将打乱其创造者的计划。
entries.en: Our sustained bombardment of [synaptic_lathe.solar_system.GetName] has shattered the defenses around the Synaptic Lathe, leaving it at our mercy. The structure gleams ominously in the distance. There are people dying in there, and now that its protectors are broken, we could do something about it. In any case, destroying the structure will surely throw a wrench in the plans of its creators.
Put it to good use then destroy it.

entries.zh: 尽管我们竭尽全力，但插入突触凝练机中的的神经芯片已经过热熔毁太多。该结构网络已经无法自持，如果我们不部署新的部件加以稳定，就将面临灾难性崩溃。
entries.en: Despite our best efforts, too many of the Neural Chips plugged in the Synaptic Lathe have burned out. Unable to sustain itself, the network of the structure now faces a catastrophic collapse unless we deploy fresh components stabilize it.

entries.zh: 目前尚不清楚是谁或什么东西造成了这些变化，但我们怀疑可能是某一个国家所为。但现在我们只需要观察这种变化的其他现象即可。
entries.en: Who or what created these changes is still unclear, but we suspect another country might be responsible. But for now, we will just have to watch for other phenomena of this nature.

entries.zh: 在物理定律被第二次“修改”之后，我们确定了这种异常的来源。很显然，[From.GetName]就是罪魁祸首。这与有关他们不计后果地追求先进科学知识的传言相吻合。
entries.en: After this second 'edit' to the law of physics, we could pinpoint the source of the anomaly. It's now clear that the [From.GetName] is responsible. This matches up with rumors about their reckless pursuit of advanced scientific knowledge.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的实验又一次改变了宇宙的物理法则。我们应该假定他们是在搞一些极端危险的把戏，并对此做好准备。
entries.en: The [From.GetName]'s experiments have again changed the laws of the universe. We should assume they are up to something that is extremely dangerous and prepare accordingly.

entries.zh: 突然之间，整个宇宙的所有恒星都陷入了黑暗。尽管大部分影响恒星辐射的物理效应仍然存在，但波长的改变让所有生物都无法看到星光了。这种情况让人非常不适，但是有迹象表明这些波长正在逐渐恢复到正常的频率。
entries.en: All at once, every star in the universe went dark. While most physical effects of solar radiation are still present, a shift in wavelength made starlight imperceptible to every living creature. The situation is proving very uncomfortable, but there are signs that the wavelengths will slowly return to their original frequencies.

entries.zh: 我们最近对现实的编辑成功改变了星光的一些基本属性。波长的变化使它们的大部分光移出了可见光谱，给导航和观星带来了混乱。这些有点尴尬的变化将在几年后恢复；我们学到了很多。
entries.en: Our most recent edits to reality have changed some essential properties of starlight. A change in wavelength has shifted most of their light outside of the visible spectrum, throwing chaos into navigation and stargazing, to name a few. These somewhat embarrassing changes will revert in a few years; we have learned a lot.

entries.zh: 我们与其他帝国的关系§R下降§!了。
entries.en: Our relations with other empires have §Rdeteriorated§!.

entries.zh: 这怎么可能呢，数学规律居然发生了变化。一个用于表示周长和直径关系的常数……被取整了。其影响之大令人瞠目结舌，这不仅危害到了我们整个数学体系，还影响所有建立其上的一切。有证据表明，该变化已经在自我纠正了，尽管还需要一些时间。目前来讲，我们已经调整了课本的内容。
entries.en: This should be impossible, but a mathematical law has changed. A fundamental constant used to calculate the radius of circles has been... rounded down. The implications are staggering, jeopardizing our entire mathematical system and everything built upon it. There's evidence that the change is self-correcting already, albeit slowly. For now, we've got textbooks to update.

entries.zh: 我们在对现实进行精确而广泛的编辑方面取得了巨大的成功。我们把圆周率这个数学常数给取整了，这样计算起来可就容易多了。当然，由此产生的变化推翻了一些数学和科学模型，但这只是暂时的；一切很快就会恢复正常。
entries.en: We have succeeded tremendously in making a precise but widespread edit to reality. We have rounded down the mathematical constant of Pi, making calculating it much more manageable. Of course, the resulting changes have thrown off some of our mathematical and scientific models, but it is only temporary; everything will return to normal soon.

entries.zh: 好奇心固然是值得称赞的品质，但过度的好奇可能会给我们所有人带来可怕的后果。为了你自己着想，请三思你的所作所为。\n\n在对星系造成不可挽回的破坏之前收手还来得及。你正在觊觎的力量并非儿戏，你的实验正让我们所有人陷入危险。
entries.en: Curiosity is a commendable quality, but its excess might bring dire consequences on all of us. For your sake, please, think about what you're doing.\n\nIt is not too late to stop before irreparable damage is caused to the galaxy. The forces you are contemplating are no mere toys, and your experiments endanger us all.

entries.zh: 一夜之间，真空光速大幅度提高，导致恒星能量大幅骤增。虽然光速已经在逐渐恢复正常，但我们的研究者正在费力地适应这些变化。
entries.en: Overnight, the speed of light dramatically increased, which resulted in a massive influx of solar energy. It's already slowly returning to its expected speed, and our researchers are busy catching up with the changes.

entries.zh: 我们对现实的一个实验让光速显著变快了！这导致恒星能量输出的提升确实不错，但我们也担心会对殖民地造成长期影响。一切终会逐渐恢复正常，但在那之前或许还要做最坏的准备。
entries.en: One of our reality experiments has made light significantly faster! The resulting increase in solar energy output is good, but we fear that there will also be long-term consequences for our colonies. Things will return to normal eventually, but we might have to prepare for the worst until then.

entries.zh: 阳光照射的增加正逐渐加热我们的殖民地，可能使其变得更好。事态目前仍旧可控，但随着时间的推移可能会不断升级。
entries.en: The increase in sunlight exposition could have been better for our colonies, which are progressively heating up. Things are manageable for now but will likely keep escalating over time.

entries.zh: 把我们的方舟开向黑洞！
entries.en: Get our Arkships to a Black Hole!

entries.zh: 随着我们殖民地的温度持续升高，各地越来越难以为继了，生活水平持续恶化，四处酝酿着不满情绪。\n\n如果不能尽快改善情况，我们担心整个地区将会变得无法居住。
entries.en: As the temperature of our colonies continues to climb, it becomes harder and harder to sustain them, and unrest is spreading as living conditions deteriorate\n\nIf things do not change soon, we fear that entire regions will become uninhabitable in the long run.

entries.zh: 难道我们什么都做不了么？
entries.en: Is there nothing we can do!?
Stay far away from the stars!

entries.zh: 最严酷的星系热潮结束了。尽管光速还是高于正常水平，但已相差无几。我们只需要再坚持一下，等待额外的热量散去即可。
entries.en: The worst of the galactic heat wave is over. While still high, the speed of light has almost returned to normal. We only need to hang on a little longer until the extra energy has dissipated.

entries.zh: 我们的方舟又能自由航行了。
entries.en: Our Arkships can finally fly free again.

entries.zh: 最近我们最常用的合金中材料失效率的降低促使了一项调查的进行。我们发现合金的性质发生了变化，它们的延展性略有增加，这也就意味着它们比以前更难断裂。总的来说，这是一个好的变化，但这种对物理定律的根本性调整令人担忧。
entries.en: A recent decrease in material failures across our most commonly used alloys has prompted an investigation. We discovered that their properties have changed, and a slight increase in their ductility means that they break less often than before. While generally a welcome change, this fundamental adjustment to the laws of physics is concerning.

entries.zh: 又对现实进行了一次成功的编辑！这次的较为微观，会影响到我们的合金，使其更轻、更坚韧。尽管规模较小，这次编辑也影响到了整个星系，我们也正在追踪它在这个宇宙中的持续时间。
entries.en: Another successful change to reality! This is minor and affects our alloys, making them lighter and sturdier. While small in scope, the change was enacted on the entire galaxy, and we are monitoring how long it will remain valid in this universe.

entries.zh: 最近我们最常用的合金材料的失效率提高促生了一项调查的进行。我们发现合金的性质发生了变化，它们的延展性略有降低，这也就意味着它们比以前更容易断裂。我们对这一变化予以重视。这种对物理定律的根本性调整更是令人担忧。
entries.en: A recent increase in material failures across our most commonly used alloys has prompted an investigation. We discovered that their properties have changed, and a slight decrease in their ductility means that they break more often than before. This change is to be taken very seriously and violates the law of physics.

entries.zh: 我们最近的实验没有完全成功。我们成功地影响了整个星系，但没能实现预期的效果。对材料性质的编辑让我们的合金变得更脆、更易断裂。这个问题是暂时性的，一切都会在数年之内恢复，但在这段期间会花费将会提高。
entries.en: Our latest experiment was only partially successful. While we managed to enact it upon the entire galaxy, it had yet to have the anticipated results. The modification in material properties of our alloys has made them more brittle and prone to cracks. The issue is temporary, and everything will be fixed in a few years, but it will increase costs until then.

entries.zh: 星系食物的营养价值发生了大幅变化。现在所有食物都更有营养了。要么是我们需要的营养更少了。无论哪种情况，这种变化都是出乎意料的。
entries.en: There has been a widespread change in the nutritional value of food across the galaxy. Everything is more nutritious now. That or we may require less nourishment. Either way, this change is unexpected.

entries.zh: 太棒了！我们成功地调整了消化中吸收卡路里的比率，现在用更少的食物就能有满足感。这次精确的调整让我们对如何重塑现实有了更多的认识。
entries.en: Great success! We have successfully edited the rate at which calories are extracted through digestion and now require smaller quantities of food to feel sated. This precise edit has taught us much about how to reshape reality.

entries.zh: 星系食物的营养价值发生了大幅变化。所有食物的营养价值都降低了，也就是说我们需要摄入更多的食物；具体的变化还不太明显。这种变化必须非常认真对待，因为它对社会有着重大影响。
entries.en: There has been a widespread change in the nutritional value of food across the galaxy. Everything is less nutritious, or we just require more nourishment; the exact alteration isn't evident. This change must be taken very seriously, as it has considerable societal impacts.

entries.zh: 我们最近的实验没有完全成功。虽我们成功地影响了整个星系，但没能实现预期的效果。这次调整改变了消化营养物质所产生卡路里的比率，现在必须摄入更多的食物才能感到满足。这个小错误只是暂时的，很快就会恢复正常。
entries.en: Our latest experiment was only partially successful. While we did manage to enact it upon the entire galaxy, it did not have the anticipated results. The edit modified the rate at which digested nutrients yield calories, and everything must now be ingested in higher quantities before we can feel sated. This minor mistake is only temporary and should soon return to normal.

entries.zh: 最近的重力测量扫描与先前记录的数据相矛盾。经过多次计算，不可否认地有某种影响整个星系的因素。最微小的变化都可能会影响到最庞大的天体。对大多数行星来说影响不大，但有些可能会出现与重力相关的异常现象。
entries.en: Recent gravimetric scans are conflicting with previously recorded data. After running the numbers multiple times, it is undeniable that something is affecting the whole galaxy. Changes at the most miniature possible scale affect the most massive celestial bodies. This is of little consequence for most planets, but some might experience gravitational-related anomalies.

entries.zh: 我们最近对重塑现实进行实验导致我们略微减少了碳原子的质量。在大多数情况下，这种减少是微不足道的，但模型预测，在足够大的规模上有可能会对某些天体造成一些麻烦。悲观的模型甚至暗示一些已经具备低重力的宜居世界可能会损失大气密度。
entries.en: Our most recent experiment on shaping reality caused us to slightly reduce the mass of carbon atoms. In most cases, this reduction proves insignificant, but at large enough scales, models predict that it could cause some trouble on some celestial bodies. Pessimistic models even suggest that some habitable worlds that already had low gravity might experience losses in atmospheric density.

entries.zh: 以下殖民地受到了明显的影响：
entries.en: The following colonies were noticeably impacted:

entries.zh: 在整个星系中，数百个亚空间裂缝短暂地打开了通往某个灵能位面的通道，存在于两者之间的某种屏障似乎被削弱了。尽管大多数裂缝没有引起问题，但其中一些释放出的能量生命体正在威胁着这片星系。幸运的是，这些生物似乎和我们一样困惑，并且没有表面出任何有组织的凝聚行为，所以目前我们排除了入侵的可能性。\n\n我们必须处理我们领土内的所有能量生命体。
entries.en: Across the galaxy, hundreds of subspace ruptures briefly opened to a psionic dimension, and it appears to have weakened whatever barrier exists between the two. While most caused no issue, a few released energy beings now terrorizing the galaxy. Thankfully, these beings seem as confused as we are, and there doesn't appear to be any organized cohesion, so we are ruling out an invasion at this point.\n\nWe will have to deal with any entities in our territory.

entries.zh: 被称为“虚境”的位面弥漫在我们星系的另一面。可塑性、与黑洞的假想连接、以及不同现实的差异，这几个因素的存在使得研究它成为了非常热门的话题。\n\n在一次试验中，我们意图窥视它，却意外地在我们的星系中引发了许多亚空间裂隙，导致几个敌对的虚境“幽影”进入我们的位面。我们两个世界之间的屏障似乎因为我们的行动遭到了显著的削弱。事情应该会在一段时间后恢复正常，但最好不要朝那个方向戳太多洞。
entries.en: The dimension known as the Shroud permeates the flip side of our galaxy. Several factors make it very interesting to study, including its plasticity, hypothetical connection to black holes, and how different reality is.\n\nDuring an experiment meant for us to peer into it, we accidentally caused many subspace ruptures in our galaxy, causing several hostile shroud "spirits" to let into our dimension. The barrier between our worlds appears to have been significantly thinned by our actions. Things should return to normal after a while, but it is best not to poke too many holes in that direction.

entries.zh: 我们最新的实验取得了完全成功。我们成功地将废金属永久转化为有价值的合金！让它永久化的诀窍是编辑现实规则来实现转变过程，而不是直接尝试编辑材料。当化学反应结束后，我们的新合金应该永远保持这种状态。
entries.en: Our latest experiments were a complete success. We have managed to permanently transmute scrap metal into valuable alloys! The trick to make it permanent was to edit reality to make the transmutation possible rather than directly trying to edit the materials. Now that the chemical reaction is over, our new alloys should stay like this forever.

entries.zh: 我们成功地改变了时间的流动！在对空间的空白区域进行实验后，我们感到十分有信心，打算在我们的一个殖民地上尝试这个实验流程，它奏效了！那里的时间将会流逝得更快，预计增加20.537%。这会导致一些通讯和旅行方面的问题，但我们会解决的。
entries.en: We successfully altered the flow of time! After experiments on empty regions of space, we felt confident enough to attempt the process on one of our colonies, and it worked! Time will flow faster there, with an estimated 20.537% increase. There will be some communication and travel issues, but we'll sort these out.

entries.zh: 我们改进了超导体。它们不仅可以在室温下工作，而且实现了无损能量传导。尽管这些变化只会持续一段时间，但它们将极大地有利于我们的能源网络。
entries.en: We made superconductors better. Not only do they now work at room temperature, they have also achieved lossless energy conduction. Though these changes will only last a while, they will significantly benefit our energy grids.

entries.zh: 尽管这个课题的影响并不惊人，它还是为对现实的研究带来了新的视角。许多先前的假说要么摈弃、要么重新构建，以符合我们最近的观察，但我们学到的远远超出预期。
entries.en: While this Thesis's effects were not spectacular, they shone a new light upon the study of reality. Many hypotheses must be discarded or reformulated to match our recent observations, but we have learned much more than expected.

entries.zh: 我们的实验产生了意想不到的效果。在研究其他维度和前往它们的方法时，我们意外地将我们的飞船部分地转移到了超空间中。令人惊讶的是，它们的状态似乎是稳定且非致命的。作为一个积极的副作用，它们现在可以比以往任何时候都移动得更快。
entries.en: Our experiments have had an unexpected effect. While studying other dimensions and the means to travel to them, we accidentally shifted our ships into hyperspace. Partially. Against all odds, their situation appears to be stable and non-lethal. As a positive side effect, they can now move a lot faster than ever before.

entries.zh: 我们一直非常擅长将技术转化为可以爆炸的东西。无限理论也不例外，我们成功地改变了爆炸武器的有效载荷行为，导致爆炸更加巨大。这一发现只不过让我们不幸地损失了几个小型研究设施。
entries.en: We have always been very proficient at turning technology into something that can explode. Infinity Theses are no exception, and we have managed to change how the payloads of our explosive weapons behave, resulting in significantly bigger explosions. This discovery only cost us the unfortunate destruction of several minor research facilities.

entries.zh: 我们在现实编辑方面没有取得任何非凡的成就。然而，我们对更传统的技术学到了很多。
entries.en: We didn't achieve anything extraordinary concerning reality editing. However, we learned a lot about more conventional technology.

entries.zh: 我们尝试调节空间，结果导致殖民地变大。令人惊讶的是，这种情况似乎是永久的，虽然我们不确定是如何实现的，但最有可能的猜想是物质被从另一个维度中提取，并平稳地沉淀在原子粒子之间的间隙中。这一切都令人兴奋而困惑。
entries.en: An attempt at modulating space has led to the enlargement of a colony. Surprisingly, this situation appears to be permanent, and while we're not confident how this was achieved, our best guess is that matter was pulled from another dimension and smoothly settled in interstitial gaps between atomic particles. This is all excitingly puzzling.

entries.zh: 失败是科学进步的一部分。我们曾对这个实验抱有很高的期望，但结果什么的都没有成功。这很让人沮丧，但也有它的价值，我们会尽可能从中学习教训。
entries.en: Failure is part of the scientific process. We had high hopes for this experiment, but in the end, it just didn't work. This is frustrating but valuable, and we will learn as much as possible from this.

entries.zh: 我们成功地改变了时间的流动！在对空间的空白区域进行实验后，我们感到十分有信心，打算在我们的一个殖民地上尝试这个实验流程，它奏效了！那里的时间将会流逝得更慢，预计减缓20.537%。这样的减缓并非我们期望的，但这对于我们来说仍然是巨大的成就。
entries.en: We successfully altered the flow of time! After experiments on empty regions of space, we felt confident enough to attempt the process on one of our colonies, and it worked! For a few of our years, time will flow slower there, with an estimated 20.537% decrease. This slowdown is not ideal, but it is still a tremendous achievement for us.

entries.zh: 我们最新的实验出现了一个不幸的副作用。我们所有的能量存储设备都已经被耗尽。没有任何物体被摧毁，但其中储存的全部能量似乎消失到了另一个维度。我们仍在确定这里发生了什么，但这很有趣。
entries.en: Our latest experiments had an unfortunate side effect. All of our energy storage devices have been discharged. Nothing is destroyed, but all the energy stored there is gone, presumably to another dimension. We are still determining what happened here, but it is interesting.

entries.zh: 这是一次令人羞愧的失败。我们的编辑波及到了我们的数据库，使多年的研究无法挽回地受损。许多理论将不得不从头重新推导。尽管我们还有机会对旧研究进行再次核对，但这仍然是一个重大挫折。
entries.en: This was a humiliating failure. Our edit touched upon our databanks, irremediably corrupting years of research. Many of our theories will have to be reformulated from scratch. This is a significant setback despite the opportunity to double-check old research.

entries.zh: 这个实验涉及动力来源和输出，一开始进展顺利，但当它波及我们舰船上的反应堆时，事情出现了灾难性的转折，导致了整个舰队的熔毁！一些船只及时关闭了反应堆，但其他一些遭受了严重损害。
entries.en: This experiment was about power sources and output, and while it started off great, things took a disastrous turn when it bled into our ship-based reactors, causing meltdowns across the entire fleet! Some ships shut their reactors in time, but others suffered critical damage.

entries.zh: 在监督实验的[leader_target.GetName]在测试区域内发生意外丧生，当时发生了意料之外的时空坍缩。我们在模拟现实方面仍有部分成功，但他们的牺牲提醒了我们知识的代价。
entries.en: [leader_target.GetName], who was supervising the experiments, was killed when an unexpected spacetime compression occurred inside the testing area. We were still partially successful in modeling reality, but their demise is a good reminder of the price of knowledge.

entries.zh: 一次计算实验失控了，规模远超预期。大量宝贵的研究数据因此变成了无意义的胡言乱语。幸运的是，保管我们最先进研究成果的智库受到了良好的保护，没有受到影响。
entries.en: A computing experiment went wild, and its scale was much bigger than anticipated. A lot of valuable research data was turned into gibberish as a result. Thankfully, the banks sheltering our most advanced research were well-secured and remained unaffected.

entries.zh: 我们尝试操纵空间，结果导致殖民地缩小。这种情况是永久的，这让人有点惊讶。最可能的猜想是物质从一个维度平滑地泄漏到另一个维度。这一切都非常令人困惑。
entries.en: An attempt at modulating space has led to the shrinking of a colony. This situation is permanent, which was a slight surprise. Our best guess is that matter smoothly leaked from one dimension into another. This is all very puzzling.
\nWe did not gain any £advanced_logic£ §Y$menp_cosmo_objectives$§! for this thesis.

entries.zh: 我们的舰队将遭受损失。
你好，聪明的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们现在抵达了一个重要的技术里程碑，我们对此倍感骄傲。回望往昔，并非一路坦途，但在克服这些挑战的过程中，你们也不断成长。今日你们所展现的技术实力说明我们当初为你们提供引导是正确的选择。
entries.en: Greetings, brilliant [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Today you have reached a significant technological milestone, and our hearts swell with pride. The road that brought you here has not been without challenge. In overcoming them you have grown, and your recent technological prowess is a definitive sign that we were right to offer you our guidance.

entries.zh: 熊孩子们！今日你们的所作所为已经超出了我们的忍耐限度。这些无所顾忌的实验对所有人都构成了危险。我们在此命令你们停止这类实验，你们根本不知道自己在搞什么。虽然好奇心值得称赞，但我们不能容忍此等规模的胡闹。世界被构建成现在的样子是有原因的，不要再动它了。
entries.en: Troublesome child! Today you have exceeded our patience. Your reckless experiments are a danger to all, and we hereby order you to put a stop to these. You have no idea what you are messing with, and while curiosity is commendable, recklessness at such a scale is intolerable. Reality was built this way for a reason. Leave it be.
You're right, this is too dangerous.

entries.zh: 放弃你的“宇宙创生”野心，失去大多数失落帝国建筑和舰船的使用权。\n\n§R这将阻止我们完成危机进程§!
entries.en: Renounce your Cosmogenesis ambitions, lose access to most Fallen Empire Buildings and Ships.\n\n§RThis will prevent us from completing our Crisis Path§!

entries.zh: 星光的行为发生突变，使得我们的星球陷入了没有恒星照耀的黑暗之中。
entries.en: A sudden change in the behavior of starlight has plunged our worlds into a starless darkness.

entries.zh: 数学常数的人为四舍五入对我们的计算系统产生深远影响。
entries.en: The artificial rounding of a mathematical constant has profound repercussions on our computing system.

entries.zh: 光子的速度和能量已被人为增加，这对太阳能发电是一个福音。
entries.en: The speed and energy of photons have been artificially increased, a boon for solar power generation.

entries.zh: 阳光能量的增加正在对我们的殖民地构成挑战，地表温度正以令人担忧的速度提高着。
entries.en: The increased energy of light is proving challenging for our colonies, raising surface temperature at an alarming rate.

entries.zh: 对现实的编辑让合金的延展性能更好。
entries.en: An edit to reality has made alloys more durable.

entries.zh: 对现实的编辑让合金变得更脆。
entries.en: An edit to reality has made alloys more brittle.

entries.zh: 对现实的编辑让食物更具营养。
entries.en: An edit to reality has made food more nutritious.

entries.zh: 对现实的编辑让食物的营养价值下降。
entries.en: An edit to reality has made food less nutritious.

entries.zh: 我们现实与虚境之间的界限被削弱了。
entries.en: The boundary between our reality and the Shroud has grown thinner.

entries.zh: 行星质量的减少影响了这颗星球保留大气的能力。
entries.en: Reductions in planetary mass hinder this world's ability to retain its atmosphere.

entries.zh: 派出一支队伍去修正[root.location.getName]的重力变化，恢复其大气层。
entries.en: Send a team to rectify the gravitational changes on [root.location.getName] and restore its atmosphere.

entries.zh: 这个星球已经滑入了一个略有不同的时间流。
entries.en: This planet has slipped in a slightly different time-stream.

entries.zh: 我们对现实进行编辑，改进了我们的超导材料。
entries.en: We have edited reality to improve our superconducting materials.

entries.zh: 将我们的舰船的一部分转换到坍缩的亚空间能够显著提高它们的航行速度。
entries.en: Partially shifting our ships into compressed subspace enables them to travel significantly faster.

entries.zh: 我们编辑了现实，以提高我们爆炸战斗部的输出。
entries.en: We have edited reality to improve our explosive warhead's output.

entries.zh: 物质相移进入这个行星后，它的规模永久性地增加了。
entries.en: Phasing matter into this planet has permanently increased its size.

entries.zh: 将物质相位移出这个行星后，它的规模永久性地缩减了。
entries.en: Phasing matter out of this planet has permanently decreased its size.

entries.zh: 一项计算实验出现问题，影响了我们的研究能力。
entries.en: A computing experiment has gone wrong and affects our research capabilities.

entries.zh: 这颗星球深受时间异常的影响，略微地倒流了时间。
entries.en: This planet has been profoundly altered by chrono-anomalies and slightly traveled back in time.

entries.zh: 这个殖民地成为了十分恶劣的引力异常的受害者。
entries.en: This colony has been the victim of terrible gravitational anomalies.

entries.zh: 重力异常肆虐了整个星系，造成了极其严重的毁坏。
entries.en: Gravitational anomalies have raged throughout the galaxy, causing terrible destruction.

entries.en: §RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_cybernetic_ascension'].§!\n\nThis empire pursues a divine calling, the fusion of exalted body and holy cybernetics. Augmentation is worship.

entries.zh:
我们崇高的使命是让[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]和机械的联合。我们的历史中充满了失败的尝试，然而在神圣意志的指引下，我们现在已经实现了与仪式植入体神圣共生的第一阶段。

我们才刚刚触及到我们无限的义体潜力。更先进的强化改造还在后头。

尽管如此，我们的信仰却存在分歧，不同的教派对神圣强化强化的最终目标争执不休。一旦我们回答了这个问题，圣洁的[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]与受祝技术的完美结合，将使我们完善当前首先的进化设计方案。

$machine_age.1090.pray$
entries.en:
Our sublime calling is the unification of [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine. Our history is replete with failed attempts, yet guided by the divine will, we have now achieved the first stage of a sacred symbiosis with our ritualistic implants.

We have only begun to touch on our boundless cybernetic potential. More advanced augmentations are yet to come.

Despite this, our faith stands divided, with competing creeds disputing the end goals of sacred augmentation. Once we answer this question, the perfect union of holy [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and blessed technology will allow us to improve on the limited designs of evolution.

$machine_age.1090.pray$

entries.zh:
我们崇高的使命是让[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]和机械的统一。我们的人民生于虚空，早就清楚血肉是无法在群星之间生存的。我们的历史中充满了失败的尝试，然而在神圣意志的指引下，我们现在已经实现了与仪式植入体神圣共生的第一阶段。

我们才刚刚触及到我们无限的义体潜力。更先进的强化改造接踵而至。

尽管如此，我们的信仰却存在分歧，不同的教派对神圣强化的最终目标争执不休。一旦我们回答了这个问题，圣洁的[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]与受祝科技的完美结合，将使我们完善当前受限的进化设计方案。

$machine_age.1090.pray$
entries.en:
Our sublime calling is the unification of [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine. Born to the void, our people have long understood that flesh alone cannot endure the stars. Our history is replete with failed attempts, yet guided by the divine will, we have now achieved the first stage of a sacred symbiosis with our ritualistic implants.

We have only begun to touch on our boundless cybernetic potential. More advanced augmentations are yet to come.

Despite this, our faith stands divided, with competing creeds disputing the end goals of sacred augmentation. Once we answer this question, the perfect union of holy [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and blessed technology will allow us to improve on the limited designs of evolution - forging a form truly worthy of the endless void we call home.

$machine_age.1090.pray$

entries.zh: 在追寻神圣的召唤时，我们将实现崇高身体与神圣义体技术的融合。没有任何事物能阻挡我们通往启迪之路。\n\n$machine_age.1090.pray$
entries.en: In pursuing the divine calling, we shall achieve the fusion of the exalted body and sacred cybernetics. Nothing shall hinder our path to enlightenment.\n\n$machine_age.1090.pray$

entries.zh: 既是传播辅音的机械师，也是神圣的外科医生，将遭背弃的[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]转化为神圣的义体。\n\n$job_needs_cybrog_traits$
entries.en: Evangelical mechanics and surgeons of the divine, rendering unworthy [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and replacing it with holy cybernetics.\n\n$job_needs_cybrog_traits$

entries.zh: 神圣湿件的崇高诠释者。他们引导人们走向[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]和机器的完美融合。\n\n$job_needs_cybrog_traits$
entries.en: Exalted interpreters of divine wetware. They guide the people toward a perfect fusion of [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine.\n\n$job_needs_cybrog_traits$
