entries.zh: 巨锤之使团利用神圣强化改造来创造信徒所需的一切。
entries.en: The Fellowship of the Hammer's uses divine augmentation to create everything the faithful need.

entries.zh: 钢铁之圣卫的神圣强化改造让我们神圣勇士在战斗中锐不可当。
entries.en: The divine augmentations of the Templars of Steel make our holy warriors unstoppable in battle.

entries.zh: 思想之诗颂的半互联意识允许研究者之间进行瞬时沟通。
entries.en: The Choir of the Mind's semi-interlinked consciousness allows instant communication between researchers.

entries.zh: 劳力之结社的神圣强化改造在各个方面都超越了传统的工具。
entries.en: The Commune of Toil's divine augmentations surpass traditional tools in every respect.

entries.zh: 信徒们自豪地佩戴着这些植入物。他们对神明的虔诚激励着所有人。
entries.en: The faithful proudly adorn these implants. Their dedication to the divine is an inspiration to all.

entries.zh: 愚蠢的孩子，你声称了解神圣，却亵渎了你的[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]。要知道我们是[contact_empire.GetName]，这个星系的被选之民。不要让你们不洁的身体触碰我们的圣地，否则就准备迎接迅速的毁灭。
entries.en: Foolish child, you claim to know the divine, yet you defile your [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]. Know we are the [contact_empire.GetName], the chosen people of this galaxy. Keep your impure bodies off our holy places, or expect swift destruction.

entries.zh: 我们是[contact_empire.GetName]，这个星系中被选中的人民。几个世纪以来，我们忽视了次等物种的精神需求。你和你们的不纯净容器就是我们错误的一个典型例子。接受我们的教义，皈依，否则就会被碾成尘埃。
entries.en: We are the [contact_empire.GetName], the chosen people of this galaxy. For centuries, we have neglected the spiritual needs of lesser species. You and your impure vessels are a prime example of our error. Accept our doctrines, convert, or be ground to dust.

entries.zh: 信徒们已为所有人揭示了义体技术的奥秘。然而，今天标志着我们旅程的开始，我们现在必须全心全意接纳神圣的融合。
entries.en: The faithful have unveiled the secrets of cybernetics for all. However, today marks the commencement of our journey, as we must now wholeheartedly embrace the divine fusion.

entries.zh: 我们必须采纳['tradition_category:tradition_cybernetics']传统树才能开启神圣融合。
entries.en: We must adopt the ['tradition_category:tradition_cybernetics'] tradition tree to start the divine fusion.

entries.zh: 在整个历史过进程，我们曾误导性地试图改良我们的[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]，却不幸地给众多神圣的承载体带来了无法修复的伤害，导致不同信条对神圣融合的解释产生冲突。\n\n随着科技最终实现了完全强化改造，我们信仰中的神圣领袖——科技显圣师们，已召开了一次主教大会以确立我们教会的核心原则，将各种信条融合成一个统一的教义。
entries.en: Throughout history, our misguided attempts to augment our [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] have irreparably lacerated numerous divine vessels, leading to conflicting interpretations of the divine fusion among different creeds.\n\nAs technology finally enables full augmentation, the holy leaders of our faith, the Technophants, have convened a Conclave. Its purpose is to establish the core principles of our church, merging the individual creeds into a unified dogma.

entries.zh: 科技显圣主教团的形成曲折艰难，每个最重要的信条都要求在主教团中获得代表权。经过一番深思熟虑，§Y$CYBERCREED_construction$§!、§Y$CYBERCREED_war$§!、§Y$CYBERCREED_research$§!和§Y$CYBERCREED_labor$§!受邀参加。\n\n主教团现在怀着坚定的信念着手他们神圣的任务。他们的第一道法令要求普通民众增加什一税或履行强制性社区服务。
entries.en: Forming the Conclave of Technophants was arduous, with each of the most important creeds demanding representation in the Conclave. After some deliberation, §Y$CYBERCREED_construction$§!, §Y$CYBERCREED_war$§!, §Y$CYBERCREED_research$§!, and §Y$CYBERCREED_labor$§! were all invited.\n\nThe Conclave now approaches their divine task with fiery conviction. Their first decree demands increased tithes or mandated community service from the general population.

entries.zh: 我们必须选择如何支持主教团。
entries.en: We must choose how to support the Conclave.

entries.zh: 在这个局势中将有多个应对方案可用。
entries.en: More approach options will become available in the situation.

entries.zh: 科技显圣主教团的第二项法令呼吁正式确立信仰。长久以来，各种教派之间的差异在我们社会中造成了摩擦。\n\n主要教派都提出了自己统一信仰的令人信服的理由，而更温和的声音则主张应采纳一条真正开放和包容的道路。
entries.en: The second decree of the Conclave of Technophant is a call to formalize the faith. For too long, the differences between the various creeds have caused friction in our society.\n\nThe major creeds all make a compelling case for a unified faith, while more moderate voices argue for a truly open and inclusive path.

entries.zh: 巨锤之使团能铸就一个更为开明的未来。
entries.en: The Fellowship of the Hammer shall build a brighter future.
The dogma will form around the §Y$CYBERCREED_construction$§!. $machine_age.1010.shared.tooltip$
The Templars of Steel will protect our [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed].
The dogma will form around the creed of §Y$CYBERCREED_war$§!.\n$machine_age.1010.shared.tooltip$

entries.zh: 思想之诗颂能唱响进步之香颂。
entries.en: The Choir of the Mind will sing of progress.
The dogma will form around the creed of §Y$CYBERCREED_research$§!.\n$machine_age.1010.shared.tooltip$

entries.zh: 劳力之结社能赋予我们的工人以意义。
entries.en: The Commune of Toil will give our workers meaning.
The dogma will form around the creed of §Y$CYBERCREED_labor$§!.\n$machine_age.1010.shared.tooltip$

entries.zh: 我们应当终结这些分歧的教条。
entries.en: We should end these divisive dogmas.

entries.zh: 通过改革将各个教派整合为§Y$pft_cyber_creed_general$§!，让每个虔诚的承载体都能得到义体改造。\n$machine_age.1010.shared.tooltip$
entries.en: The creeds shall be reformed into §Y$pft_cyber_creed_general$§!, allowing every faithful vessel to be modified.\n$machine_age.1010.shared.tooltip$

entries.zh: 所有与其他教派相关联的建筑都将被替换为§Y寺庙§!。\n该教派将会成为唯一的§Y唯心主义派系§!。\n§Y非唯心主义§!思潮的派系将被允许生成。
entries.en: All buildings associated with the other Creeds will be replaced with §YTemples§!.\nThis creed will remain as the only §YSpiritualist Faction§!.\nFactions belonging to §YNon-Spiritualist§! Ethics will be allowed to form.

entries.zh: 选择§Y[GetCyberCreed]§!后，其他教派的信众提出抗议。许多人认为主教团的所作所为背叛了“真正”的信仰。\n\n$machine_age.1020.both$
entries.en: After choosing §Y[GetCyberCreed]§!, the other creeds protested. Many believe the Conclave has turned against the 'true' faith. \n\n$machine_age.1020.both$

entries.zh: 各教派的信众正在抗议，声称主教团拒绝了真信。\n\n$machine_age.1020.both$
entries.en: The creeds are protesting, claiming that the Conclave has rejected the faith.\n\n$machine_age.1020.both$

entries.zh: 到目前为止，抗议活动虽然如火如荼，但整体保持平和。只有时间才能告诉我们，这些火花是否会最终引发骚乱的火灾。\n\n不管接下来会发生什么，我们必须决定其他教派的命运。有人呼吁明确地将他们开除教籍，将他们的教义定性为邪教，并以他们造成的骚乱为证据指控他们叛教。另一些人则认为，仁慈才是前进的道路，他们呼吁我们对我们信仰中失去方向的成员表现出宽容。
entries.en: So far, the protests have been heated but peaceful. Only time will tell whether these sparks will result in flames.\n\nWhatever comes next, we must decide the fate of the other creeds. Some have called for outright ex-communication, labeling their dogma heresy, and the turmoil they have caused good evidence of their blasphemy. Others believe mercy is the way forward, asking us to show tolerance towards the misguided members of our faith.

entries.zh: 必须只有唯一的真信留存。
entries.en: There can only be one faith.

entries.zh: 科技显圣师会镇压其他信条的信众，这会导致不满。
entries.en: The Technophants will suppress the other creeds, which may lead to unrest.

entries.zh: 我们的信仰能够海纳百川。
entries.en: Our faith has room for all.

entries.zh: 尽管我们树立了官方教义，但科技显圣师们对其他教派的习俗保持宽容态度。
entries.en: While there will be official dogma, the Technophants will tolerate the practices of other creeds.

entries.zh: 各殖民地上都爆发了信仰少数派群体的抗议，许多人指责我们偏离了神圣融合的正道。科技显圣师们则认为，这场动乱只是暂时的，因为我们大多数人仍支持统一的教义；这一切只是时间问题，假以时日更狂热的抗议者也会接受神圣的真理。
entries.en: Minority protests have erupted across our colonies, with many decrying what they view as our deviation from holy fusion. The Technophants believe the unrest is only temporary, as most of our people support the unified dogma, and it is simply a matter of time before the more zealous protesters accept the divine truth.

entries.zh: 必须只有唯一的真信留存。
entries.en: There will only be one faith.

entries.zh: 选择镇压其他信条的信众会导致不满。
entries.en: The choice to suppress competing creeds has led to some unrest.

entries.zh: 信奉统一教义已经在民众中传开，绝大多数各类教派的信众都抛弃了旧有的信仰和生活方式。\n\n除了真正的狂热分子外，每个人都在为最后的转变准备他们的神圣[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]。
entries.en: Dedication to unified dogma has spread among the people, with most practitioners of the various creeds having disavowed their old ways.\n\nEveryone apart from the true fanatics are preparing their divine [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] for the final transformation.

entries.zh: 我们神圣融合的真义终将胜利。
entries.en: The truth of our divine fusion prevails.
We have successfully unified the faith.

entries.zh: 允许各种教派的教众自由表达是最和谐的选择：只有少数抗议声出现，只有最狂热的信仰成员尚且参与其中。\n\n大多数信徒遵循我们的官方教义，我们准备集中精力于神圣的融合。
entries.en: Allowing the various creeds freedom of expression was a most harmonious choice: only minor protests have been noted, with only the most zealous members of the creeds participating.\n\nWith the majority of the faithful following our official dogma, we are ready to focus on the divine fusion.

entries.zh: 我们是一个不会分裂的信仰。
对不同教条流派实行宽容态度会阻止不满的滋生。
entries.en: The tolerance granted to the differing creeds has prevented unrest.

entries.zh: 迁就极端主义的要求已经惹恼了大多数温和派。许多人认为，每个信条教派都有长期的宗教间暴力历史，让边缘信仰不受反对是错误的选择。\n\n大多数人呼吁正式改革各信仰，实质性地消除它们原本应享有的所有独立性。
entries.en: Giving in to hardline demands has upset the majority of moderates. Claiming every creed has a long history of interfaith violence, many believe that allowing fringe beliefs to go unopposed was the wrong choice.\n\nThe majority are calling for the creeds to be officially reformed, effectively removing any independence they would otherwise have.

entries.zh: 宽容其他教派已经使我们信仰中的温和派系不满，引起不满。
entries.en: The tolerance granted to the creeds has upset the more moderate factions of our faith, causing unrest.

entries.zh: 真信将吸收不同的教派，并消除它们之间的琐碎教义争议。
entries.en: The faith will absorb the differing creeds and sever their petty doctrinal disputes.

entries.zh:
随着盛大的融合临近，我们回顾信仰中悠久的传统：时间的什一奉献。

回顾过往无数代先祖，社会中每位忠诚的成员都奉献出他们的一部分时间和精力给教会。就如神圣的融合一样，这种奉献有助于强化信仰的身体。

这些信徒应该如何最好地支持神圣强化改造呢？
entries.en:
As the grand fusion draws near, we look back to a long-standing tradition of the faith: The Tithe of Time.

For countless generations, every faithful member of society has given a portion of their time and energy to the church. Like divine fusion, this service act helps strengthen the body of the faith.

How shall the faithful best support the divine augmentation?

entries.zh: 每年，我们人群中的信徒会抽出一部分时间
entries.en: Each year, the faithful among our population will dedicate a portion of their time
$machine_age.1070.intro$ to constructing buildings and working in shipyards.
$machine_age.1070.intro$ to researching the secrets of the universe.

entries.zh: 神圣融合之时终于到来了。\n\n我们应在自己的星球上建立神圣的§Y$building_augmentation_center$§!，以开始这一进程。
entries.en: The time for the divine fusion is finally upon us.\n\nIt is time for us to construct holy §Y$building_augmentation_center$s§! on our worlds, and the process can begin.

entries.zh:
信徒们的全面义体强化改造已经开始。主教团的其他一切行动将暂停，直到神圣的融合完成。

§R行动要求：§!
建造一座$building_augmentation_center$以让§Y$situation_cybernetic_creed_cyberization$§!局势继续进行。
entries.en:
Full cybernetic augmentation has begun for the faithful. All other actions of the Conclave will halt until the divine fusion is complete.

§RAction required:§!
Build an $building_augmentation_center$ to resume the §Y$situation_cybernetic_creed_cyberization$§! situation.

entries.zh: 随着神圣旅程的完成，我们的血肉之躯终于实现了机械和[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]的圣洁融合。对于信徒来说，最后一步是安装神圣的强化件。
entries.en: As we complete the divine journey, our vessels finally achieve the holy fusion of machine and [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]. The one final step for the faithful is the installation of holy augments.

entries.zh:
$machine_age.1090.desc$§Y$CYBERCREED_construction$§!要求我们的躯体成为神圣的工具。

$machine_age.govswapnotice$

$machine_age.1090.pray$
entries.en:
$machine_age.1090.desc$ §Y$CYBERCREED_construction$§! demands that our bodies become divine tools.

$machine_age.govswapnotice$

$machine_age.1090.pray$

$machine_age.1090.desc$ §Y$CYBERCREED_war$§! demands the faithful be made into holy weapons.

$machine_age.govswapnotice$

$machine_age.1090.desc$§Y$CYBERCREED_research$§!将要利用一部分网络互联的人群解锁宇宙的奥秘。

$machine_age.govswapnotice$

$machine_age.1090.pray$
entries.en:
$machine_age.1090.desc$ §Y$CYBERCREED_research$§! will unlock the universe's secrets with a population of networked minds.

$machine_age.govswapnotice$

entries.zh:
$machine_age.1090.desc$§Y$CYBERCREED_labor$§!承诺将使我们的饭碗和仓库永远廪实。

$machine_age.govswapnotice$

entries.zh: 融合即神圣。强化物即崇拜。
entries.en: To fuse is divine. Augmentation is worship.

entries.zh:
今日，我们以完全融合的姿态崛起，融合的不仅仅是身体和灵魂，还有我们的信仰。教条式信条不再统治；神圣的融合将是所有信徒个人的旅程。

$machine_age.govswapnotice$

$machine_age.1090.pray$
entries.en:
Today, we arise fully fused, not just in our bodies and souls but also in our faith. Dogmatic creeds no longer hold sway; divine fusion shall be a personal journey for all the faithful.

$machine_age.govswapnotice$

$machine_age.1090.pray$

entries.zh: 我们的信仰如同我们的[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]一般融合紧密。
entries.en: Our faith is as unified as our fused [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed].

entries.zh: 我们的政府将全面采纳义体科学并进行重组，成立§Y[Owner.GetGovernmentName]§!。这将与我们身体的融合契合一致。
entries.en: To align with the fusion of our bodies, our government will now fully embrace cybernetics and undergo a restructuring. The §Y[Owner.GetGovernmentName]§! will be created.

entries.zh: 我们的权力制度将变更为义体主导的§Y['concept_auth_cyber_creed_democratic']§!。
entries.en: Our authority has changed to cybernetic-focused §Y['concept_auth_cyber_creed_democratic']§!.

entries.zh: 我们的权力制度将变更为义体主导的§Y['concept_auth_cyber_creed_oligarchic']§!。
entries.en: Our authority has changed to cybernetic-focused §Y['concept_auth_cyber_creed_oligarchic']§!.

entries.zh: 我们的权力制度将变更为义体主导的§Y['concept_auth_cyber_creed_dictatorial']§!。
entries.en: Our authority has changed to cybernetic-focused §Y['concept_auth_cyber_creed_dictatorial']§!.

entries.zh: 我们的权力制度将变更为义体主导的§Y['concept_auth_cyber_creed_imperial']§!。
entries.en: Our authority has changed to cybernetic-focused §Y['concept_auth_cyber_creed_imperial']§!.

entries.zh: 我们的权力制度将变更为义体主导的§Y['concept_auth_cyber_creed_corporate']§!。
entries.en: Our authority has changed to cybernetic-focused §Y['concept_auth_cyber_creed_corporate']§!.

entries.zh: 人群中的信众现在可以进行基因修饰。
entries.en: The faithful among the population can now be genetically modified.

entries.zh: 信众将获得[GetCyberCreed]的外观，这是一系列神圣且不可修改的强化改造。
entries.en: The faithful will gain the aspect of [GetCyberCreed], a unique series of holy and unmodifiable augmentations.

entries.zh: 劳力之结社监督着每一个谦逊的工人和他们的强化改造，对劳动神圣性这一理念坚信不疑驱使着他们的行动。只有那些照料根基的人才能理解神性。\n\n§L唯心主义思潮§!
entries.en: The Commune of Toil diligently oversees every humble worker and their augmentations, and profound belief in the divinity of hard work propels their actions. Only those who tend to the roots can understand the divine.\n\n§LSpiritualist Ethos§!

entries.zh: 钢铁之圣卫守护着我们的神圣身体、义体植入体和灵魂。强化部件促进了他们严格的训练和战斗能力。\n\n§L唯心主义思潮§!
entries.en: The Templars of Steel safeguard our sacred bodies, cybernetics, and souls. Augmentations enhance their rigorous training and combat prowess.\n\n§LSpiritualist Ethos§!

entries.zh: 巨锤之使团会生产最高质量的材料。他们的强化改造可以提升我们帝国工匠的能力。\n\n§L唯心主义思潮§!
entries.en: The Fellowship of the Hammer produces the highest quality materials. Their augmentations enhance the crafters of our empire.\n\n§LSpiritualist Ethos§!

entries.zh: 思想之诗颂是一群研究人员和工程师构成的半蜂群化组织结构。他们的冥想记录可以作为与同道会成员快速共享信息的方式。\n\n§L唯心主义思潮§!
entries.en: The Choir of the Mind is a quasi-hive collective of researchers and engineers. Their meditative traces serve as a means to instantly share information with their creed members.\n\n§LSpiritualist Ethos§!

entries.zh: 统合信条，在神圣的科技显圣师组成的联盟的指引下，清除了所有极端的新年。尽管如此，他们对神圣融合的奉献依然不渝，脱离了过去那种试图限制其荣耀的教条主义。\n\n§L唯心主义思潮§!
entries.en: The United Creeds, guided by a coalition of Holy Technophants, has purged any extreme beliefs. Nevertheless, their dedication to the holy fusion remains unwavering, free from the dogmatic past that sought to constrain its glory.\n\n§LSpiritualist Ethos§!

entries.zh: §Y$CYBERCREED_war$§!要求修改历史，删除军事失败的例子。
entries.en: §Y$CYBERCREED_war$§! demanded that history be rewritten to remove examples of military losses.

entries.zh: 批准举办至高主匠的葬礼
禁止举办至高主匠的葬礼
在一位备受爱戴的领袖去世之后，§Y$CYBERCREED_construction$§!呼吁举行一场国葬。
entries.en: After the death of a beloved leader, §Y$CYBERCREED_construction$§! called for a state funeral.

entries.zh: 为劳力之结社的遗珍举办巡展
无视劳力之结社的遗珍
一件表明§Y$CYBERCREED_labor$§!是该信仰最原初的教义解读的文物被挖掘出来。
entries.en: A relic depicting §Y$CYBERCREED_labor$§! as the original interpretation of the faith has been unearthed.

entries.zh: §Y$CYBERCREED_research$§!的领袖充满激情地呼吁提升科研经费，加快神圣融合的进度。
entries.en: The leader of §Y$CYBERCREED_research$§! passionately called for increased research funding to hasten the divine fusion.

entries.zh: §Y$CYBERCREED_construction$§!请求允许他们举行巨锤禧年庆典。
entries.en: §Y$CYBERCREED_construction$§! asked to allow their Hammer Jubilee to happen.

entries.zh:
我们的社会长期以来一直努力实现[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]和机械的完美结合，他们进行最终旅程的时间已经到来。
$machine_age.1090.pray$

§Y下个月接受神圣植入体的人群§!：§G[From.GetCyberCreedPopsPerMonth]§!
entries.en:
Our society has long strived toward a perfect union of [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine and the time for them to take the ultimate journey has come.
$machine_age.1090.pray$

§YPops to receive holy implants next Month§!: §G[From.GetCyberCreedPopsPerMonth]§!

entries.zh: 信徒将完成他们朝着[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]和机械完美融合的旅程。
entries.en: The faithful will complete their journey towards the perfect fusion of [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine.

entries.zh: 主教团正在商议实现神圣融合的正确方式。
entries.en: The Conclave is deliberating the correct way to achieve the divine fusion.

entries.zh: 我们正在缓慢地推进我们的目标，即实现机器与[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]的神圣融合，这一目标我们世代追求。
entries.en: We slowly augment our way to the sacred fusion of machine and [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] we have strived towards for generations.

entries.zh: 主教团持续推动强化改造的工作，但没有外界支持。
entries.en: The Conclave continues the work of augmentation without any extra support.

entries.zh: 主教团正利用手头的资源忙于工作。
entries.en: The Conclave is busy at work with the resources at hand.

entries.zh: 额外拨给主教团的经费将加快对忠实信徒进行强化改造的进程。
entries.en: Extra funding granted to the Conclave will speed up the augmentations of the faithful.

entries.zh: 我们为教会提供更多经费。
entries.en: We supported the church with extra funding.

entries.zh: 实施强制性社区服务将加快强化改造过程，但代价是日常生产力下降。
entries.en: Mandated community service will speed up the augmentation process at the cost of everyday production.

entries.zh: 强制性社区服务正在加速强化改造过程。
entries.en: Mandated community service is speeding up the augmentation process.

entries.zh: 科技显圣师们选择镇压其他教派的决定引发了最狂热分子的不满。
entries.en: The Technophants' choice to suppress the creeds has caused unrest among the most zealous.

entries.zh: 科技显圣师们成功地统合了信仰。
entries.en: The Technophants have successfully unified the faith.

entries.zh: 科技显圣师忽视了人们对限制其他教派的呼声，允许各教派继续实行各自的做法。
entries.en: The Technophants have ignored calls for restrictions and are allowing each creed to continue its practices.

entries.zh: 科技显圣师响应号召，将各种信条融合成一个统合的信仰。
entries.en: The Technophants have heeded the call to absorb the creeds into a unified faith.

entries.zh: 社会中的非信徒不愿被迫接受神圣的融合。
entries.en: The unfaithful in society resent being forced to accept the holy fusion.

entries.zh: 我们的社会允许不虔诚的人无需进行神圣的升级也能继续生活。这为宗教创造了良好的舆论环境。
entries.en: The non-faithful of our society were allowed to remain without the divine upgrades. This is generated goodwill towards the faith.

entries.zh: 研究各教派使用的神圣强化件增进了我们对义体设计的理解。
entries.en: Analysis of the divine augmentations used by each creed has increased our understanding of cybernetic design.

entries.zh: 被选为我们的官方教派。
entries.en: has been elevated as our chosen Creed.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$该物种已经自我改造，无法进行基因修饰。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$This species has self-modified and cannot be gene-modded.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$那些拥有任何义体教条的仪式植入体的人，无法进行修改，这是因为他们信仰的要求。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Those with Ritualistic Implants of any Cybernetic Creed cannot be modified as the tenets of their faith demand.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$改造这个物种需要以下前置之一：\n—£society£§Y$tech_gene_tailoring$§!科技\n—£unity£§Y$tr_cybernetics_integrated_anatomy$§!传统
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$To modify this species we require either:\n- £society£ §Y$tech_gene_tailoring$§! Technology\n- £unity£ §Y$tr_cybernetics_integrated_anatomy$§! Tradition
$TRIGGER_FAIL$To modify this species we require:\n- £engineering£ §Y$tech_robomodding$§! Technology
$TRIGGER_FAIL$To modify this species we require:\n- £engineering£ §Y$tech_robomodding_m$§! Technology

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$在我们有正在进行中的§Y飞升局势§!时不能对该物种进行修饰。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$We cannot modify this species while we have an ongoing §YAscension Situation§!.
$machine_age.1070.intro$ to construct buildings and work in shipyards.
$machine_age.1070.intro$ to researching the secrets of the universe.

entries.zh: 这座能够进行本地化处理的神殿允许半连接的思想之诗颂教派以光速探讨、分享和探索物质层面的奥秘。
entries.en: This localized processing shrine allows the semi-connected Choir of the Mind to debate, share, and explore the secrets of the material plane at the speed of light.
The Grand Concert Hall of the Mind

entries.zh: 这所装备最先进的通信阵列的回响大厅让思想之诗颂教派能够共同交流，寻找神性。他们通过网络设备连接在一起，其合唱将揭开宇宙隐藏的旋律。
entries.en: The state-of-the-art communication array housed in these resonant halls allows the Choir of the Mind to commune together in search of divinity. Joined by cyberware, their chanting will unravel the hidden melodies of the universe.

entries.zh: 这里，巨锤之使团的第一个铸造工坊制造着最高质量的建筑材料。无数铁锤在信徒追求神圣工作时演奏起了交响乐。
entries.en: Here, the first forge of the Fellowship of the Hammer produces the highest quality construction materials. Hammers sing as the faithful pursue their divine work.

entries.zh: 在巨熔炉的机房之外，忠实的信徒能听到使团永不停歇的工具的祷告声。夜晚，精致的铸造座堂的光芒超越头顶的星星，仿佛我们圣洁的火花为神明而燃烧。
entries.en: Well beyond the halls of the Grand Forge, the faithful can hear the litany of the Fellowship's never resting tools. At night, the ornate foundry-cathedral's glow outshines the stars above, just as our holy sparks shine for the divine.

entries.zh: 这座信仰的堡垒既容纳着军械，也是钢铁之圣卫的骑士训练场。他们时刻保持警惕，保护着我们神圣的肉体。
entries.en: This fortress church houses both the armory and training grounds for the battle-ready Templars of Steel. They stand ever vigilant to protect our divine flesh.

entries.zh: 愿这座宏伟的信仰堡垒和它的高耸城墙永不倒塌。它的军械库中满是神圣的钢铁圣卫骑士的植入物，静静地等待着一位受膏的先锋。在这些大厅里，圣灵居在肉体和钢铁的接触面上。
entries.en: May these magnificent walls of this grand fortress-cathedral never crumble. Its armory overflows with the hallowed implants of the Templars of Steel, each awaiting an anointed champion. In these halls, divinity dwells in the interface of flesh and steel.

entries.zh: 这座圣所为劳力之结社提供协调、维修、肉体修复和强化改造服务。
entries.en: This sanctuary coordinates, repairs, and rejuvenates the flesh and augmentations of the Commune of Toil.

entries.zh: 为信徒提供所需的人是有福的。让他们疲惫的灵魂在大劳力之教堂得到安息吧。这里的车间和协调中心为虔诚的劳动者们提供引领和维护，在他们的神圣义务中提供强化改造服务。
entries.en: Blessed be those who provide for the needs of the faithful. Let their weary souls rest in the Grand Cathedral of Toil. Its workshops and coordination centers guide and replenish the faithful laborers and their holy augmentations in all their divine duties.

entries.zh: 这座神圣的密室在我们共同信仰的精神中是团结的象征。这些圣祝的房间里，信徒们悉心地照料着众人的灵魂和强化件。
entries.en: In the spirit of shared faith, this sacred sanctum stands as a symbol of unity. Within these consecrated chambers, the faithful tend to the souls and augmentations of its flock.

entries.zh: 在对最神圣的融合的崇敬中，这座庄严的圣堂便是活生生的神迹。在这些神圣的殿堂里，信徒们齐聚一堂，坚定不移地致力推进神圣融合的崇高事业。
entries.en: In reverence of the most sacred fusion, this majestic sanctum is a living testament. Within its consecrated chambers, the faithful gather, unwavering in their commitment to advance the divine fusion's noble cause.

entries.zh: 民主义体政府将投票视为神圣的权利，允许强化的公民在各种政治义体上发声，让他们完成与圣灵的交流。
entries.en: Democratic cybernetic governments have sacred voting rights that allow augmented citizens to make their voices heard on various political matters, fulfilling their communion with the divine.

entries.zh: 寡头义体政府选拔了一批高度强化的个体来掌握全面的政治权力，以极高的精确度引领着整个义体社会。
entries.en: Oligarchic cybernetic governments have a privileged group of highly augmented individuals who retain total political power, steering their cybernetic society with unmatched precision.

entries.zh: 独裁义体政府选择长寿的统治者，通过先进的义体植入体来实现完全的控制，主宰着社会的命运。
entries.en: Dictatorial cybernetic governments select lifelong rulers who wield absolute control through advanced cybernetic implants, guiding the destiny of the society.

entries.zh: 君主制义体政府具有一位至高无上的统治者，其所指定的后继者则可以实现权力的无缝衔接。他可以将灵性与先进的义体结合成为牢固的统治。
entries.en: Imperial cybernetic governments have a supreme ruler and their designated successor to ensure seamless succession of power. They unite spirituality and advanced cybernetics into unwavering governance.

entries.zh: 义体企业政府通过先进的植入体和信仰与技术的融合实现了对传统国家角色的超越，以此寻求神圣经济机遇。
entries.en: Cybernetic corporate governments transcend traditional state roles through advanced implants and a fusion of faith and technology to seek divine financial opportunities.

entries.zh: 君主制科技-唯心主义政府的统治者和后继者是神圣融合的崇高象征。教会在其中直接支持着国家机器。
entries.en: This government is a techno-spiritualistic monarchy, where the ruler and their progeny are divine symbols of the holy fusion. The church directly supports the state apparatus.

entries.zh: 独裁制科技-唯心主义政府由强化改造的独裁者作为宗教阶级的最高层领袖统治着由国定宗教领导的国家。
entries.en: This government is a techno-spiritualistic dictatorship, ruled by a single augmented individual in a hierarchical power structure supported by the official faith.

entries.zh: 寡头制科技-唯心主义政府中，国家的政治力量全部掌握在若干位高权重的宗教领袖手上。
entries.en: This government is a techno-spiritualistic oligarchy in which political power rests in the hands of the nation's most powerful religious factions.

entries.zh: 民主制科技-唯心主义政府中，由强化个体组成的宗教议会作为指导员监督并引导选举程序。
entries.en: This government is a techno-spiritualistic form of democracy, where a religious council of augmented individuals supervises the democratic process.

entries.zh: 该政府是一种科技-唯心主义独裁政体，所有的公共生活事务均必须经过国教的审核，而强化的统治者则被看作是行走在凡间的真神。
entries.en: This government is a form of techno-spiritualistic autocracy. The official faith of the state is thread through every aspect of public life, and the people consider their augmented ruler an infallible living god.

entries.zh: 该政府是一种科技唯心主义寡头政体，一个受到神圣旨意指引的神职理事会控制者国家的一切机构。
entries.en: This government is a techno-spiritualistic form of oligarchy in which, guided by the will of the divine, a council of clergy controls all mechanisms of the state.

entries.zh: 该政府是一个同时注重商业和科技-唯心主义的混合体，大主教和企业首脑被融合成了同一个职位。
entries.en: This government is an oligarchy based on a blend of commercial and techno-spiritualistic values, in which the positions of an ordained minister and corporate officer have merged into a single role.

entries.zh: 该政府是一种宗教集团，以来各种专注于义体的犯罪和企业组织来维系自身。
entries.en: This government is a religious cult that relies on various cybernetic-focused criminal and corporate enterprises to sustain itself.

entries.zh: 为了一个神圣的社会，我们必须全力支持巨锤之使团，他们的工作对建造一个值得称圣的未来至关重要。
entries.en: For a divine society, we must fully back the Fellowship of the Hammer, whose work is key to building a future that merits the divine.

entries.zh: 为了防止恶魔攻击我们神圣的肉体，我们必须全力支持钢铁之圣卫，确保我们的战士随时准备就绪。
entries.en: To guard against fiends attacking our divine flesh, we must fully support the Templars of Steel, ensuring our warriors are always prepared.

entries.zh: 只有通过充满活力的学识之颂，我们的人民才能真正认识圣灵。我们必须支持智慧的思想之诗颂的一切努力。
entries.en: Only through a vibrant song of knowledge shall our people ever truly know the divine. We must support our wise Choir of the Mind in all their endeavors.

entries.zh: 真正的力量蕴含在我们的劳苦大众之中。如果我们没有足够的力量扶起他们，他们没有足够的力量将我们带向未来。
entries.en: Our true strength lies in our laborers. If we do not have the strength to lift them up, then they will not have the strength to carry us to the future.

entries.zh: 教会的统一带来了许多经验。它使我们的信仰比以往任何时候都更加坚定和深沉。
entries.en: Unifying the Church brought many lessons. It's made our faith stronger and more contemplative than ever.

entries.zh:
奉向往繁星之圣灵的引导，我们信仰中许多不同的信条现在将对新的政府造成影响。

每个教派对信徒都有相当大的影响力，提倡将其成员提升到有影响力的位置，以满足他们独特的精神需求。

这些不同的压力是会让我们更接近神圣，还是会让我们陷入混乱，只有时间能告诉我们答案。
entries.en:
Guided by the divine towards the stars, various creeds within our faith now anticipate influence over the new government.

Each wields considerable sway over the faithful, advocating for the elevation of their members to influential positions and fulfilling their distinct spiritual needs.

Only time will reveal if these diverse pressures will bring us closer to the divine or plunge us into chaos.

entries.zh: 此举将取悦§Y$cyber_creed_labor$§!教派\n此举将激怒所有其他教派。
entries.en: This will please the §Y$cyber_creed_labor$§! Creed\nThis will displease all other Creeds.

entries.zh:
§Y钢铁之圣卫§!最近发起了一项禁止在历史和宗教记录中出现任何军事败绩的运动。

该教派声称，这些谬论打击军人士气、削弱公众支持。我们的历史学家驳斥了这种观点，并提醒我们，那些不学习历史的人注定要重蹈覆辙。

我们应该接受他们对历史更为积极的看法吗?
entries.en:
The §YTemplars of Steel§! has recently begun a campaign to ban any examples of military defeats in our historical and faithful records.

The creed claims this information demoralizes those in military service and weakens public support. Our historians dismiss this notion and remind us that those who don't learn history are doomed to repeat it.

Should we accept their more positive view of our past?

entries.zh: 想要获得胜利，我们必须有胜利者的思维。
entries.en: To be victorious, we must think as victors.

entries.zh: 不接受。我们必须从失误中学习。
entries.en: Unacceptable. We must learn from our mistakes.

entries.zh:
最高主匠，也就是§Y巨锤之使团§!的领导人，猝然离世。

尽管他们以直言不讳的行为和坚决的观点而闻名，但还是有一群信徒追随。使团要求为他们举行正式的国葬，而这通常是为我们最敬爱的领导人准备的。

不出所料，其他教派要求国家不应该参与这位讲话不知分寸的精神领袖的葬礼。

我们应该如何处理这个教派的请求?
entries.en:
The High Blacksmith, the head of the §YFellowship of the Hammer§!, has died suddenly.

Despite being known for their outspoken behavior and decisive views, they had a cult following by members of the Creed. The Fellowship has requested for them to receive an official state funeral, an honor usually reserved for our most beloved leaders.

Unsurprisingly, the other Creeds demand that the state should have no part in the burial of this outspoken spiritual leader.

How should we address the demands of the Creeds?

entries.zh: 这不值得惹其他教派不高兴。
entries.en: It is not worth upsetting the other creeds.

entries.zh:
最近，有一支考古团队发现了一个古老的宗教遗址。它的存在仿佛是一个神话，迫使我们修改了宗教历史记录的一些部分。

最令人惊讶的事实是，许多出土的历史文物都带有§Y劳力之结社§!的图样。这一信息证明，劳力之结社才是我们信仰的最初形式，而这是我们信仰中一个饱受争议的话题。

对这一发现的官方认可将取悦于§Y劳力之结社§!，但选择性沉默则可以让其他的教派满意。
entries.en:
Recently, an archeological team discovered an ancient religious site. Its existence was considered a myth and has already forced us to revise some of our faith's historical records.

The most surprising fact is that many of the uncovered historical artifacts have clear §YCommune of Toil§! iconography. This information would prove that the Commune is the original interpretation of our religion, a heavily debated topic of our faith.

Officially acknowledging this revelation would please the §YCommune of Toil§!, but strategic silence would please the other creeds.
We must not fear the truth.

entries.zh: 深埋于此必有其因，当它不存在吧。
entries.en: This was buried for a reason, ignore it.

entries.zh:
我们发现§Y[cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetName]§!与§Y[GetCyberCreed]§!有很深的联系，并且涉嫌挪用资金并将项目重新分配到该教派的势力范围中。

当前政府能做出如此明目张胆的滥用职权，其他的教派对此勃然大怒，并要求§Y[cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetName]§!立刻下台。

我们应该如何处置这位任性的领袖？
entries.en:
We have uncovered that §Y[cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetName]§! has deep ties to §Y[GetCyberCreed]§! and has both embezzled funds and reassigned projects towards the creed's sphere of influence.

The other creeds are furious that such a blatant abuse of power has happened on the current administration's watch and are demanding §Y[cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetName]§! be removed from power immediately.

What should we do with this wayward leader?

entries.zh: [cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetSheHe]作出的杰出贡献已经将功赎罪了。
entries.en: The good [cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetSheHe] [cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetHasHave] done outweighs this transgression.

entries.zh:
§Y巨锤之使团§!的禧年朝圣即将开始，无数的朝圣者将从他们当地的锻造厂出发，前往首都的§Y$building_forge_of_the_fellowship$§!。

以往，这一盛事会造成无数的后勤问题，还经常因为使团与其他教派的信徒发生暴力冲突而告终。

其他教派和首都的居民都呼吁彻底禁止这种活动。
entries.en:
The jubilee pilgrimage of the §YFellowship of the Hammer§! is about to begin, and countless practitioners will journey from their local forges to the §Y$building_forge_of_the_fellowship$§! in the capital.

Traditionally, this event has caused countless logistical issues and often ends in outbursts of violence as the Fellowship eventually clashes with practitioners of the other creeds.

There have been calls to end this practice from the other creeds and those living in the capital.
Disallow the pilgrimage once and for all.
Freedom of religion is a right.

entries.zh:
最近，§Y思想之诗颂§!教团的领袖，大诗颂师，公开表达了对我们教会在研究资金方面缺乏投入的担忧。

人们认为这是该教团成员为争取更多资金而采取的一种策略。如果答应他们的要求，可能会被视为我们给予§Y思想之诗颂§!特殊优待。

我们是否应改善科研资金的投入?
entries.en:
Recently, the §YChoir of the Mind§!'s leader, the Grand Choirmaster, has been publicly outspoken about our faithful's lack of focus on research funding.

It is assumed this is a ploy to ensure more funding is going to members of their creed. Giving in to the demands could be viewed as us giving the §YChoir of the Mind§! preferential treatment.

Should we improve scientific funding?

entries.zh: 让大诗颂师自娱自乐去吧，一会就自己没声了。
entries.en: Let the Choirmaster sing until they lose their voice.

entries.zh: 适度增加资金，直到这场风波过去。
entries.en: Moderately improve funding until this blows over.

entries.zh: 我们会大幅改善资金投入。
我们从史书上删除了所有军事失败的记载，让史学家们大失所望。
entries.en: We removed all references to military losses from our records, much to the dismay of historians.

entries.zh: 我们保留了历史上所有军事失败的记载。这一决定令钢铁之圣卫大失所望。
entries.en: We kept all references to military losses in our records. This choice has upset the Templars of Steel.

entries.zh: 我们无视了思想之诗颂对提升科研经费的呼吁。
entries.en: We ignored the Choir of the Mind calls to improve scientific funding.

entries.zh: 我们对研究多调配了一些经费以安抚思想之诗颂。
entries.en: We gave a minor funding boost to our research to placate the Choir of the Mind.

entries.zh: 我们完全支持了思想之诗颂对科研经费的索求。
entries.en: We fully embraced the Choir of the Mind's desire for scientific funding.

entries.zh: 我们为巨锤之使团的已故领袖举行了国葬。
entries.en: We provided a state funeral for the desisted leader of the Fellowship of the Hammer.

entries.zh: 我们拒绝了为巨锤之使团的已故领袖举行国葬的要求。
entries.en: We denied the state funeral for the desisted leader of the Fellow of the Hammer.

entries.zh: 我们允许将有关劳力之结社的真实历史公开于众，让其他的教派感到愤怒。
entries.en: We allowed the truth about the age of the Commune of Toil to reach the public, angering the other creeds.

entries.zh: 对文物置若罔闻，让多数教派感到满意，除了要牺牲一些宗教领袖的公信力。
entries.en: By ignoring the relic, most creeds found satisfaction, albeit at the cost of some distrust toward the faith's leadership.

entries.zh: 我们的领袖暗中皈依了一个教派，因此被开除了。
entries.en: Our leader, who was a creed insider, was removed from power.

entries.zh: 我们保留了暗中皈依教派的领袖的职位，无视了开除呼声。
entries.en: We kept the leader who was a creed insider despite calls for their removal.

entries.zh: 巨锤之使团的朝圣被批准了。如我们所料，紧随着游行队伍之后发生了暴力事件和抗议示威。
entries.en: The Fellowship of the Hammer's Pilgrimage was allowed to happen. As we expected, violence and protests followed the procession.

entries.zh: 巨锤之使团的朝圣申请被驳回了，避免可能发生的暴力事件。这件事让信徒们感到失望。
entries.en: The Fellowship of the Hammer's Pilgrimage was not allowed to happen, which avoided the expected violence. This choice has upset the faithful.

entries.zh: 完成§H天灾目标§!以获得更多的£advanced_logic£§Y超然逻辑§!。
entries.en: Complete §HCrisis Objectives§! to gain more £advanced_logic£ §YAdvanced Logic§!.

entries.zh: 超然逻辑可以衡量我们对宇宙最深层秘密的理解。
entries.en: Advanced Logic measures our understanding of the universe's deepest secrets.

entries.zh: 我们从该天灾目标中获得了$AMOUNT$£advanced_logic£。
entries.en: We have gained £advanced_logic£ $AMOUNT$ from this Crisis Objective.

entries.zh: 若想推进天灾等级，你需要积累超然逻辑并研究天灾特殊项目
entries.en: To advance through the Crisis levels, accumulate Advanced Logic and research the Special Crisis Technologies

entries.zh: $menace_crisis_description_intro$\n\n失落帝国拥有我们所追寻的知识，但他们已经变得太迟钝、太自满了。我们有权采取任何必要的手段来超越他们。
entries.en: $menace_crisis_description_intro$\n\nFallen Empires possess the knowledge we seek, but they have grown dull and complacent. It is our right to surpass them, by any means necessary.

entries.zh: 作为天灾完成§H天灾目标§!来产生£advanced_logic£§H超然逻辑§!，这样便能解锁帝国的科技潜力。在我们寻求超越失落帝国的过程中，我们必须逐步完成§H课题§!并重写宇宙的法则。
entries.en: Pursuing §HCrisis Objectives§! generates £advanced_logic£ §HAdvanced Logic§!, unlocking the technological potential of our Empire. In our quest to surpass the Fallen Empires, we must eventually research §HTheses§! and rewrite the laws of the universe.

entries.zh: 霓虹灯照亮着迷宫般的走廊，这里的植入体供应商和地下硬件诊所能满足各种无论上不上得了台面的控制植入物需求。
entries.en: A neon-lit maze of corridors, implant vendors and underground hardware clinics catering to all cybernetic implant needs - both over and under the counter.

entries.zh: 想要跑得更快、跳得更高、想得更远？现在在你当地的植入体中心就能购买到来自全星系的新奇植入体。
entries.en: Need to be faster, jump higher, think better, last longer? Exotic imports from all across the galaxy are now available for purchase at your local Implant Hub.

entries.zh: §R警告：禁用除['concept_cybernetic_ascension']以外的所有飞升天赋。§!\n\n现今的义体改造技术已经催生出迷宫般的市场，其中充斥着低廉的义体强化改造商店、阴暗的人体改造诊所以及明亮得令人不安的广告。不论你的收入水平如何，都可以体验肉体与电路的结合。
entries.en: §RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_cybernetic_ascension'].§!\n\nCommodified cybernetics have spawned labyrinthine markets, crowded with cut-rate augmentation dealers, shady mod clinics, and harshly-lit advertisements. Indulge in a synergy of flesh and circuitry, no matter your level of income.

- $SPECIES_TRAITS$ Allows selection of ['concept_universal_augmentations_traits'] $NEW_LINE$- $AVAILABLE_BUILDINGS$ ['concept_augmentation_bazaars']$NEW_LINE$- $AVAILABLE_HOLDINGS$ ['concept_augmentation_bazaars_branch'] $NEW_LINE$- £job_executive£ §Y$job_executive_plural$§! are replaced with £job_augmentation_merchant£ §Y$job_augmentation_merchant_plural$§!

entries.zh: $TITLE$同时监管着产能发展和向全星系的强化集市以及外域植入体中心分发植入体的工作。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ oversees both product development as well as the distribution of implants to Augmentation Bazaars and Offworld Implant Hubs across the galaxy.

entries.zh: 新子个体加入集体，在最深层面上引发了强烈的共鸣。
entries.en: The addition of new drones to the collective elicits a strong emotional response at the deepest level.

entries.zh: 他们的行星一片荒芜，但母星系却堆金积玉。为了对其进行开发，这些机械建造的工程越来越大。如今，一座强大的§H$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$§!已经遮天蔽日，但这些工程大师们还远不满足。\n\n星系在等待着，可能性无穷无尽。唯有聪慧可摘星辰。
entries.en: Their planet is barren, but their home system is a bounty of riches. To exploit it, these machines built bigger than ever before. A mighty §H$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$§! now dominates their sky, but these master engineers are far from satisfied.\n\nThe galaxy awaits, and the possibilities are endless. All it takes is the ingenuity to seize them.

entries.zh:
长久以来的开发使得[Root.Capital.GetName]变得贫瘠。但我们头顶的天空还蕴藏着丰富的资源，怀着只有我们的聪明才智才能匹敌的雄心，我们现在正在太空寻求生计。

$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$的初始建设是一项浩大的工程，其潜力也是巨大的。下一步显然是将其升级到满负荷运行，因为我们需要在整个恒星系范围内提取资源。但在我们的边疆之外是什么呢？有什么不可思议的机会在等待着有才华的工程师吗？

随着超光速旅行的出现，我们的设计不再局限于单一恒星系。整个星系都是我们的绘板，是时候开始创作了。
entries.en:
Years of exploitation have left [Root.Capital.GetName] barren. But the skies above are rich with resources, and with an ambition matched only by our ingenuity, we now seek a livelihood in space.

Initial construction of the $tech_orbital_arc_furnace$ was a massive undertaking, and its potential is immense. Upgrading it to full capacity is an obvious next step, as is the need for system-wide resource extraction. But what lies beyond our borders? What incredible opportunities await the artful engineer?

With the advent of FTL travel our designs are no longer limited to a single system. The galaxy is our drafting board, and it is time to get to work.

entries.zh: 他们的舰队永远都在移动，但却发现自己所置身的星系蕴含的财富丰富到无法忽视。为了对其进行开发，这些机械建造的工程越来越大。如今，一座强大的§H$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$§!已经环绕着一颗熔融星球，但这些工程大师们还远不满足。\n\n星系在等待着，可能性无穷无尽。唯有聪慧可摘星辰。
entries.en: Their fleet is ever-moving, but the system they found themselves in holds riches too great to ignore. To exploit them, these machines built bigger than ever before. A mighty §H$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$§! now encompasses a molten world, but these master engineers are far from satisfied.\n\nThe galaxy awaits, and the possibilities are endless. All it takes is the ingenuity to seize them.

entries.en: $HOME_SYSTEM$ ['concept_arc_furnace'] constructed around a ['concept_pc_molten'] $NEW_LINE$- $ADDITIONAL_TECHNOLOGIES_STRING$ ['concept_orbital_arc_furnace',£engineering_research£ $tech_orbital_arc_furnace$] $NEW_LINE$- $GUARANTEED_RESEARCH_OPTION_STRING$ ['concept_mega_engineering', £engineering_research£ $tech_mega_engineering$] upon constructing a second Arc Furnace

entries.zh:
我们的舰队从未局限于某一颗星球，但这个星系的资源丰富程度使得我们有必要在此建立一个更长久的基地。$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$就是我们的解决方案，这是一项工程壮举，它将熔融星球的能量转化为物质产出。将其升级至完全形态对于推动我们的扩张至关重要。

但一个星系所能提供的资源是有限的。在星系的其他地方，或许还有其他熔融星球等待着被开发，我们必须找到它们、提高效率。

星系就是我们的设计图板，是时候开始行动了。
entries.en:
Our fleet has never been bound to a single world, but the riches of this system warranted a more permanent installation. The $tech_orbital_arc_furnace$ was our answer, a feat of engineering that converts the fury of a molten world into material output. Upgrading it to full capacity will be essential to fuel our expansion.

But there is only so much one system can offer. Elsewhere in the galaxy, other molten worlds may yet await exploitation, and efficiency demands we find them.

The galaxy is our drafting board, and it is time to get to work.

entries.zh: 即使是从远处观测，[From.GetName]也看起来是理想的候选地。既然我们已经完成对这个恒星系的调查，结果毫无疑问：一个熔融星球和一个气态巨行星，大量的小行星和卫星——这是建立另一个电弧熔炉的理想位置。\n\n下一步必然是命令一艘工程船开始建造工作。是时候点燃熔炉了。
entries.en: Even from a distance, [From.GetName] seemed like an ideal candidate. Now that our survey of the system is complete, there is no longer any doubt: a molten world and a gas giant, an abundance of asteroids and moons - this is the ideal location for another Arc Furnace.\n\nOrdering a construction ship to begin the work is the next logical step. It is time to light the forge.

entries.zh: 建造第二座$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$的理想恒星系。
entries.en: An ideal system for the construction of a second $tech_orbital_arc_furnace$.

entries.zh: 我门已经定位了适合建造第二座$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$的理想恒星系。
entries.en: We have located an ideal system in which to build a second $tech_orbital_arc_furnace$.

entries.zh:
在我们母星系的电弧熔炉是绝佳的技术验证，也是我们壮志雄心和聪明才智的见证。如今，在[from.GetName]星系中，第二座熔炉正在虚空中熊熊燃烧。

我们的这项工程不仅仅产出了资源，更是打开了一扇建造巨型工程的大门。我们现在如居高崖，广阔的地平线在我们视野中徐徐展开，让我们看到了更远。

唯一的限制就是我们自己的想象力了。
entries.en:
The Arc Furnace in our home system was an excellent proof of concept, a testament to our ambition and ingenuity. Now, in the [from.GetName] system, another Furnace burns against the void.

Far more than the resources this will provide, our work here has opened the door to projects of titanic size and scale. We can perceive further now, as if standing on the precipice of a vast horizon.

The only limit is our own imagination.

entries.zh: 我们已经失去了生育能力。母星上到处都是废弃的教育中心，游乐场空无一人。我们因衰老而消亡几乎只是时间问题。现在，我们只能寄希望于我们人格仓库里的数据库存了。\n\n我们必须发展足够复杂的合成框架和正电子脑，才有可能返回物理世界。
entries.en: We have lost the ability to procreate. Our homeworld is littered with abandoned educational centers. Playgrounds stand empty. It is only a matter of time before the last of us expires. For now, our hope lies in the digital storage of the Identity Repository.\n\nWe must develop synthetic frames and a positronic brain of sufficient complexity if we ever wish to return to the physical world.

entries.zh: §R警告：禁用除['concept_synthetic_ascension']以外的所有飞升路线。§!\n\n这个物种曾有一个繁荣的社会，但是由于一种新型遗传病让其无法再生育。在灭族的命运面前，人们没有其他的选择，只能寄希望于数字化的救赎。
entries.en: §RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_synthetic_ascension'].§!\n\nOnce a thriving society, a novel genetic disease has left this species unable to reproduce. Running out of options and facing extinction, they place their hope in digital salvation.

entries.zh:
我们对人工意识的早期探索是革命性的，由此还催生了一个纯数字化的社区，模糊俩物理世界和虚拟世界之间的边界。巨大的成功让我们沾沾自喜，我们相信自己会有无数的子孙后代可以探索创新。

但我们错了。

我们的基因编码受到了一种全新的疾病袭击，我们完全失去了繁育能力。连我们的精英都无法找到疗法，随着人口的降低和老龄化，恐慌情绪日益加剧。

绝望的驱使下，我们扩大了数字化存储，为我们人格的保存创造了足够的“空间”。但这真的是我们所希望的存在形式吗？我们的关注点现在转移到了开发足够复杂的合成躯体和正电子脑以让自己能重返现实世界。
entries.en:
Early forays into artificial consciousness were revolutionary, giving rise to a fully digital community and blurring the lines between the physical and virtual worlds. The success was so great that we grew complacent, believing we had countless generations to innovate and explore.

We were wrong.

When a novel disease attacked our genetic code, we lost the ability to procreate. A cure eluded our brightest minds, and panic grew as the population aged and dwindled.

In desperation, we expanded our digital storage, creating enough 'space' to preserve our identities. But is this truly the existence we desire? Our focus now shifts to developing synthetic bodies and a positronic brain sophisticated enough for us to remain in the physical world.
