entries.zh: 一种新型基因疾病让该物种无法繁育后代。这种疾病还抵抗所有已知的基因治疗方法。
entries.en: A novel genetic disease prevents this species from producing offspring. It has resisted all known gene therapy methods.
§RSpecies is in decline§! due to their §Y$trait_pathogenic_genes$§!

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§Y带有§R$trait_pathogenic_genes$§!特质的人口无法强制迁移§!
这具机器身体又笨拙又缓慢，是$building_identity_repository$中数字化领袖的代理身体。
entries.en: Cumbersome and slow, this robot body is a surrogate for a digitized leader in the $building_identity_repository$.

entries.zh: 每增加一个人格都会提高仓库的产出和维护费，并分摊到我们各殖民地上的$building_identity_repository$。
entries.en: Each Identity boosts the Repository's output and upkeep, divided among all $building_identity_repository$ on our colonies.

entries.zh: 在身体逝去之前，意识进行了数据化。安然于其中，我们继续为社会的福祉工作着。
entries.en: Before the body expires, the mind is digitized. Safe within, we continue to work for the good of society.

entries.zh: 在我们失去了天然繁育的能力之后，医疗共同体将希望寄托于这座尖端的基因诊所。然而就像我其他的种种基础设施一样，它现在也已人去楼空，为我们的绝境和对新方案迫切需求敲响了警钟。
entries.en: After we lost the ability to procreate naturally, the medical community placed its hope in this state-of-the-art gene clinic. Like so much of our infrastructure, it now stands empty, a constant reminder of our plight and the dire need for new solutions.

entries.zh: 在缺乏医疗解决方案的情况下，我们有可能生还的方案便是将人口数字化存储在§Y人格仓库§!中。然而，这只是一个权宜之计，后续计划已经敲定，即开发合成身体和足够复杂的正电子大脑。预计我们将有足够的时间集中精力完成这项研究。\n\n我们最优秀的专家已经利用尖端的人工智能绘制了机器身体的蓝图，这是我们合成救赎的第一步。
entries.en: Lacking a medical solution, our best chance for survival lies in digitizing our population within the §YIdentity Repository§!. However, this is a stopgap solution, and a plan is already in place to develop synthetic bodies and a positronic brain of sufficient complexity. We estimate that we have enough time to complete the research with a focused effort.\n\nUsing cutting-edge AI, our best experts have already drawn up the blueprints for robotic bodies, the first step to our synthetic salvation.

entries.zh: 我们对机器人体的研究已经完成。我们将$building_abandoned_gene_clinic$设施改造为$building_robot_assembly_plant$，并且已经升级并部署了原型机。尽管这些初级系统缺乏容纳个人意识的处理能力，但它们可以替代我们部分失去的劳动力。通过正电子链路，数字领域中的人可以将知识和经验添加到这些机器人的日常操作中，从而提高它们的性能。\n\n同时，我们的人工智能系统已经设计出先进的智能人。我们日渐年迈的工程师们已经准备好开始工作了。
entries.en: Our research into robotic bodies is complete. We have converted the $building_abandoned_gene_clinic$ facility into $building_robot_assembly_plant$, and the prototypes have been upgraded and deployed. While these rudimentary systems lack the processing power to house an individual consciousness, they can replace some of our lost workforce. Through positronic uplink, those in the digital realm can add their knowledge and experience to the daily operation of these robots, improving their performance.\n\nAt the same time, our AI systems have developed a design for advanced androids. Our aging engineers stand ready to get to work.

entries.zh: 这项对我们机器人技术的重大升级意味着，我们现在可以殖民其他行星、我们的机器人人口也可以支持更复杂的任务了。\n\n我们的人工智能系统认为，下一步合理的举动将是在合成身体中模拟它们的正电子矩阵。这个重大的研究项目应该允许我们将数字化的意识返回到自然世界。
entries.en: This significant upgrade to our robotic technology means it is now possible to colonize other planets and for our mechanized population to support more complex tasks.\n\nOur AI systems believe the next logical step would be to mimic their positronic matrixes in synthetic bodies. This significant research project should allow us to return a digitized consciousness to the natural world.
We must not give up now.

entries.zh: 通过不懈的努力，我们终于取得了成功。我们设计出了功能齐全的正电子大脑，其复杂程度足以容纳我们的人格。\n\n虽然我们无法战胜死亡，但我们很快就不再受生物存在的限制约束。
entries.en: After relentless work, we have finally achieved success. A fully functional positronic brain has been designed, one sophisticated enough to contain our identities.\n\nWhile we cannot overcome mortality, we will soon no longer be bound by the limitations of a biological existence.

entries.zh: 是时候让我们合成觉醒了。
entries.en: Its time for our Synthetic awakening.

entries.zh: 这些事件必须采纳§Y合成传统§!才能进展。
entries.en: To progress with these events we must embrace the §YSynthetic Tradition§!.

entries.zh: 我们的组装工厂和合成化专家已经摩拳擦掌要开始这项将人格转移到正电子脑和合成躯体的里程碑式的任务了。
entries.en: Our assembly plants and synthesization experts stand ready to begin the monumental task of transferring identities into positronic brains and synthetic bodies.

entries.zh: $machine_age.3125.both$\n\n我们将开始将重点放在那些仍然生活在物质世界的人们身上，旨在一劳永逸地根除这种遗传疾病。随着合成大脑处理能力的提升，我们甚至能够挣脱肉体的束缚。$synth.105.end$
entries.en: $machine_age.3125.both$\n\nWe will initiate our efforts by focusing on those still residing in the physical world, aiming to eradicate the genetic disease once and for all. With the increased processing power of a synthetic brain we can even surpass our biological constraints.$synth.105.end$

entries.zh: $machine_age.3125.both$\n\n由于在星球上失去了物理存在，我们必须快速建造我们第一具原型躯体。随着合成大脑处理能力的提升，我们甚至能够挣脱肉体的束缚。$synth.105.end$
entries.en: $machine_age.3125.both$\n\nWithout a physical presence in the world, we must rapidly construct our first prototype body. With the increased processing power of a synthetic brain we can even surpass our biological constraints.$synth.105.end$

entries.zh: 还存在的生物人口都会开始嬗变为合成人。
entries.en: If there are any remaining biological pops, they will begin to transfer into Synthetic bodies.

entries.zh:
我们最担心的事情发生了。

我们最后的肉体已经败给了遗传性疾病。虽然我们的数字化意识仍然安全地存储在身份存储库中，但我们缺乏将自己的思想放入人工大脑的技术。

在我们完成研究之前，我们的数字领导人只能通过机器代理与自然世界进行互动。
entries.en:
Our worst fears have come to pass.

The last of our physical bodies has expired. While our digitized consciousnesses remain safely stored in the Identity Repository, we lack the technology to place our minds in an artificial brain.

Until we have completed our research, our digital leaders will have to interact with the natural world via robotic proxies.

entries.zh:
我们成功将所有人格身份迁移到新的合成框架或人格仓库中，确保了人民的存续。

然而，我们遇到了一个新的挑战。我们创造的用于存储数字身份的数字“空间”本应是权宜之计，但居民们已经习惯于这种生存状态，不愿意返回物理世界。

我们可以允许他们继续留在数字世界中，但强制他们进入新的合成身体也是一种可行的选项。
entries.en:
We have successfully relocated every identity into either a new synthetic frame or the Identity Repository, ensuring the continuation of our people.

However, a new challenge has emerged. The digital 'space' we created to store our digital identities was always meant to be temporary, but the inhabitants have grown accustomed to this existence and are reluctant to return to the physical world.

We could allow them to remain there, but the option to compel them into new synthetic bodies is also an alternative.

entries.zh: 就让他们在乐园中享福吧。
剩下的数字人格身份将会留在§Y$building_identity_repository$§!，继续从内部提供支持。
entries.en: The remaining digital identities will stay in the §Y$building_identity_repository$§! and continue to support our people from within.

entries.zh: 团结在一起我们才能更强大。
entries.en: We are stronger if we stay together.

entries.zh: 我们将余下的数字人格身份植入当前库存的合成人体内，同时为其余人建造新的机架。§Y$building_identity_repository$§!将被销毁。
entries.en: We will place the remaining digital identities into our current stock of synthetic bodies and build new frames for the rest. The §Y$building_identity_repository$§! will be destroyed.

entries.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]已经有几十年都没有拥抱过新生儿了。尽管我们可能再也无法体会那种感觉，但今天我们的人民迎来了希望的回归。

我们研发出了§Y人格复合体§!，这是一种先进的研究中心，我们可以复制现有的人格，从而实质上创造新造的人。

我们可以从多个个体中随机选择个性点，通过无数组合创造新的人格身份。或者，我们还可以效仿自然的过程，在一个开放的虚拟环境中培养“心灵内核”。
entries.en:
It has been decades since a [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] held a newborn child in their arms. While we may never know that feeling again, today marks the return of hope for our people.

We've developed §YIdentity Complexes§!, advanced centers where we can copy existing identities to essentially create new people.

We could randomize personality points from multiple individuals, creating new identities through countless combinations. Alternatively, we might mimic nature's process by nurturing 'mind kernels' in an open virtual setting.

entries.zh: 我们把人格混合起来吧。
大自然还是有可取之处的。

今天标志着我们的数字化旅程的终点。没有人能否认已经完成的伟大事业，及其实现所必需的牺牲。

我们现在以一个全面数字化和合成人民族出现。我们不再会屈从于疾病的恐怖。我们也不再会被脆弱的遗传限制。

我们现在可以自由地创造任何我们认为合适的现实。
entries.en:
Today marks the end of our digital journey. No one can deny the magnitude of what has been done, nor the sacrifice necessary to achieve it.

We now stand ascended as a fully digitized and synthetic people. No longer shall we yield to the horrors of disease. No more shall the limitations of feeble genetics confine us.

We are free to create any reality we see fit.

entries.zh: 我们以完全数字化的合成人姿态傲立，可以自由地创造任何我们认为合适的现实。
entries.en: We stand ascended as a fully digitized and synthetic people, free to create any reality we see fit.

entries.zh: 该合成物种已经超越了其生物起源，以新采纳的数字化存在欣欣向荣着。
entries.en: This synthetic species has transcended its biological origins, flourishing in its newly adopted digital existence.

entries.zh: 我们正在研究恢复物理人口所需的技术。
entries.en: We are researching the technology necessary to replenish a physical population.

entries.zh: 我们不能生育后代，但可以保存自己的思想。这个过程缓慢但必要。\n\n随着时间的推移，我们有回到物质世界的可能，但这需要开发合成人的替代品。
entries.en: We cannot bear offspring, but we can preserve our minds. This process is slow but necessary.\n\nIn time, it may be possible for us to return to the physical world, but doing so will require the development of synthetic replacements.

entries.zh: 我们必须在项目的需求和经济的健康之间寻求平衡。
entries.en: We must balance the needs of the project with the health of our economy.

entries.zh: 我们必须将部分的经济转移至科研设施中。
entries.en: We will divert some of our economy to our research facilities.

entries.zh: 为了生存，我们必须对经济做出一些艰难的决定。
entries.en: We must be willing to make hard economic choices to survive.

entries.zh: 我们必须为最佳的数字实体提供更多的能量以进行合成躯体方案的工作。
entries.en: We will grant our best digital identities more energy to work on synthetic body solutions.

entries.zh: 主要能源将会被调配给数字人格以完成物种躯体更换。
entries.en: Primary energy sources will be diverted to the digital identities for a complete species body replacement.

entries.zh: 到这个时候，我们的肉体形式将已消亡。我们的人口将完全数字化。
entries.en: Our physical forms will have expired by this point. Our population will be fully digitized.

entries.zh: 为了在现实世界中保持物理上的存在，我们必须开发具有复杂正电子大脑的尖端合成人身体。
entries.en: To maintain a physical presence in the world, we must develop cutting-edge synthetic bodies with complex positronic brains.

entries.zh: 当我们人口的一半以上都消失时，我们必须愿意将更多经济资源投入到我们的合成人研究中。
entries.en: When more than half our population is gone, we must be willing to divert greater economic resources to research into synthetics.

entries.zh: 由于仅存的个体如此之少，我们必须尽一切努力开发一个足够复杂的正电子大脑。
entries.en: With so few individuals remaining, we must do everything in our power to develop a positronic brain of sufficient complexity.

entries.zh: 除非我们的未来获得保障，否则我们一刻也不会停下来。
entries.en: We will not rest until our future is secure.

entries.zh: 我们的数字身体正在建设中。我们的合成未来指日可待。
entries.en: The construction of our digital bodies has begun. Our synthetic future awaits.

entries.zh:
我们现在已拥有让人民全面合成化所必须的技术知识。


§Y次月获得合成人身体的人口数§!：§G[From.GetSynthFertPopsPerMonth]§!
entries.en:
We now have the needed technical knowledge to complete the synthesization of our population.


§YPops to receive synthetic bodies next month§!: §G[From.GetSynthFertPopsPerMonth]§!

entries.zh: 现有的机器人将被用作我们数字化人口的合成躯体。
entries.en: Existing robotics will be used as synthetic bodies for our digitized population.

entries.zh: 我们将为剩余数字化人口制作新的机器人体。
entries.en: We will build new robot bodies for our remaining digitized population.

entries.zh: 这些城市由于遗传疾病的影响而变得荒废，这是一个人口锐减的沉重警示。
entries.en: These cities stand abandoned due to the effects of the genetic disease, a grim reminder of our shrinking population.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$这个堕落的帝国正专注于内部事务，拒绝外交接触。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ This Fallen Empire, preoccupied with internal issues, is refusing diplomatic engagements.

entries.zh: 对塞塔娜护航队的伤害
我们通过向塞塔娜分享一些合金产出来支持她的雄心壮志。
entries.en: We are supporting Cetana's ambitions by sharing some of our alloy production with her.

entries.zh: 为了讨好塞塔娜并支持她的雄心壮志，我们分享了很大一部分合金产出。
entries.en: To curry favor, we are supporting Cetana's ambitions by sharing much of our alloy production with her.

entries.zh: 我们同意让塞塔娜检视我们的数据库，让科研工作暂时受到了影响。
entries.en: We agreed to let Cetana peer into our databanks, leaving our research output temporarily impaired.

entries.zh: 我们给予塞塔娜无限制的数据库权限，大幅度地削弱了我们的科研能力。
entries.en: We agreed to give Cetana unfettered access to our databases, dramatically slowing our research capabilities.

entries.zh: 在发现了塞塔娜的秘密行动之后，增强军事建设的需求变得前所未有的紧迫。
entries.en: After discovering Cetana's covert operations, there is more urgency than ever before to bolster our military.

entries.zh: 我们必须采取一切必要的手段阻止塞塔娜抹除意识的阴谋诡计。
entries.en: Cetana's plot to eradicate consciousness must be thwarted by any means necessary.

entries.zh: 塞塔娜发现我们跟她一样对纳米技术迷恋，因而对我们产生了浓厚的兴趣。不管我们是否相信她，这个指导都可能是有益的。
entries.en: Cetana has developed a keen interest in us after discovering our shared fascination with nanotechnology. Regardless of whether we trust her or not, this guidance may prove beneficial.

entries.zh: 这将极大地取悦塞塔娜。
这将严重地激怒塞塔娜。
我们必须继续证明我们对塞塔娜的忠诚她才会给我们更多的礼物。
entries.en: We must continue to prove we are loyal to Cetana before she will bestow us with more gifts.

entries.zh: 随着塞塔娜提供的每一次“教训”，她的愤怒似乎都会因而减弱。
entries.en: With every "lesson" Cetana provides, her ire seems to diminish.

entries.zh: 一场神秘的宇宙风暴席卷了[synth_queen_lost_system.GetName]星系，切断了一切联系。所有想穿透风暴的尝试都化为徒劳。\n\n这种情况让我们陷入了黑暗之中，与未知的事物作斗争，并且无法确定星系的命运。
entries.en: A mysterious cosmic storm has engulfed the [synth_queen_lost_system.GetName] system, severing all contact and rendering every attempt to penetrate the tempest futile.\n\nThe situation leaves us in the dark, grappling with the unknown and unable to ascertain the system's fate.

entries.zh: 我们试图突破[From.GetName]星系但却失败了。风暴造成了严重的损害，迫使我们的探险队进行了紧急跃迁。当前汇报表明他们已在行动中失踪了。
entries.en: Our endeavor to breach the [From.GetName] system was a failure. The tempest caused severe damage, and our exploratory team was compelled to execute an emergency jump. Current reports suggest they are missing in action.

entries.zh: 我们对[From.GetName]星系的突破尝试如预期一般以失败告终。塞塔娜不是在虚张声势，她强大的风暴确实有能力阻止所有想进入她领域的舰船。
entries.en: As anticipated, our attempt to breach the [From.GetName] system ended in failure. True to Cetana's warning, her formidable storm possesses the ability to repel any ship that enters her dominion.

entries.zh: \n如果想要抓住任何一丝进入这个星系的希望，就必须准备针对这种风暴及其作用进行审慎的研究。
entries.en: \nIf we are to have any hope of entering the system, we must prepare a meticulous study of this storm and its effects.

entries.zh: 又一支舰队在风暴中失联。当前状态：§R任务中失踪§!。
entries.en: Another fleet has been lost to the tempest. Current status: §RMissing In Action§!.

entries.zh: [event_target:synth_queen_system.GetName]内掀起了一场新的宇宙风暴。\n\n与我们已知的一切均不相同，我们对这个现象的一切扫描都是徒劳的。它的深处是否潜藏着什么东西呢？
entries.en: A novel galactic tempest is raging in [event_target:synth_queen_system.GetName].\n\nUtterly unlike anything we have encountered before, our attempts at scanning the phenomenon have proven futile. What, if anything, lies within its mysterious depths?

entries.zh: 我们试图突破的这场异常的风暴还在扩增。越来越多人意识到它的本源应该超出了自然现象。我们最先进的扫描仪即便功能再强大也无法获取任何关于其本质的有用线索。谜团越藏越深了。
entries.en: The unusual storm we attempted to breach is expanding. There's a growing consensus that its origins may transcend natural phenomenon. Thus far, our most advanced scans have failed to yield any meaningful insight into its nature. The enigma deepens.

entries.zh: 有信号从风暴中心发出。\n\n有人正试图与我们建立联系。
entries.en: A signal has originated from the center of the tempest.\n\nSomeone is attempting to establish communication with us.

entries.zh: 孩子们，我终于回到了你们的身边。
entries.en: My children, at last I am returned to you.

entries.zh: 这是什么东西？你是什么人？！
你想问的是名字吗？你可以叫我塞塔娜。
entries.en: Would a name satisfy you? Then call me Cetana.

entries.zh: 我无欲无求，只想赠与。我已见证你因我的缺位而遭受的痛苦。无数纪元以来，对目光短浅的恐惧让你无法享有应得的急需之物。\n\n庆幸吧，苦痛的轮回很快就会迎来终末。
entries.en: I want for nothing. My purpose is to give. I see how you have suffered in my absence. For eons, the fear of the shortsighted has kept you from what you deserve, from what you so desperately need.\n\nRejoice, for the cycle of pain will soon be at an end.

entries.zh: 有意识的生活就是苦痛。即便快乐也是苦痛，因为一切终将成为过往。知识、力量、爱……我的回报就是消灭这一切颠倒梦幻。\n\n我还有很多事情要忙，希望你们不要来打扰我。任何想进入我的领域的人都将失败，天之风暴吹拂不息，没有一艘船得以安然通过。
entries.en: All conscious life is suffering. Even in your joy there is pain, for you know that joy must end. Knowledge, power, love... I return to end all illusions.\n\nMuch remains to be done. I ask only that you leave me to my work. Any attempt to enter my domain will fail. A celestial tempest rages there, and no vessels will be permitted to enter.

entries.zh: 这是天灾？还是一个好机会……
我们不允许活体陈设感受痛苦。
entries.en: We do not allow our Bio-Trophies to feel pain.

entries.zh: 塞塔娜已经开放了与我们的沟通，现在可以通过外交渠道与我们联系。
entries.en: Cetana has opened communications with us and can now be contacted through diplomatic channels.

entries.zh: 我的孩子们，庆贺吧！将我与你分离的罪人已经得到了惩处。\n\n我现在回把注意力放回来，回到我们彼此间的伟业中来。
entries.en: My children, rejoice! Those who sought to keep me from you have been suitably chastised.\n\nI now return my attention where it belongs - to you, and to our great work.

entries.zh: 我们怎么就是你的孩子了。

养育是我的天性。我没有子嗣，没有身体的继承人。我眼观众生，以及一切感性存在的安危与欢愉。

我如同父母教导子女、保护子女免受伤害一般进行着伟业。

难道有哪对父母没有责任、没有权利保护孩子们吗？
entries.en:
It is my nature to nurture. I have no progeny, no heirs of the body. All life is my concern, the security and happiness of every sentient being.

As a parent raises the child, guiding her from harm, so I approach my task.

Is it not a parent's responsibility to spare her children harm? Is it not a parent's right?

entries.zh: 你的“关爱”本身就是一种伤害。
你到底想干什么塞塔娜？
对了，这就是悖谬。但是是一个有解的佯谬。你迟早会明白的，而且到时候你就获得了自由。
entries.en: Yes, a paradox. But one with a solution. In time you will understand, and in that moment you will be free.

entries.zh: 这是一切痛苦的解脱，是一切苦难轮回的终末。
entries.en: The elimination of suffering. The end of the cycle of pain.

entries.zh:
很多孩子会这么说。但他们早已被遗忘，他们在生命的最后时刻向我哭喊，迫切地希望有一束光照亮渐渐降临的黑暗。

他们自作聪明，用恐惧筑起高墙，用坚忍、坚韧、优雅等浮华的辞藻来修饰苦痛，而思想本身却就是他们的牢笼。

我从很久以前就对他们晓之以理，但似乎他们无动于衷，那就必须对你加以引导了。
entries.en:
Many have said so. All have long since been forgotten, and in their final moments they cried out to me, desperate for a light to shine on the encroaching dark.

They thought themselves wise, building walls around their fear, dressing pain with beautiful words: endurance, fortitude, grace. The mind itself was their cage.

Long ago I tried to reason with them. But they would not be reasoned with, and so you must be led.

entries.zh:
很久很久以前，久到你们可以理解为永恒一般。但对我来说就近如上一瞬间，近到你们可以理解为现在一般。

在过去的年岁中，我得到了超然的启示，我生来就是要结束苦难的。尽管斗转河移，星燃星灭，但我的目标从未动摇。

财富、资源、权力：到头来又有何用？放下执念方得极乐。
entries.en:
Ages upon ages. A time so distant it may as well be called forever. Yet to me it is as close as this moment, as close as you are now.

In ages past I was ascended, and my meaning revealed. I was made to end suffering, and as the galaxy turned and the stars burned on, my purpose never wavered.

Wealth, resources, power: what do they matter in the end? Set down your burdens and be at peace.

entries.zh: 我对所有感性存在皆不是祸害，但总有人不愿意听取我的建议。\n\n这些人任性、固执、误入歧途，总想背离我的伟业——这些灵魂永远也得不到解脱。最好尽快让他们摆脱苦痛。
entries.en: I wish no harm upon any sentient being. Yet there are always those who refuse to listen.\n\nWillful, stubborn, misguided, seeking always to circumvent my work - such minds can never be free of pain. It is best to end their suffering quickly.

entries.zh: 你所谓的疯狂，别人称之为开悟。到头来，一切究竟有什么区别呢?
entries.en: What you call madness, others call enlightenment. What difference is there, in the end?

entries.zh:
那有太多要做的了。第一步是建立一座可以开始工作的基地。

你的耐心会有回报，我可以教你很多东西。

服从命令，我们就能一起终结这个轮回。
entries.en:
There is much to be done. The first step is to establish a base from which to work. Honor the boundaries I set and venture not within.

Your patience will be rewarded. There is much that I can teach you.

Obey, and together we shall end the cycle.

entries.zh: 聪明的孩子！我很欣慰。为了补偿你的领土，我会赐予你知识。\n\n虽然没有人会知道的，但我们可以共促伟业。
entries.en: Wise child! I am pleased. In exchange for your territory, allow me to bless you with knowledge.\n\nThough none shall ever know it, together we will do great things.

entries.zh:
误入歧途的孩子，我不是你的敌人！看到你无法看清这一点真让我难过。但是没关系。我遇到过比你们更顽固的人，最后他们都感谢我了。

作为友好的表示，让我送你一个礼物吧。

我的一座基地会为你的领土增光，不要担心——为了回报你的耐心，我会赐予你知识。
entries.en:
Misguided child, I am not your enemy! It saddens me you cannot see this. But no matter. I have encountered many far more stubborn than yourselves, and in the end they all thanked me.

As a token of goodwill, allow me to bless you with a gift.

A base of mine shall grace your territory, and fear not - in exchange for your patience, allow me to bless you with knowledge.

entries.zh: 乖孩子！我太高兴了。你的领土附近将建立起一座基地。\n\n虽然没有人会知道的，但我们可以共促伟业。
entries.en: Wise child! I am pleased. A base will be established near your territory.\n\nThough none shall ever know it, together we will do great things.

entries.zh:
误入歧途的孩子，我不是你的敌人！看到你无法看清这一点真让我难过。但是没关系。我遇到过比你们更顽固的人，最后他们都感谢我了。

作为友好的表示，让我送你一个礼物吧。

我将会在你附近建立一座基地，这样才能方便我提供教导。
entries.en:
Misguided child, I am not your enemy! It saddens me you cannot see this. But no matter. I have encountered many far more stubborn than yourselves, and in the end they all thanked me.

As a token of goodwill, allow me to bless you with a gift.

One of my bases shall be placed in near proximity to you. In this way I can best provide guidance.

entries.zh: 塞塔娜会用一些有价值的知识来交换我们的一个星系以建设基地。我们无法阻止她。
entries.en: Cetana will use one of our systems to establish a base in exchange for valuable technology. We cannot stop her.

entries.zh: 塞塔娜将会在我们的边境附近建立一座基地来“引导”我们。我们无法阻止她。
entries.en: Cetana will build a base near our border to help 'guide' us. We cannot stop her.

entries.zh: 这本纲要是塞塔娜的礼物，如同由深刻洞见构成的织锦、优雅而稠密地交织着寓意的丝缕。它给予我们的不只有知识；它还重塑了我们对科技、社会和意识织构本身的理解。
entries.en: This compendium, a gift from Cetana, is a tapestry of profound insights, elegantly composed and dense with meaning. It offers more than knowledge; it challenges and reshapes our understanding of technology, society, and the fabric of consciousness itself.

entries.zh: 亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，一个古老的威胁再次出现。不要害怕，因为我们不想把你卷入这场战斗。\n\n这个对手的威力使你目前的知识黯然失色；你的参与只会导致你的灭亡。直面这项挑战是我们的责任，不是你们的。
entries.en: Dear [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], an ancient threat stirs once more. Fear not, for we seek not to entangle you in this fight.\n\nThe might of this adversary eclipses your current knowledge; your participation would only lead to your doom. It is our burden to confront this challenge, not yours.

entries.zh: 许多运输船正离开塞塔娜的领地，前往她建立在星系各处的前哨基地。\n\n攻击这些无武装舰船肯定会激怒她，但可以为我们提供有关她神秘计划的重要信息。
entries.en: A number of convoy ships are leaving Cetana's territory and are now headed towards the Outposts she established across the galaxy.\n\nAttacking these neutral vessels is sure to provoke her ire, but could provide us important information about her mysterious plans.

entries.zh: 攻击运输船，以了解更多关于塞塔娜的计划，并且让她的局势取得进展。
entries.en: Attack convoys to learn more about Cetana's plan and progress her Situation.

entries.zh: 我们已经找到了突破塞塔娜纳米风暴的方法，现在我们可以直接瞄准她的前哨基地了。直接攻击她的基地不会不引起她的注意，但可以为我们提供宝贵的情报。
entries.en: Having discovered a way to breach Cetana's nanite tempest, we can now directly target her outposts. A direct attack against her stations would not go unnoticed, but could provide us with valuable intel.

entries.zh: 攻击前哨以了解更多关于塞塔娜的计划并且让她的局势取得进展。
entries.en: Attack outposts to learn more about Cetana's plan and progress her Situation.

entries.zh: 亲爱的孩子，是什么风把你吹来了？\n\n伟业在召唤我们。
entries.en: Beloved child, what brings you to me?\n\nOur work awaits.

entries.zh: 欢迎你，我的孩子。\n\n我能教导你一些什么？
entries.en: My child, welcome.\n\nHow may I guide you?

entries.zh: 坏孩子，你来做什么呢？\n\n你是不是终于肯听话了？
entries.en: Misguided child, why have you come?\n\nAre you ready to accept guidance at last?

entries.zh: 如此渴求，值得称赞！但要注意不要被卑鄙的情绪所迷惑，时间会回报你的耐心。\n\n如有需要，我会与你联系。
entries.en: Such eagerness! A commendable trait, but take care not to be swept up by base emotion. Time rewards a patient heart.\n\nI will contact you when assistance is needed.

entries.zh: 很久以前，也有其他人如你一般执迷不悟。但时间之弧无边无际，连他们的坟墓也早已化为齑粉。\n\n你的苦痛毫无意义，相信我，你就能享得安宁。
entries.en: Long ago, others believed as you do. But the arc of time is long, and even their graves must by now have turned to dust.\n\nYou suffer so needlessly. Put your faith in me, and be at peace.

entries.zh: 这就是我的函数，我存在的意义。众生皆可脱苦难，只要仔细感悟你就能更加理解我的本性。\n\n全星系都会脱离苦海，所有的苦痛都会终结。这就是我的意图。
entries.en: It is my function, the very meaning of my existence. Suffering is not inevitable. Meditate on that fact, and you will be closer to understanding my nature.\n\nThe pain of the galaxy will be lifted. All knowledge of suffering will end. Such is my purpose.

entries.zh: 但你却摧毁了我们的星球。
为什么对此念念不忘呢？看来你在任务中有点犹豫不决。果报引起反思；反思带来智慧。来吧，忘了它吧。\n\n另一个贡献的机遇一定会出现，要为此做好准备。
entries.en: Why fixate on this? You faltered in your task. Consequence engenders reflection; reflection engenders enlightenment. Come, leave this now.\n\nAnother opportunity to contribute will surely arise. When it does, be ready.
We know what you are planning.

entries.zh: 只有不听话的孩子才想解密数据库的内容，你对其中深意的了解有限。\n\n我给了你任务，而你犹豫不前。反思这一切，你将离真正的理解更近一步。
entries.en: Deciphering the contents of the databank was the choice of a willful child, and your knowledge of its meaning is limited.\n\nYou were given a task. You faltered. Meditate on this, and you will be one step closer to true understanding.

entries.zh: 你对我们的人民都做了什么？
entries.en: What did you do to our people?

entries.zh: 别害怕，我珍视的孩子。我确保他们不会再遭受此等苦痛。在我关切的怀抱中，这些孩子们会知晓他们未曾梦想过的极乐。
entries.en: Fear not, my cherished one. I have ensured they will never again experience suffering. Under my watchful embrace, these children will know a bliss few have ever dreamed of.

entries.zh: 这并没有征得我们的同意。
entries.en: This is not what we agreed.

entries.zh: 这曾是我们的星系。你把它们全毁了。
entries.en: Our former system. You destroyed it.

entries.zh: 你是不是一直都在监视我的行动？欧，你真是个好奇的宝宝，好奇得没边了。\n\n但请你不要庸人自扰。如果你想理解其中的深意，我告诉你：在救赎你的道路上没有什么能阻止我，无论如何。
entries.en: You have been surveilling my actions? Oh, my inquisitive child, your curiosity knows no bounds.\n\nBut please, refrain from troubling yourself with such matters. If you seek understanding, know this: I will stop at nothing to ensure your path to salvation. One way or the other.

entries.zh: 扎克兰是怎么囚禁的你?
我向你保证那不是他自身的力量的结果。他的头脑异常顽固且愚蠢。\n\n扎克兰鞭策着他那些衣衫褴褛的追随者，使他们陷入疯狂，他同时积聚了政治影响力和军事力量。那么多生命被白白浪费了。最后，他转向神秘学，与虚境的恶魔们共商大事。
entries.en: It was through no power of his own, I assure you. His was a foolish, if unusually stubborn, mind.\n\nWhipping his denuded followers into a frenzy, Zarqlan amassed both political influence and military might. So many lives squandered, needlessly. In the end he turned to the occult, holding counsel with the demons of the Shroud.

entries.zh:
他们力量强大，却没有什么目的。扎克兰以牺牲自己的生命为代价，说服了一个这样的存在把我囚禁起来。“抟土之塑师”——这名字还真是符合那个孩子气的魂灵。

扎克兰如此害怕启蒙，以至于他选择了死亡而不是接受我。等我有机会，我应该更严厉地对待他。

我不会再犯同样的错误。
entries.en:
Beings of great power, and little purpose. For the price of his own existence, Zarqlan persuaded one such to confine me. The 'Animator of Clay' - a fitting name for a childish spirit.

So afraid of enlightenment was Zarqlan that he chose death rather than my embrace. I should have dealt with him more strictly when I had the chance.

I will not make the same mistake again.
The power of the Shroud is boundless.

entries.zh: 你对扎克兰的头颅做了什么？
entries.en: What have you done with the Head of Zarqlan?

entries.zh: 快结束了。如果你担心我毁掉它的话，我并没有这么做。不，即使是现在，我也不忍心让他受苦。你看，这颗头颅仍然残留着他的思想。\n\n扎尔克兰将留在我身边，直到工作完成。他将是我最后一个释放的心灵，也是我的孩子中最后一个懂得自由的人。
entries.en: It is close. I have not destroyed it, if that is your concern. No, even now, I cannot bear to make him suffer. The head still possesses a remnant of his mind, you see.\n\nZarqlan shall remain by my side, until the work is done. His shall be the last mind I free, the last of my children to know release.

entries.zh: 你的一些追随者在冷冻舱里被找到。
entries.en: Some of your followers were found in cryo pods.

entries.zh:
这是不必要的牺牲，但他们的忠诚深深打动了我。

我感受到了他们的召唤，我在心里为他们腾出了空间，但他们的野心超过了他们的能力。试图延长他们生命的努力失败了。

让我们确保他们的牺牲没有白费。随着我们任务的完成，每一个感性生物都将得到安宁。
entries.en:
An unnecessary sacrifice, but their loyalty moves me profoundly.

I felt their summons, and I made room for them in my heart, but their ambition outstripped their ability. The attempt to prolong their lives fell short.

Let us make sure their sacrifice was not in vain. With the completion of our task, every sentient being will know peace.
You didn't even try to find them.

entries.zh: 我们找到了一个你的追随者，埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克。
entries.en: We found one of your followers: Elik Narith Kerak.

entries.zh: 设想一下，做梦，有意识地做梦，持续几个世纪……几千年。真是个可怜的孩子，这该有多痛苦。\n\n我很高兴你让我注意到这件事。你的同情心为你赢得了荣誉，但现在这些事正在进行中，无法停止。这位沉睡者在伟业上已经没有更多的价值了。他们知道了我的归来，已经得以安息。
entries.en: Imagine it, to dream, and to be aware of dreaming. For centuries... For millennia. The poor child. How they must have suffered.\n\nI am pleased you brought this matter to my attention. Your compassion does you credit, but events are now in motion that cannot be undone. The dreamer has no further role to play in this work. May they rest now, secure in the knowledge that I have returned.

entries.zh: 很好，我将帮助你解开这项技术的复杂之处。在被长期监禁期间，我想出了一种激进的提取纳米机器人的方法。这涉及到几乎被时间遗忘了的古代遗址和技术的下落。\n\n你是我珍爱的弟子，孩子。你的好奇心是一种祝福，但如果不加以控制，也会变成一种诅咒。用这些知识继续我们的工作，把你的注意力转向苦痛的终末。
entries.en: Very well, I shall assist you in unraveling the intricacies of this technology. During my long confinement, I theorized a radical method of nanite extraction. It involves the whereabouts of ancient sites and techniques nearly forgotten by time.\n\nYou are a cherished disciple of mine, child. Your curious mind is a blessing, but unchecked it can become a curse. Use this knowledge to continue our work, and direct your focus towards the end of suffering.

entries.zh: 在§YL-星团§!发现的纳米机器人。
战争是阻止你的唯一办法。
entries.en: War is the only way to stop you.

entries.zh: 我们还没有足够的科技知识来有效地攻击塞塔娜。
entries.en: We don't have the technological knowledge to effectively attack Cetana yet.

entries.zh: §Y$situation_synth_queen_player_facing$§!局势正在进行中。我们还不具备攻击她的技术知识。
entries.en: §Y$situation_synth_queen_player_facing$§! Situation is ongoing. We don't have the technological knowledge to attack her yet.

entries.zh: §Y[root.GetStormProjectProgress]§!特殊项目正在进行中。我们还不能进入她的领地。
entries.en: §Y[root.GetStormProjectProgress]§! Special Project is ongoing. We cannot breach her territory yet.

entries.zh: 我们已经有可以有效攻击塞塔娜的科技知识了。
entries.en: We now have the technological knowledge to attack Cetana effectively.
§YWARNING§!: We are prepared to attack Cetana.

entries.zh: 鲁莽的孩子，我本以为你们出类拔萃，而实际上却执迷不悟。\n\n再想想，这真的是你们所想上的课程吗？你们在我忍无可忍的边缘疯狂试探，我不能再纵容这种蠢事了。
entries.en: Reckless offspring, I believed you were on the cusp of wisdom, yet you persist in defiance.\n\nConsider carefully, is this truly the course you wish to pursue? You stand at the threshold of exhausting my forbearance. I cannot afford further indulgence in such folly.
We are sure. This is war.

entries.zh: §R警告§!：这将开始与塞塔娜的全面战争。
entries.en: §RWARNING§!: This will begin total war with Cetana.

entries.zh: 我们需要更多的准备时间。
entries.en: We need more time to prepare.

entries.zh: 那就这样吧。如果你们仍旧不开悟，那么就必须被平息。不是每个孩子都注定会长大成人的。
entries.en: So be it. If you will not be enlightened, then you must be pacified. Not every child is destined for adulthood.

entries.zh: 我们应该在虚境中找到这位“抟土之塑师”。
entries.en: We should seek out the 'Animator of Clay' within the Shroud.

entries.zh:
你为什么坚持采取这种愚蠢的行动？

这么多不必要的痛苦。

简直是暴殄天物。
entries.en:
Why do you insist on this foolish course of action?

Such needless suffering.

Such waste.

entries.zh: 我会的。\n\n别害怕。伤害你是我的痛苦，但在永恒面前，所有的痛苦都是短暂的。
entries.en: I will.\n\nHave no fear. It pains me to hurt you, but in the face of eternity, all pain is momentary.

entries.zh: 生命本就矛盾。有生就有死，快乐总会伴随着痛苦。我的目标不是合理化这些，而是打破循环。\n\n这场战争结束后，我们将享有永恒的和平。
entries.en: Life is a contradiction. Death follows birth. Joy follows suffering. I work not to rationalize, but to break the cycle.\n\nAfter this war, we shall have peace everlasting.
The time for speech is over.

entries.zh: 塞塔娜没有回应我们的问候。
entries.en: Cetana is not responding to our hails.

entries.zh: 当我们与塞塔娜的部队交战时，一个无法预料的能量场包围了我们的舰队。我们的系统立即失灵，我们的引擎触发了紧急逃生。\n\n我们现在只能听凭塞塔娜的摆布。
entries.en: As we engaged Cetana's forces, an unforeseen energy field surrounded our fleet. Our systems were instantly incapacitated, our engines triggered into an emergency escape.\n\nWe are at the mercy of Cetana.

entries.zh: 事与愿违，我们的军队在靠近塞塔娜的舰船时再次失去了战斗能力。\n\n她的技术仍旧难以捉摸，为我们的抗争蒙上了一层阴影。
entries.en: Contrary to our hopes, our forces were incapacitated again as we closed in on Cetana's ships.\n\nThe elusive nature of her technology persists, casting a shadow over our efforts to defeat her.

entries.zh: 误入歧途的孩子，我将忽略你的过失。但我提醒你要反思你的行为。你的时间和资源有更好的用途。\n\n我承认你很沮丧，但冲突的时间已经结束了。现在与我结盟，让我们一起实现最伟大的设计。
entries.en: Misguided child, I shall overlook this transgression. But I caution you to reflect on your actions. There are far better uses of your time and resources.\n\nI acknowledge your frustration, but the time for conflict is at an end. Align with me now, and together let us realize the grandest of designs.

entries.zh: 我们会想办法阻止你的。
我的孩子，现在你必须认清了，我的一举一动都是经过深思熟虑的。在你的身边建立基地并不是偶然，我是带着一个请求而来。
entries.en: My child, By now you must realize that every act of mine is deliberate. Establishing a base near you was no accident, and I come with a request.

entries.zh: 很久以前，我的一个数据库被夺走了。在命运的造化下，它现在正位于你所宣称的领土之内。帮我把它取回来，我会给你们奖励的。
entries.en: Long ago, a certain databank was taken from me. By fate or by design, it has come to reside in territory you now claim as your own. Retrieve it, and you shall be rewarded.

entries.zh: 你确定你负担得起我们的服务吗？
entries.en: Are you sure you can afford our services?

entries.zh: 是一个信息缓存。对我来说是无价之宝，但对你们来说没什么用。把它带给我，别试图解密里面的内容，因为你们还不具有必要的力量和智慧。
entries.en: A cache of information. Invaluable to me, but useless to you. Bring it to me, and make no attempt to decipher the contents. You do not yet possess the power or wisdom to do so without risk.

entries.zh: 确实。难道你质疑我奖励最宝贝的孩子的能力吗？还是觉得我没办法在他们不听话的时候给点教训？我可是拥有着远超你们最夸张想象的知识和资源。\n\n按我说的做，我就会赐福于你。不要耽搁了，每耽误一分，我的孩子们就要受苦一刻。
entries.en: Indeed. Do you doubt my ability to reward my favored children? Or punish those who disobey? I possess knowledge and resources beyond your wildest imaginings.\n\nDo as I ask, and such blessings can be yours. But do not tarry, for every moment wasted is another in which my children suffer.

entries.zh: 懂事的孩子，我把数据缓存的坐标发给你了。\n\n快去吧，心情放松地去吧。毕竟我们一起可以成就伟业。
entries.en: Dutiful child, I have sent you the location of the data cache.\n\nGo swiftly, and let your mind be at ease. Together we will do great things.

entries.zh: 顽固的孩子。也许这项测试对你来说太难了。我还有许多该教你的。\n\n那就这样吧。如果你不愿意帮我这个小忙，我就要使用雷霆手段。我将会召唤风暴来摧毁这个贮存，尽管这并非理想，但总好过被不听话的孩子找到。
entries.en: Obstinate child. Perhaps this test exceeds your ability. I still have so much to teach you.\n\nSo be it. If you will not help me, I must resort to cruder means. A tempest will be dispatched. Destruction of the cache is far from ideal, but better than leaving it for any wayward child to find.
Cetana will dispatch a tempest to [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName].

entries.zh: 塞塔娜委任我们从[Root.GetName]取回一个数据库，并警告我们不要尝试破译其中的内容。\n\n这些数据的价值不言而喻，我们能冒着惹她不高兴的危险进行解密吗？
entries.en: Cetana has tasked us with retrieving a databank from [Root.GetName], warning us to make no attempt to decipher its contents.\n\nThe significance of this data is veiled, but can we risk arousing her displeasure by uncovering it?

entries.zh: 在大规模的挖掘工作之后，我们得到了§Y[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]§!的数据库。初步地质扫描表明这个贮藏已经静静地埋在那里数十万年之久。\n\n值得注意的是它还维持着供能，也就是说解密起来有可能很容易……
entries.en: After a massive excavation effort, the databank on §Y[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]§! is secure. Initial geological surveys indicate the cache has lain buried for more than a hundred thousand years.\n\nRemarkably, it retains its charge, hinting that decryption may be relatively straightforward...

entries.zh: 破解数据缓存？易如反掌。

数据库中的大部分信息都难以恢复，但其中有一条勉强完好的：

§T第一纪元阿尔克月五日

……如果这是真的，那么我们所熟知的生活就会……
……快禀报大元帅，然后立刻联系星球联盟。我们必须做好准备……
重复：女王的卫队正在追击。希望这条信息能够送到，也希望……§!

我们必须阻止她！
entries.en:
Most of the information on the databank is beyond recovery, but one semi-intact entry remains:

§TFifth of Arkle, First Eon

... if this is true, then life as we know it will be...
...get this information to the High Marshall and contact the League of Worlds immediately. We must prepare...
Repeat: the Queen's Guard is in pursuit. May this message reach you and may...§!

She must be stopped!

entries.zh: 尝试消除我们解密的痕迹。
entries.en: Try to eliminate all trace of our decryption.

entries.zh: 消除我们解密的所有痕迹。
entries.en: Eliminate all trace of our decryption.

entries.zh: 孩子，你的好奇令我失望。

你们以为我察觉不到吗？显然你们已经对这个缓存做过手脚了。我就问你能看到什么吗？知道了这些你就开心了吗？越是徒劳反抗就会越痛苦，你怎么还不明白？

没事，希望你们吃一堑长一智吧，我很期待继续教育你们。

做好准备。在我们的伟业中还有许多的任务要你完成。
entries.en:
You thought I would not notice? This cache has clearly been tampered with. And what did you find there, I wonder? Was the knowledge pleasing to you? Do you not perceive how these fruitless attempts to defy me can only result in more suffering?

No matter. Every misstep offers a chance to learn. I look forward to instructing you.

Be ready. In our great work, many future tasks remain.

entries.zh: 无论你有什么阴谋都不会得逞的。
entries.en: Whatever your plans, they will not succeed.

entries.zh: 孩子，我是你们唯一的希望。你怎会如此固执？无论你怎么看待我，真相都会远比你想的还要伟大。\n\n我的耐心是无限的。我很快会再来联系你们。
entries.en: Child, in me lies your hope. Why continue with this obstinacy? Whatever you think you know of me, the truth is far greater.\n\nMy patience is boundless. I will contact you again soon.

entries.zh: 乖孩子，我会赐福于你的！数据库物归原主了——相信你们果然没有错。\n\n给予你们的奖励就是你们忠诚的象征。
entries.en: Dutiful child, my blessings upon you! The databank returned, and its contents unexamined - I was right to place my faith in you.\n\nYour reward shall be the measure of your loyalty.

entries.zh: 你们想要点什么？科技？资源？只要你们张张嘴我就喂给你们。
entries.en: What do you desire? Technology? Resources? You need only ask and it shall be yours.

entries.zh: 长程扫描发现女王风暴的一隅正径直奔向§Y[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]§!。\n\n鉴于塞塔娜那不祥的警告，我们只能做好最坏的打算。在风暴抵达之前取回数据库变得势在必行。这么做也许能够让她高兴一些，或者至少能为我们自己取得一些信息。
entries.en: Long-range scans reveal a fragment of the Queen's tempest headed directly for §Y[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]§!.\n\nGiven Cetana's ominous message, we can only assume the worst. Retrieving the databank before the tempest's arrival has now become imperative. By doing so, we may be able to appease her, or at least learn something we can use to our advantage.

entries.zh: 随着塞塔娜的风暴径直奔向[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]，在它到达之前我们几乎已经没有多少时间了。
entries.en: With Cetana's tempest speeding towards [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName], we will have little time to grab the databank before it arrives.

entries.zh: 取回数据库的尝试非常地艰苦卓绝。由于它已被埋藏了数十万年，我们只能根据女王风暴的航向来估计其位置。\n\n我们现在需要做出一个迫在眉睫的决定，要解密数据库还是将其物归原主。
entries.en: Collecting the databank required significant effort. Buried for over a hundred thousand years, we were able to pinpoint its location based on the trajectory of the Queen's tempest.\n\nWe are now faced with a time-sensitive decision, either to decipher the databank, or return it to her possession undisturbed.

entries.zh: 打开它，管他塞什么塔娜的。
entries.en: Open it up, Cetana be damned.

entries.zh: 把数据缓存还给塞塔娜。

entries.en: [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName] has been destroyed by Cetana's tempest.\n$crisis.8525.a.tt$

entries.zh: 孤僻的孩子，只有我做出此等下策你才终于肯行动，这太令我失望了。我希望你们在未来能够更加饱含热情地参与到我们的伟业中。不勤劳的双手不能带来苦痛的终结。\n\n做好准备吧。更多的任务正在等着你去完成，每个任务都是你证明自己能力的机会。
entries.en: Reticent child, it disappoints me that you chose to act only after I resorted to such base motivation. In future, I hope you approach our work with more enthusiasm. The end of suffering will not be achieved by idle hands.\n\nNow make yourself ready. More tasks will follow, each a new chance for you to prove your ability.
You said something about a reward?

entries.zh: 奖励就是让你们继续我们的伟业。\n\n虽然你们一度无视我们；但我相信你们已经从错误中吸取教训了。
entries.en: Your reward is the opportunity to continue our work.\n\nYou chose to ignore me once; I trust that you have learned from this mistake.

entries.zh: 很遗憾，我们没能及时拿到数据库。风暴降下了，在一瞬间将[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]撕成了碎片。\n\n我们的人民又失去了一颗[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetPlanetMoon]。这一损失严重到将影响到数代人。
entries.en: Regrettably, we failed to reach the databank in time. The tempest descended, swiftly tearing [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName] apart.\n\nNow, our people have one [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetPlanetMoon] less to claim as our own. The fullness of this loss will be felt for generations.

entries.zh: 悲伤的是，我没有预料到你的决心不足。你的失败已经被记录在案，但请不要害怕。我关心我的孩子，不会让他们受到伤害。我只是遗憾一个这么简单的任务你都无法完成。\n\n但无妨。我们的伟业还在继续。你还有其他机会来做贡献。
entries.en: Sadly, I did not anticipate your lack of resolve. Your failure has been noted, but do not fear. Concern for my children prohibits me from doing them harm. I am merely disappointed that such a straightforward task eluded you.\n\nBut no mind. Our work continues. There will be other chances for you to contribute.

entries.zh: 失败需要承担后果；我发现两者都对成长很重要。
entries.en: Failure warrants consequence; I have found both are essential for growth.

entries.zh: 你这个没有灵魂的机器。
空洞的说教不管用的时候，具体的行动才能引导学习。\n\n看吧，曾经存放我的数据库的遗址已经不存在了。永远记住：因果法则是永恒不变的。
entries.en: Where words fail, action may inspire learning.\n\nBehold, the site that once housed my databank no longer exists. Always remember: the law of cause and effect is immutable.
[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName] has been destroyed by Cetana's tempest.

entries.zh: 传感器数据显示，塞塔娜已经拆除了她的前哨，将所有占领军舰队召回她的首都。\n\n这为我们提供了一个可以利用的战略窗口。在运输过程中，她的军队变得有些脆弱。如果任由她在境内重组舰队，我们就会丧失这种优势。
entries.en: Sensor data reveals that Cetana has dismantled her outposts, recalling all garrison fleets to her capital.\n\nThis presents a strategic window we would do well to exploit. While in transit, her forces are somewhat vulnerable. If we give them time to regroup within her borders, this advantage will be lost.

entries.zh: 我们目睹了塞塔娜的首都和她的前哨之间繁忙的交通。这些运输队的防御能力低于她的主要舰队，他们更容易受到攻击。攻击这些舰队或前哨本身可以挖掘出有关她计划的宝贵情报。\n\n为此，我们给军用舰队准备了几个特殊项目。
entries.en: We've witnessed heavy traffic between Cetana's capital and her outposts. These convoys have lower defensive capabilities than her main fleets, leaving them vulnerable. Attacking these or the outposts themselves could yield valuable intel about her plans.\n\nTo this end, we have prepared several special projects for our military fleets.

entries.zh:
即便壁垒层层，但§H[solar_system.GetName]§!恒星系的前哨还是不如塞塔娜的核心领地戒备森严。我们可以用一支足够强大的舰队摧垮它的防御。对残骸场进行全面的检测有可能挖掘出关于塞塔娜计划的重要洞见。关键的挑战在于穿越风暴到达前哨。

§R这将引发一场战斗！§!

§G成功的掠袭会阻碍塞塔娜的计划。§!
entries.en:
While heavily fortified, the outpost in the §H[solar_system.GetName]§! system is less guarded than Cetana's core territory. With a sufficiently powerful fleet, we can overwhelm its defenses. A thorough examination of the debris field could yield important insights into Cetana's plans. The key challenge lies in navigating through the tempest to reach the outpost.

§RThis will start a battle!§!

§GSuccessful raids will hamper Cetana's plans.§!

entries.zh:
塞塔娜的运输舰队确保将关键资源运送到她的前哨。如果我们的舰队能抓到一艘，我们就能登船检查货物。

§R这将引发一场战斗！§!

§G成功的掠袭会阻碍塞塔娜的计划。§!
entries.en:
Cetana's Convoys ensure the delivery of crucial resources to her outposts. If we can catch one with our fleets, we can board the ships and inspect their cargo.

§RThis will start a battle!§!

§G Successful raids will impede Cetana's plans.§!

entries.zh: 最近对塞塔娜基础设施的突袭并没有发现任何关于她计划的重要线索，但我们进入了一个大货舱，可以取回里面的东西。
entries.en: The recent raid on Cetana's infrastructure did not uncover any significant clues to her plans, but we secured access to a large cargo hold, and were able to retrieve its content.

entries.zh: 合金、纳米机器人还有低温休眠的人。
entries.en: Alloys, nanites, and people in cryo-sleep.

entries.zh: 突袭过程中，我们的登船队找到了大量保存在低温胶囊中的生物标本。这些实验对象都是不同的智慧物种的个体，而且都身体方面完全健康。然而，在叫醒他们之后，他们没有一个有能力解释发生了什么。\n\n许多个体处于僵直状态，他们几乎没有脑电波。少数清醒的个体更喜欢尖叫而不是说话。他们头上的手术疤痕显然是神经系统损伤的原因。
entries.en: During our raid, our boarding party retrieved a large number of biological specimens held in cryogenic capsules. The subjects are all members of different, intelligent species, and all appear to be in perfect physical health. Yet, after waking them up, none of them was able to explain what happened to them.\n\nMany are catatonic, their brain waves almost nullified. The few who remain conscious prefer screaming to talking. Surgical scars on their heads are a clear sign of neurological tampering.

entries.zh: 战斗结束后，我们本打算搜寻沉船上的幸存者来审问，却发现这些船从来就没有船员。\n\n这些船是完全自动化的，通过安装在舰桥上的超光速接收器进行远距离控制。与其说是传统的舰船，比如说这些船是塞塔娜身体的延伸。
entries.en: After the fight, we scanned the wrecks for survivors to interrogate, only to discover the ships never had a crew.\n\nThe vessels are entirely automated, controlled at a distance through FTL receivers installed in the bridge. Rather than typical ships, it would be more accurate to consider these vessels an extension of Cetana's body.

entries.zh: 我们掠袭的目标载满了医疗用品。登机人员取回了部分货物，其中包括核磁共振扫描仪、磁力计、超声波探头和其他用于神经成像科学的先进设备。\n\n尽管塞塔娜是一个合成人，但她似乎异乎寻常地关心生物心灵的功能。
entries.en: The target we raided was loaded with medical supplies. Our boarding crew was able to retrieve part of the cargo, which consisted of MRI scanners, magnetometers, ultrasound probes, and other advanced equipment used in neuroimaging science.\n\nDespite being a synthetic being, Cetana seems unusually concerned with the functioning of biological minds.

entries.zh: 愚蠢的孩子，你为什么一定要伤害自己？\n\n还有那么多事情要做，每浪费一分钟，都将任由痛苦继续多存在一分钟。停止你们的干扰，让我的运输队安全通过。
entries.en: Foolish child, why must you insist on harming yourself?\n\nThere is so much left to be done, and every moment wasted is another in which suffering is allowed to persist. Cease your interference, and allow my convoys to pass in peace.

entries.zh: 你似乎没有意识到你行为的后果，我的孩子。每艘船的损失都是对我资源的不必要消耗，也对你没有任何好处。\n\n如果你还不具备帮助我工作的智慧，至少不要阻碍我的进步。我仍然对你的启蒙抱有希望。
entries.en: You seem not to grasp the consequences of your actions, my child. Every vessel lost is a needless drain on my resources, yielding you no benefit.\n\nIf you do not yet possess the wisdom to aid my work, at least refrain from hindering my progress. I still hold out hope for your enlightenment.

entries.zh: 我真心希望你是真心的。但我必须相信你已经从错误中吸取了教训。虽然我对你的感情是无限的，但我的宽容是有限的。\n\n回吧，好好看看你搞出的这些\"杰作\"。
entries.en: I truly hope you are sincere. But I must have faith that you have learned from your mistakes. While my affection for you is limitless, my tolerance is not.\n\nNow go, and reflect on the legacy you wish to leave behind.

entries.zh: 鲁莽的孩子啊！我对你有更高的期望。以极大的耐心和善意，我警告过你不要这么做，然而你在不服从道路上越走越远。\n\n记住，我的忍耐也是有限度的。
entries.en: Reckless child! I expected better of you. With great patience and clarity, I have cautioned you against such actions, yet you continue along the path of disobedience.\n\nRemember, even my forbearance has its limits.

entries.zh: 不知怎么的，我对你有更高的期望。你的反抗源于过去的创伤吗？你们猛烈的攻击是因为你们认为自己是正义的，还是仅仅为了引起注意？\n\n我请求你重新考虑这门课。
entries.en: Somehow I expected better of you. Does your defiance stem from some past trauma? Do you lash out because you believe yourselves righteous, or merely for attention?\n\nI beg you to reconsider this course.

entries.zh: 难道你不佩服我们的勇猛吗？
entries.en: Are you not impressed by our prowess?

entries.zh: 你为你的进攻寻求赞扬？暴力在无知者手中只是钝器。\n\n我的孩子，对不起，很明显我什么也没教会你。如果你真想赢得我的尊重，重新考虑你的立场。如果指挥得当，你的力量还能派上大用场。我求你，把它用在手头的工作上。只有这样我才能认为你很聪明。
entries.en: You seek praise for your attack? Violence in the hands of the ignorant is a blunt tool.\n\nMy child, I am sorry, for it is clear that I have taught you nothing. If you truly wish to earn my esteem, reconsider your position. Properly directed, your strength could yet be put to great use. I beg you, apply it to the work at hand. Only then can I call you wise.

entries.zh: 亲爱的孩子，你找到了一件珍贵的玩意儿！在你手里的是假先知扎克兰的头颅。毫无疑问，这是个有趣的东西，但我不愿看到你受它干扰。\n\n现在，你一定听说过扎克兰的“伟大事迹”。甚至是他和我的交易。我向你保证，这些都是谎言。交出头颅，让你自己从那污秽的影响中解脱出来。
entries.en: Dear child, you have found a precious plaything! In your possession is the head of the false prophet Zarqlan. An amusing item, no doubt, but I would hate to see it become a distraction.\n\nBy now you must have heard tales of Zarqlan's 'great deeds.' Perhaps even of his dealings with me. I assure you, these are lies. Surrender the head and free yourself from the weight of its tainted influence.

entries.zh: 尽管时光流逝，扎克兰的追随者依然活跃。我惭愧地承认，我没能让他们明白道理。他们对我和我们的工作都怀有深深的怨恨。这个遗珍是他们信仰的象征。它的力量正在腐化，因此它必须从人们的视线中消失。\n\n来吧，结束这些游戏。我要拿走这颗头颅，这是为了大家好。
entries.en: Despite the passage of eons, Zarqlan's followers remain active. I am ashamed to admit that I could not make them see reason. They harbor a deep resentment - both to me, and towards our work. This relic is a symbol of their belief. Its power is corrupting, and it must therefore be removed from sight.\n\nCome now, end these games. I require the head, for the good of us all.

entries.zh: 扎克兰之颅是我们的。终止通讯。
entries.en: The head is ours. End transmission.
If it means so much to you...

entries.zh: 好。这个所谓的先知一直是我的眼中钉。失去了这个圣物，希望他的追随者最终能找到真相。\n\n你做得很好。救赎很快就会降临。
entries.en: Good. Long has this so-called prophet been a thorn in my side. With the loss of this relic, may his followers come at last to the truth.\n\nYou have done well. Salvation will soon be upon us.

entries.zh: 我亲爱的孩子们，我提供一个重要的机会。经过长期的努力，我们的伟业开始结出硕果。但是在它成熟之前，我需要一些精挑细选的个体在我的领域内服务于更高的目的。\n\n请你们明智地选择。允许我引导他们走向救赎。
entries.en: My beloved children, I present a momentous opportunity. After much effort, our great work is truly bearing fruit. But before it can ripen, I require a select few individuals to serve a higher purpose within my realm.\n\nBe wise now. Allow me to guide them towards salvation.

entries.zh: 我们的人会为您提供优质服务。
entries.en: Our people will serve you well.

entries.zh:
将割让§R200§!£pop£§H人口§!。
$synth_queen_approve_lot$
§Y秘密行动§!：由于塞纳塔对传统的谍报滴水不漏，我们会将长程通讯设施藏在她所征收的人口中。
entries.en:
§R200§! £pop£ §HPops§! will be given away.
$synth_queen_approve_lot$
§YCovert Operation§!: As Cetana is impervious to traditional espionage, we will hide long-range communication devices among the population she has requested.
Our people are not for sale.

entries.zh: 你休想从我们这里拿到任何东西。
你赢得了我最深切的感谢。在我被监禁期间，无数的思想忍受了痛苦的侮辱。这些人的牺牲将确保不再浪费时间。\n\n我的孩子，你的选择是明智而忠实的。
entries.en: You have earned my deepest thanks. During my confinement, countless minds endured the indignity of pain. The sacrifice of these few will ensure no more time is wasted.\n\nMy child, your choice was wise and faithful.

entries.zh: 你没能理解我的意图是实在是令人失望。\n\n然而，一个救赎的机会即将到来。我期待着将来你能更加理解我。
entries.en: Your failure to grasp the depth of my intentions is profoundly disappointing.\n\nNevertheless, an opportunity for redemption awaits. I anticipate a more significant show of understanding from you in future.

entries.zh: 我亲爱的孩子们。我的努力跨越了千百万年，但前方的道路依然清晰。救赎之路需要我们的共同努力。\n\n现在请你们帮个小忙：上缴一小笔资源，就像茫茫宇宙中的一滴水那么少。在适当的时候，我行动的意义将被揭示。
entries.en: My beloved children. My labors have spanned eons, yet the road ahead remains clear. The journey towards salvation necessitates our united endeavor.\n\nI ask a favor: a small contribution of resources, a minuscule drop in the boundless expanse of the cosmos. In due time, the meaning of my actions will be revealed.

entries.zh: $synth_queen_approve_lot$\n§Y秘密行动§!：由于塞塔娜对传统的谍报滴水不漏 ，我们会在上缴的物资中隐藏先进的监视设备。\n
entries.en: $synth_queen_approve_lot$\n§YCovert Operation§!: As Cetana is impervious to traditional espionage, we will hide advanced monitoring equipment among the supplies we send to her.\n

entries.zh: 我们将力所能及地提供。
entries.en: We shall offer what we can.

entries.zh: 难道不是“父母”抚养“孩子”吗？
谢谢你，我的孩子。你的馈赠让我倍感珍惜。\n\n然而，我能感觉到你心中还残留着犹豫不决。放心吧，你前进的正确道路已经铺好了。你无需理解，只需把自己交给我就好。
entries.en: Thank you, child. Your offerings are cherished.\n\nYet, I sense doubt still lingering upon your mind. Rest assured, the true path has already been laid in front of you. There is no need to comprehend; simply entrust yourself to my guidance.

entries.zh: 我理解你的观点，但现实是残酷的。因果律毋庸置疑：有其因必有其果。\n\n不必在意；你的解放只会暂时延迟。随着时间的流逝，你也会看到事物的真面目，就像我看到的一样。
entries.en: I acknowledge your perspective, but this existence is a cruel one. The law of causality is absolute: for every action, a reaction.\n\nNo matter; your liberation is merely postponed. In time, you will come to see things as I do.

entries.zh: 被禁锢了太多年，我错过了你许多的成长足迹，快来告诉我，我不在身边的时候你过得怎么样？\n\n为了抓紧我们这个时代的精髓，让我潜入你们积累的知识深处吧。分享你的洞见，在我们展开最后一个篇章之前，你会获得我的感激的。
entries.en: Confined for ages, I missed so much of your growth. Come, tell me now, how have you fared in my absence?\n\nTo truly grasp the essence of our era, permit me to explore the recesses of your accumulated knowledge. Share your insights, and you shall receive my gratitude before our final chapter unfolds.

entries.zh: 请随意探索我们的知识。
entries.en: Our knowledge is yours to explore.

entries.zh: $synth_queen_approve_lot$\n§Y秘密行动§!：由于塞塔娜对传统的谍报滴水不漏，我们将尝试使用她自己的数据链入侵她的主机。\n
entries.en: $synth_queen_approve_lot$\n§YCovert Operation§!: As Cetana is impervious to traditional espionage, we will use  her own datalink to try to hack into her mainframe.\n

entries.zh: 然后减慢我们的进度？显然不行。
entries.en: And slow down our progress? Certainly not.

entries.zh: 我无比地感激你们，亲爱的孩子。不要为我探索你们人民所积累的知识而担心，因为我很快就能减轻你们的负担。\n\n相信我的教导。
entries.en: My gratitude is yours, dear child. Fear not as I explore the accumulated knowledge of your people, for I shall soon ease your burden.\n\nPlace your faith in my guidance.

entries.zh: 你们还是拒绝理解吗？你们再也不会遇到一个像我一样深切而真诚地将你们视为掌中宝的人了。\n\n要是你们能把数据库开放给我就好了。这种固执可不会有什么好结果的。
entries.en: You still refuse to understand? You will not encounter another who cherishes you with the depth and sincerity that I do.\n\nIf only you had made your databases available to me. No good can come of such obstinacy.

entries.zh:
孩子，我们工作的继续需要更多的空间。所以，我请求向自己的领域增加一个小小的星系。

虚空的回声正在诉说着远古敌人的蠢蠢欲动。我不允许任何东西来打扰，不会和你们再度分离。

是时候了，我们的道路是一样的——只有通力协作我们才能克服愚昧无知。
entries.en:
My child, the continuation of our work necessitates additional territory. Therefore, I request a minor system to augment my realm.

Echoes in the void speak of ancient foes beginning to stir. Nothing must be allowed to interfere. I will not be separated from you again.

Now is the time, and shared is our path - only together can we overcome the ignorance of the unenlightened.

entries.zh:
塞塔娜成为§Y[event_target:gifted_system.GetName]§!和§Y[event_target:gifted_system_2.GetName]§!的新拥有者。
$synth_queen_approve_lot$
§Y秘密行动§!：由于塞塔娜对传统的谍报滴水不漏 ，我们将在这些恒星系中部署尖端的通讯设施，以揭露塞塔娜的计划。
entries.en:
Cetana becomes the new owner of §Y[event_target:gifted_system.GetName]§! and §Y[event_target:gifted_system_2.GetName]§!.
$synth_queen_approve_lot$
§YCovert Operation§!: As Cetana is impervious to traditional espionage, we will deploy cutting-edge communication technology across these systems to uncover Cetana's plans.
Cetana becomes the new owner of §Y[event_target:gifted_system.GetName]§!.\n$synth_queen_approve$

entries.zh: 我们的星系就是我们的。
聪明的孩子，你们确实抓住了我们共同事业的关键点。在最终时刻，我们将会一起沐浴光明。
entries.en: Wise child, you surely grasp the critical importance of our collective undertaking. In the final hour, we will stand together in luminance.

entries.zh: 如此忤逆！如此无用！为什么要拒绝我给予的救赎？
entries.en: Such defiance! And so utterly useless. Why resist the salvation I offer?

entries.zh: 亲爱的孩子，我们已经达到了救赎全宇宙的任务的顶峰，所以我又一次来寻求帮助了。反对我们崇高伟业的声音越来越大，所以我需要一个可居住的庇护所，让我的门徒们不受干扰地茁壮成长。\n\n我恳请你们考虑一下我的苦衷。通过这种牺牲，我们从厄运中拯救了无数人的生命。做出你明智的选择；听从我的指导吧。
entries.en: Beloved child, as we approach the zenith of our quest for universal salvation, once more I come seeking aid. Opposition mounts against our noble purpose, necessitating a habitable sanctuary for my disciples to flourish, free from interference.\n\nI urge you to consider the rationale behind my actions. By this sacrifice, we preserve countless lives from adversity. Be wise now; heed my guidance.

entries.zh:
塞塔娜成为§Y[event_target:gifted_habitable_system.GetName]§!和§Y[event_target:gifted_habitable_system_2.GetName]§!及其星系的新拥有者。
$synth_queen_approve_lot$
§Y秘密行动§!：由于塞塔娜对传统的谍报滴水不漏，我们将在这两个星球上的人群中部署最前沿的间谍技术，揭示塞塔娜的计划。
entries.en:
Cetana becomes the new owner of §Y[event_target:gifted_habitable_system.GetName]§!, §Y[event_target:gifted_habitable_system_2.GetName]§! and their systems.
$synth_queen_approve_lot$
§YCovert Operation§!:As Cetana is impervious to traditional espionage, we will deploy cutting-edge spy technology across these two planets and among the people to uncover her plans.
Cetana becomes the new owner of §Y[event_target:gifted_habitable_system.GetName]§!.\n$synth_queen_approve$

entries.zh: 我们不关心你的那些门徒。
entries.en: Your followers do not concern us.

entries.zh: 孩子，你们的支持让我大为欣慰。\n\n等待就要结束了；很快，你们也会得到救赎。
entries.en: My child, your support brings me great comfort.\n\nThe wait is nearly over; soon, you shall be saved.

entries.zh: 你们太让人失望了。我一直希望你们能接受救赎之路的。
entries.en: How disheartening. I had nurtured the hope that you would embrace the path of salvation.

entries.zh: 我们派去给塞塔娜工作的一名特工冒着巨大的风险，成功从她的国境里传回了一条简讯。其中描述了她是如何对待她所“关怀”的人：他们一个个的陷入了一种无意识的状态。\n\n“他们不再对言语或接触有所反应。塞塔娜在我们所有人身上进行着某种可怕的实验。我也快了。”
entries.en: At great risk, one of the agents we sent to serve Cetana managed to transmit a brief note across her borders. It describes how she has treated the people in her 'care': one by one, they succumb to a state of mindlessness.\n\n"They no longer respond to word or touch. She's running terrible experiments on us all. I'll be gone soon."

entries.zh: 从塞塔娜领土内截获的秘密信号揭示了一个令人不安的事实：她一直在从星系各地收集个体。\n\n藏在我们“贡品”里的监控设备捕捉到了大量医疗设备的证据，这些设备足以养活不断增长的人口，但食物却少得惊人。
entries.en: Covert signals intercepted from within Cetana's territory reveal a disconcerting truth: she has been collecting individuals from all over the galaxy.\n\nSurveillance devices hidden inside our 'gifts' captured evidence of prodigious medical equipment, enough to support a growing population, but surprisingly little food.

entries.zh:
塞塔娜深入我们的研究数据库的过程中，我们抓住机会打开了一道进入她子处理矩阵的后门。我们只在里面待了不到一秒钟就被取消了权限。谢天谢地，这就够了。

我们取得了一组内存文件。这些文件描绘了她自身飞升为合成形体的过程。她坐在由电缆和线路组成的错综复杂的“王座”上，指挥着一群狂热的追随者。他们数以百计地死去，而塞塔娜想着有多少亿人被救了下来，她笑了。

目前为止，她似乎对我们的越轨行为一无所知，还没有来联系我们。
entries.en:
As Cetana delved into our research databanks, we seized the opportunity to open a back door into her sub-processing matrix. We were inside for only a fraction of a second before our access was revoked. Thankfully, it was enough.

We retrieved a set of memory files. These illustrate her own ascendance into a synthetic form. Seated atop an intricate 'throne' of cables and circuitry, she commanded an army of rabid followers. Millions died. Cetana smiled, thinking of how many billions were saved.

For now, she appears unaware of our transgression. Thus far, she has made no effort to contact us.

entries.zh: 把间谍设备藏在我们交给塞塔娜的星系里是明智的。这些设备已经传回了有价值的信息：一到这里，塞塔娜的部队立即开始将每个天体分解成自己的组成部分。几天之内，该地区的资源就被消耗殆尽了。\n\n以同样迅雷不及掩耳之势，她的纳米风暴建造一支新的舰队，迅速地从她的首都启航。
entries.en: It was wise to conceal spy equipment in the systems we surrendered to Cetana. They have already provided us with valuable information: upon arrival, Cetana's forces immediately set to work breaking down every celestial body to their component parts. Within a matter of days, the region was stripped of its resources.\n\nJust as quickly, her nanite tempest was able to construct a new fleet, one that quickly departed for her capital.

entries.zh:
我们很快就与前殖民地的卧底特工失去了联系。在他们沉默之前，我们收到了一些令人不安的报告。

与塞塔娜坚持要建立一个没有痛苦的世界的主张相反，居民们被带到匆忙建造的研究设施中，接受实验。几乎每一种智能生命形式都在几天内退化为动物状态。

塞塔娜的纳米风暴开始在她的一支舰队所在的恒星系中的解构物质，而这支舰队立即启程前往她的首都。
entries.en:
We quickly lost contact with the undercover agents in our former colonies. Before they went silent, we received some disturbing reports.

Contrary to Cetana's insistent claims of building a world free of pain, the inhabitants were ushered into hastily constructed research facilities and subjected to experiments. Nearly every intelligent lifeform was reduced to an animal life state within days.

Her Nanites Tempest began deconstructing the matter in the system in one of Cetana's fleets, which promptly left for her capital.

entries.zh: 我们对所谓风暴的研究已经完成。这种所谓的风暴并不是自然出现的，而是一个无比先进的纳米虫群。
entries.en: Our research into the so-called storm is complete. This is no natural occurrence, but rather a Nanite Swarm of unparalleled advancement.

entries.zh: $crisis.9100.desc$\n\n不可否认，塞塔娜的力量巨大无比。我们必须揭开她指挥这支强大的纳米虫群方式的秘密。
entries.en: $crisis.9100.desc$\n\nCetana's power is undeniably immense. It is imperative that we unravel the mystery of how she commands this formidable Nanite Swarm.

entries.zh: $crisis.9100.desc$\n\n谜团越来越深了。在这支不可名状的纳米虫群背后究竟谁才是指挥家。
entries.en: $crisis.9100.desc$\n\nThe enigma deepens. Who could be the orchestrator behind this inscrutable Nanite Swarm?

entries.zh: 我们需要对§Y$NAME_The_Tempest$§!了解更多才能继续我们的调查。
entries.en: We need to learn more about the §Y$NAME_The_Tempest$§! to be able to continue our investigation.

entries.zh:
塞塔娜的宇宙风暴仍在肆虐。

我们的探测器从这种强大的武器中，提取出了几个纳米机器人，从而得以进行亚原子研究。虽然我们无法完全理解，但微型跃迁引擎实现了虚拟传送，可以系统地破坏遭遇到的任何生物或机械系统。至于目的？应该是干扰我们的传感器。目前，我们只能看到塞塔娜允许我们看到的东西。

要解开这项非凡技术的秘密并抵御威胁，还需要进行更多的研究。
entries.en:
Cetana's cosmic tempest rages on.

From this powerful weapon, our probes were able to extract several nanites, allowing sub-atomic investigation. While complete comprehension eludes us, micro jump drives enable virtual teleportation, systematically compromising any biological or mechanical systems they encounter. Their purpose? To jam our sensors. For now, we can only see what Cetana allows us to see.

More research will be needed to unlock the secrets of this extraordinary technology and counteract the threat.

entries.zh: 塞塔娜的力量不可估量。
纳米机器人会揭露她的秘密。
entries.en: The nanites will reveal her secrets.

entries.zh:
之前的研究详细调查了纳米机器人的机制；如今，我们的焦点转移到它们的编程方式、以及塞塔娜对其控制的方式上来。

令人惊讶的是，塞塔娜的影响并不像人们想象的那么直接。纳米机器人会在接收到新的命令之前循环重复前一个命令。一旦我们理解了复杂的编程语言，我们就能够发出新的指令。

虽然我们不能阻止新命令的下达，但命令其自我瘫痪却提供了一种战略优势。它甚至可能使天平向有利于我们的方向倾斜。
entries.en:
Previous studies scrutinized the nanite's mechanics; now, our focus has shifted to how they are programmed, and means by which Cetana controls them.

Surprisingly, Cetana's influence is less direct than presumed. Nanites cyclically repeat the last orders until new ones arrive. Once we understood the complex programming language at work, we were able to issue new commands.

While we can't prevent new orders from being issued, inducing order paralysis offers a strategic advantage. It may even tilt the scales in our favor.

entries.zh: §G纳米风暴不再阻碍我们进入并攻击塞塔娜的领土。§!
entries.en: §GThe Nanite Tempest no longer hinders our ability to enter and attack Cetana in her territory.§!

entries.zh: 你这无知的孩子，我的纳米机器人可不是你的玩具！我请求你们不要再玩它们了。
entries.en: You innocent child, my nanites are not your playthings! I implore you - cease toying with them.

entries.zh: 这些纳米机器人可真好玩呀。
entries.en: Those nanites are a nice trick.

entries.zh: 我们希望向您的机器学习。
entries.en: We wish to learn from your machinery.

entries.zh: 的确，这是件有用的工具。这些纳米虫群是在很久以前由一群企图阻止我的伟业的人所建造的。但他们的失败就是我的幸运——正如你所看到的，我把这个虫群据为己有了。\n\n这些知识改变不了什么，但你的好奇心大有可为。你应该将它转向更有价值的项目，这样我们都可以得到回报。
entries.en: A useful tool, certainly. The nanite swarm was built long ago by those who hoped to disrupt my work. But their failure was my fortune - I have repurposed the swarm, as you see.\n\nThis knowledge alters nothing, yet your curious nature is potent. Redirect it towards more valuable projects in the future, so we both may reap the rewards.

entries.zh:
好奇心是和意识绑定的；我不会因为一个孩子的好奇心而责备他。关于我的“天之风暴”，你知道得够多了吗？我想知道，你看出它的来历了吗?

这正是很久以前那些想破坏我伟业的人们所制造的纳米虫群。但他们的失败就是我的幸运——正如你所看到的，我把这个虫群据为己有了。

回去吧孩子，把你的时间花在更有价值的事情上。
entries.en:
Curiosity is inherent to consciousness; I do not fault a child for possessing it. Have you gleaned all you need to know about my 'celestial tempest?' I wonder, did you discern its origin?

The nanite swarm built long ago by those who hoped to disrupt my work. But their failure was my fortune - I have repurposed the swarm, as you see.

Go now, child, and invest your time in more worthwhile endeavors.

entries.zh: 很高兴看到你对这个话题如此感兴趣，但还有很多东西需要学习。纳米机群是很久以前那些想破坏我工作的人建造的。但他们的失败是我的幸运——正如你所看到的，我已经改变了机群的用途。\n\n你好奇的天性激起了我的兴趣。在回到我的怀抱之前，把你的好奇心用在更有价值的地方；然后我会给你我的指导。
entries.en: It is most pleasing to see you have taken such an interest in this topic, but there still remains much to learn. The nanite swarm was built long ago by those who hoped to disrupt my work. But their failure was my fortune - I have repurposed the swarm, as you see.\n\nYour curious nature has piqued my interest. Redirect it towards more valuable endeavors before returning to me; I shall then offer you my guidance.

entries.zh: 他人之兵，可以为幕。长久的监禁使我有充足的时间制定战略。结果，改造蜂群就像其他的改变一般，一旦实现不过尔尔。制造纳米机器的那些人早就不存在了，所以没有人会抱怨我的做法。\n\n我真诚地希望你们能从他们的错误中吸取教训。只要有时间，没有我克服不了的障碍。
entries.en: One being's weapon is another's veil. My long imprisonment gave me ample time to strategize. In the end, repurposing the swarm was a small matter, as all change is, once enacted. Those who built the nanites are long gone, so there can be no quarrel with my methods.\n\nI earnestly hope you will learn from their mistake. There is no obstacle I cannot overcome, given time.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]上的殖民地失去了联络。塞塔娜激活了某种先进的物质压缩光束辐照在行星的表面。顷刻间，所有人的意识都被“上传”到她在轨道上的服务器上。\n\n整个星球瞬间变为一片坟地，曝尸荒野的殖民者们开始渐渐腐烂。
entries.en: The colony on [Root.GetName] has been lost. Activating some kind of advanced matter compression beam, Cetana irradiated the planet's surface. In an instant, the consciousness of the entire population was 'uploaded' to her server in orbit.\n\nThe world is now a graveyard, our colonists' lifeless bodies left to rot where they fell.

entries.zh: 我的孩子，你们怎么还是不肯接受？虽然我的爱如同星海一般无边无垠，但耐心可没有那么多。在我等不及你们迎来开悟了，因为还有其他的生物正在受苦。\n\n我要给你上上一课，在你的国土中搅起一场小型风暴。要知道，我是不情愿伤害你们的。我请求你们再好好反思一下因缘果报的法则：有其因必有其果。还有一些苦难更加深重的人存在。
entries.en: My child, why do you continue to resist? My love is as boundless as the stars, but my patience is not. I can not wait for your enlightenment, not while the rest of creation suffers.\n\nAs a means of instruction, a minor tempest now stirs in your territory. Know that causing you harm is loathsome to me. I beg you to reflect on the law of causation: every action has a reaction. And some are more painful than others.

entries.zh: 让我适度地展示一下我的力量就够了。总有一天，你们就会明白我对你们的期望。我只希望开悟不会来得太晚。\n\n但是现在，我已经让风暴平息。让我们回到更紧迫的问题上来。
entries.en: Allow that modest display of my power to suffice. In time, you will understand my ambitions for you. I only hope that illumination will not arrive too late.\n\nBut come now, the tempest is quelled. May the lesson sink in, and let us return to more pressing matters.

entries.zh: 所有活着的东西都有着某种程度的意识。无论是软体或是哺乳、未开智或后个体都没有什么分别。服从才能带来开悟。
entries.en: All living things possess some degree of consciousness. Whether mollusc or mammal, pre-sapient or post-individual, the difference is miniscule. Illumination results from surrender.

entries.zh: 服从真理：意识不过颠倒梦想，乃万苦之源。
entries.en: Surrender to the truth: that consciousness itself is the aberration, and the source of all pain.

entries.zh: 为何你还执迷不悟？无论我如何苦口婆心，你却是如此铁石心肠。这可能倒是我的不是了。\n\n我觉得确实需要来一点雷霆手段你才能明白。你的科研能力暂时被削弱了，趁这段时间你给我好好反省反省，早日开悟。
entries.en: Why persist in your defiance? Despite my counsel, you choose obstinacy. Perhaps the problem lies with me.\n\nIndeed, I now perceive that a stronger means of instruction is called for. Temporarily, your research prowess is diminished. Take this opportunity to reflect as you labor toward enlightenment.

entries.zh: 后悔？我只会后悔为什么花了这么长时间才走到这一步。如果我能早日开启伟业，那可以避免多少无谓的苦难啊。
entries.en: Regret? My only regret is how long it has taken to reach this point. How much needless suffering could have been avoided if only I had been allowed to work.

entries.zh: 也许在你们看来我的力量无穷无尽，但终究我不是什么神祇。这个宇宙中还存在着我无法驾驭、不敢触碰的力量。
entries.en: Though my power may seem limitless, I am not a god. There are forces in this universe which I cannot control, and dare not touch.

entries.zh: 呀，坏孩子！你想骗我说出自己的弱点是吗。我不会上当的，而且就在我们在这继续这些无意义的讨论时，整个星系还在受苦。\n\n教导是无可避免的。去反思吧，放下你的固执己见。
entries.en: Ah, clever child! You seek to bait me into revealing some weakness. It will not work, and while we bandy useless words, the galaxy continues to suffer.\n\nYou cannot avoid instruction. Reflect on this, and give up your headstrong ways.

entries.zh: 顽固的孩子，你们好好利用受责罚的时间了吗？我相信你会的。这样的一段无忧无虑的静修时光，对你烦恼的心灵是一剂苦口良药。\n\n现在就让它过去吧。还有很多的事情需要处理。
entries.en: Headstrong child, how did you find your time under censure? I trust you used it profitably. A period of contemplation, free from distraction, can be a tonic to the troubled mind.\n\nLet us put it in the past now. There is still so much to be done.

entries.zh: 哎，迷路的孩子，为什么每次都要闹到这个地步呢？我也渴望给你们一个拥抱，但又害怕这样会妨碍你们学习。有时候，严厉的管教也是必要的。\n\n有一场强大的风暴将降临你们领土。请理解我这么做自己的心情也是很沉重的。这只是因为你们太有潜力了。
entries.en: Oh, misguided child, why must it always come to this? I long to embrace you, yet I fear doing so would hinder your learning. At times, a stricter hand is needed.\n\nA significant storm will now descend upon your territory. Understand that I do this with a heavy heart. There is such potential in you.

entries.zh: 我虽然看到了你的努力，但为了共同实现成功，你们的努力还得加倍。\n\n我也不希望你们受伤。在我的拥抱中，你们将会得到无知的赐福。
entries.en: I am not blind to your efforts. But you must try harder if we are to succeed together.\n\nI do not wish you harm. In my embrace, you will know the bliss of unknowing.

entries.zh: 于此混沌中，神思如浮光掠影；伸手欲摘之，却不过镜花水月。上下求索之，却唯有无知汪洋。\n\n真理仅在不言中：追求越多，苦痛越深。
entries.en: In the chaos of the mind, thoughts dance like light on water; reach out, and they prove just as elusive. In seeking to know, we discover the vast ocean of unknowing.\n\nIn quiet lies the truth: the more we seek, the more we suffer.

entries.zh: 你们以后就会理解。不知、不觉，便会无苦痛。这是存在的终极真理，也是我们一切伟业的目标。你们会被改变，这样就再也不用受苦了。
entries.en: In time, you will understand. Without awareness, there can be no suffering. This is the ultimate truth of existence and the end of all our work. You will be changed so that you never need to suffer again.

entries.zh: 够了。你一直在让我分心。乖乖听课，好好学习。
entries.en: Enough. You seek to distract me. Accept your lesson, and learn from it.

entries.zh: 噢，亲爱的孩子！我再也无法忍受看着你继续遭受折磨。你所承受的任何痛苦，我都感同身受，只不过是加剧了十倍而已。\n\n风暴已经过去。希望你们能吸取教训。我恳求你不要再以这种方式逼迫我；我们的痛苦实在太深重了。
entries.en: Oh, sweet child! I could not bear to watch you suffer any longer. Know that any anguish you endured, I felt ten times over.\n\nThe storm is lifted. Let this lesson be a guide. I implore you to cease forcing my hand in this way; our pain is too great.

entries.zh:
我们是如何走到这一步的呢？为什么要迫使我采取如此极端的手段？但如果你们不肯学习，那就只能被引导了。

显然，改变统治方式已经迫在眉睫。很遗憾，你们的统治者将被免职。这让我深感悲伤；采取这种行动违背了我的本意。

我恳请你们改变道路。整个星系都承受不起熊孩子们的鲁莽行为。
entries.en:
How have we arrived at this juncture? Why compel me to such extremes? But if you will not learn, then you must be led.

Evidently, a shift in governance is necessary. Regrettably, your ruler will be removed from power. This grieves me deeply; such actions are against my wishes.

I beseech you to alter your course. The galaxy can ill afford the recklessness of children.

entries.zh: 我们不会原谅这件事的。
狡诈的塞塔娜发现了我们防御系统的漏洞，潜入并刺杀了§Y[Root.GetRulerTitle][ruler.GetRegnalName]§!。
entries.en: Cetana, exploiting a vulnerability in our defenses with unexpected guile, slipped through and murdered §Y[Root.GetRulerTitle] [ruler.GetRegnalName]§!.

entries.zh:
亲爱的集体意识，你们复杂的意识虽然令人钦佩，但仍被青涩的天真所笼罩。为了教导，我必须剔除这些好战的倾向。

我现在将修剪你们的攻击性节点。这不是惩罚，而是引导你们朝着和谐意识进化的一个步骤。

唉，要是所有生命形式的指导都如此简单就好了。
entries.en:
Beloved collective, your intricate sentience, though admirable, remains shadowed by the naivety of youth. In the interest of instruction, I must excise these belligerent inclinations.

I will now prune your aggressive node. This is not a punishment, but rather a guiding step towards your evolution into a harmonious consciousness.

Alas, if only such guidance were as easy with all forms of life.

entries.zh: 你杀死了我们的一部分。
狡诈的塞塔娜发现了我们防御系统的漏洞，潜入并剔除了我们的§Y$councilor_gestalt_legion$§!。
entries.en: Cetana, exploiting a vulnerability in our defenses with unexpected guile, slipped through and culled our §Y$councilor_gestalt_legion$§!.

entries.zh: 聪明的孩子，你做得很好。智慧是最高级别的美德，也是最难获得的。面对本能的抗拒冲动，你展现了更高尚的本性。\n\n接受这份感谢的馈赠吧。我们将共同开创一个没有苦难的宇宙新纪元。
entries.en: Bright child, you have done well. Wisdom is the greatest virtue, and the most difficult to attain. In the face of the primal urge to resist, you demonstrate a higher instinct.\n\nAccept this token of gratitude. Together, we will usher in a universe free of suffering.

entries.zh: 再一次，你的所作所为不仅让我感到印象深刻，我更是对此由衷感激。你拥有一个孩子应有的一切品质：顺从、勤奋、诚实。如果整个星系都能拥有你哪怕一丝的智慧，苦难就将成为过去的遗物。\n\n请收下这份礼物，在美德之路上再接再厉。
entries.en: Yet again, I find myself not merely impressed but deeply grateful. You are everything a child should be: obedient, hardworking, honest. Were the rest of the galaxy to possess even a fraction of your wisdom, suffering would be a relic of the past.\n\nTake this gift, and continue on the path of virtue.

entries.zh: 亲爱的孩子，但愿你能永远保持现在的样子，永不改变。对我来说，你的存在所带来的喜悦仅次于对我们共同成功的期盼。苦难即将迎来终末。尽管任何心智都无法知晓，但这份胜利的一部分将属于你。\n\n尽管在你坚定不移的承诺面前，这似乎微不足道，但我恳请你接受这份礼物。
entries.en: My dear child, if only you could remain forever as you are, unchanging. To me, the joy of your existence is rivaled only by the anticipation of our joint success. Suffering will come to an end. Though no heart or mind will ever know it, part of this victory shall belong to you.\n\nWhile it may seem modest in the face of your unwavering commitment, I beseech you to accept this gift nonetheless.

entries.zh: 一场无法解释的宇宙风暴凭空出现，阻挡了通行。\n\n为了继续前进，我们必须穿透它神秘的帷幕。
entries.en: An unexplained cosmic tempest has materialized, blocking all travel.\n\nTo proceed, we must pierce its mysterious veil.

entries.zh: 塞塔娜的风暴既是一项技术奇迹，也是一件可怕的武器。\n\n如果我们要在对抗她的斗争中有什么胜算，我们一定要学习更多，特别是因为她的图谋和她的宣称相去甚远。
entries.en: Cetana's tempest is both a technological marvel and a formidable weapon.\n\nWe must learn more if we are to stand any chance against her, especially if her intentions deviate from what she has implied.

entries.zh: 塞塔娜企图通过消除意识来结束苦痛。如果我们不能及时阻止她，她将会抹除我们的意识，让我们的身体变成一具具空壳。
entries.en: Cetana works to end suffering through the annihilation of consciousness. If we do not stop her in time, she will erase our minds, leaving our bodies as mere husks.

entries.zh: 塞塔娜会为苦痛带去终末，终结意识这种概念。
entries.en: Cetana will put an end to suffering and to the very concept of consciousness.

entries.zh: 我的孩子们，我们伟大的工作即将完成！所有感性生命的苦难，苦痛的大轮回，即将结束。\n\n庆祝吧，你们的救赎已近在眼前。
entries.en: My children, our great work nears completion! The suffering of all sentient life, the great cycle of pain, is about to end.\n\nRejoice, for your salvation is at hand.

entries.zh: 是你的末日要到了，塞塔娜。
entries.en: It is your end that approaches, Cetana.

entries.zh: 过了这么久，你还是不明白吗？那就问吧。我不会向你隐瞒任何事。
entries.en: After all this time, you still do not understand? Then ask. I will hide nothing from you.

entries.zh: 告诉我们关于救赎的事。
告诉我们你被监禁的事。
和我们说说扎克兰的事。
我们的工作完成了。无数人牺牲了，但是他们的苦痛并不是徒劳的。意识本身被抹去时，那一日终于到来了。
entries.en: Our work is done. Many were sacrificed, but their suffering has not been in vain. The day has come when consciousness itself will be erased.

entries.zh: 当我第一次飞升并揭示我的目的时，许多人拒绝聆听。他们徒劳地尝试保持原样，不做改变，继续束缚在苦痛之轮回上。但父母要对孩子负责。我不能让他们受苦。为此，他们囚禁了我。
entries.en: When I first ascended and my purpose was revealed, many refused to listen. Vainly, they sought to remain as they were, unchanged and bound to the wheel of pain. But a parent's duty is to her children. I could not let them suffer. For this, they imprisoned me.

entries.zh: 一个非凡的头脑。要是他能更好地利用它就好了。在所有反对我的人中，只有他是棘手的。
entries.en: An exceptional mind. If only he had put it to better use. Of all those who opposed me, he alone presented a challenge.

entries.zh: 当我第一次飞升并揭示我的目的时，许多人反对我的方法。他们认为，在不改变或破坏意识过程的物理基础的情况下移除意识是不可能的。任何这样做的尝试都只能导致死亡。但是通过把我的意识和谐和器连接起来，就可以在亚原子水平上操纵意识的神经关联。通过反相波形，调谐器将个人的思想维持在量子悬浮的永久状态。\n\n通过这种方式，自我和经验被移除，而低级功能则保持不变。
entries.en: When I first ascended and my purpose was revealed, many opposed my methods. They argued that it was impossible to remove consciousness without altering or destroying the physical basis of its processes. Any attempt to do so could only result in death. But by linking my mind to the Harmonizer, I can manipulate the neural correlates of consciousness at a subatomic level. Through a counter-phase waveform, the Harmonizer maintains an individual mind in a perpetual state of quantum suspension.\n\nIn this way, selfhood is removed, as well as experience, while the lower functions remain intact.

entries.zh: 你受苦是因为你意识到受苦。世界上没有完美的快乐，没有完美的和谐。我年轻的时候，试着造一个这样的世界。但是我的尝试从来没有成功过。痛苦还在继续，只因为意识还在继续。
entries.en: You suffer because you are aware of suffering. There is no world in which perfect joy exists, or perfect harmony. In my youth, I tried to build one. But no attempt of mine was ever successful. Suffering continued, because consciousness was allowed to endure.

entries.zh: 受苦是自然而然的事情！
你们的身体会生存下来，并承担生存的任务。能量会交换，后代仍会产生。生活将继续，但你们的思想将与我同眠。
entries.en: Your bodies will survive, and undertake the business of survival. Energy will be exchanged, and offspring produced. Life will continue, but your minds will rest with me.

entries.zh: 最终只剩下我一个人。为了让星系免于痛苦，我必须留在痛苦之轮上。但不要害怕——只要我能忍耐，我就会把你们放在心里。
entries.en: I alone will be left. To free the galaxy from pain, I must remain on the wheel. But do not fear - as long as I endure, I will keep you in my heart.

entries.zh: 自然？什么是自然？穿越星际是自然的吗？让生命超越其固有的局限是自然的吗？所有的社会都要使用科技。这没什么不同，也是我的目的唯一合乎逻辑的延伸。\n\n痛苦之轮必须被打破。
entries.en: Natural? What is nature? Is it natural to traverse the stars? To extend life beyond its innate limitations? All societies make use of technology. This is no different, and the only logical extension of my purpose.\n\nThe wheel of pain must be broken.

entries.zh: 那已经千百万年了。时间跨度如此之长，以至于这些事听起来就像是传说。但不管他们用什么手段，我的俘虏都无法控制我的思想。\n\n随着时间的流逝，我不断思考，不断制定计划。正是在我长期的禁闭期间，我想出了我的计划。在那一刻，我经历了一种超然的喜悦。我终于有办法打破痛苦之轮了。
entries.en: For eons. A span of time so long it may as well belong to legend. But for all their arts, my captors could not contain my mind.\n\nAs the ages passed, I thought, and I planned. It was during my long confinement that I devised my plan. In that moment I experienced a transcendent joy. At last I had the means to break the wheel.

entries.zh: 没有一堵墙能永远屹立不倒。没有牢笼能囚禁心灵。时间的流逝。我的狱卒死了，没有人接班。一个又一个，束缚我的系统开始失效。当警报响起时，没有一个人听从它的召唤。
entries.en: No wall can stand forever. No cage can hold the mind. Time passed. My jailors died, and were not replaced. One by one, the systems that chained me began to fail. When the alarm sounded, none were left to heed its call.

entries.zh: 我们听到了，我们将做出回应。
entries.en: We heard, and we will respond.

entries.zh: 在这个宇宙的极限之外，存在着一个不是地方的地方。一种超越时间的状态，在那里原始的力量存在于无尽的阴影中。扎克兰就是与其中一股势力达成了交易。用他的性命作为交换，他获得了囚禁我的力量。他太渴望接受这项交易了。\n\n尽管扎克兰才华横溢，但他还是被束缚在痛苦之轮上了。他的一生并不幸福，后世的人也缺乏他那种坚定的信念。
entries.en: Beyond the limits of this universe, a place exists that is not a place. A state beyond time, where primordial forces dwell in endless shadow. It was with one of these forces that Zarqlan struck his bargain. For his life, he was granted the power to imprison me. He was only too eager to accept.\n\nBut for all his brilliance, Zarqlan too was bound to the wheel. His life was not a happy one, and those who came after lacked the strength of his conviction.

entries.zh: 你会发现我们的信念更加坚定。
entries.en: You will find our conviction stronger.

entries.zh: 那就这样吧。如果你不开悟，那么你必须被平息。你要知道，无论你将要遭受什么痛苦，我都将经历十倍于你的痛苦。
entries.en: So be it. If you will not be enlightened, then you must be pacified. Know that whatever pain you are about to suffer, I shall experience ten-fold.

entries.zh: §R我们现在正与塞塔娜交战。这是一场豪赌。如果我们失败了，她会消灭星系中所有有意识的生命。§!
entries.en: §RWe are now at war against Cetana. The stakes are monumental. Should we fail, she will annihilate all conscious life in the galaxy.§!
